title: Business Intelligence Engineer, ARTS
descriptionHtml:
[English]
Amazon's mission is to be "Earth's most comprehensive selection" and "Earth's most customer-centric company." The Customer Experience we provide rests on three pillars: selection, low prices, and convenience. As the hub of Amazon Japan's Operations business, we operate approximately 30 Fulfillment Centers (FCs) and continue to expand in order to deliver a better Customer Experience. FCs are logistics hubs equipped with cutting-edge systems and facilities, shipping over 1.4 billion items in 2023. FC logistics management is less about running a warehouse and more akin to the process management found in manufacturing.

APEX-RoW Technology Solutions (ARTS), together with the FC Central team, is now seeking a customer-focused Business Intelligence Engineer to ambitiously support FC operations through technology. This position contributes to the Operations division's ongoing efforts to reduce costs, improve delivery speed, and expand selection for customers, by efficiently and effectively leveraging the Big Data gathered from across the entire Amazon Fulfillment Network throughout Japan. By applying the latest methods—such as data analysis, data pipeline construction, and data visualization—to operational challenges, this role drives standardization, automation, and optimization.

What makes this position appealing

Work moves at a very fast pace, with many changes every day. As the business expands rapidly, this is an environment where you can proactively take on new challenges and grow alongside the growth of the business. From a data management perspective, the environment offers the following:

- In a data-driven organization, you will learn methods for effectively leveraging big data for the business over the long term
- You will drive projects together with engineering team members from diverse backgrounds and skill sets, as well as business-side specialists
- You can be involved in every stage of designing and building KPIs, BI dashboards, data pipelines, and more, and drive them forward with a high degree of autonomy
- You can grow as a BIE capable of development based on AWS standards (Redshift, S3, Lambda, QuickSight, etc.)

Who we're looking for

- Someone who consistently brings flexibility and a sense of speed, and who proactively takes on problem-solving and action to make things better for both customers and Amazon
- Someone who can discern the essence of an issue, identify the root cause of a problem, and devise and execute fundamental solutions
- Someone who can drive improvements while collaborating with internal customer departments and stakeholders

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

[Japanese]
アマゾンは“地球上でもっとも豊富な品揃え”と“地球上でもっともお客様を大切にする企業であること”をミッションとしています。私達の提供するCustomer Experience（顧客満足度）は、品揃え、低価格、および利便性の三つの柱があります。アマゾンジャパンはオペレーション（運営・推進）事業の拠点として、約30のフルフィルメントセンター（Fulfillment Center, FC）を持ち、よりよいCustomer Experienceを提供するために拡大を続けています。FCは最先端のシステム、設備が導入された物流拠点で、2023年には14億個を超える商材を出荷しています。FCの物流管理業務は、物流倉庫の管理というよりは製造業に近い工程管理となっています。

この度、APEX-RoW Technology Solutions (ARTS)は、FC Network Planning チームと共に、FCのオペレーションを、テクノロジーで意欲的に支える、顧客志向のBusiness Intelligence Engineerを募集します。本ポジションは、日本全国のAmazon Fulfillment Network全体から取得するBig Dataを効率的に有効活用して、オペレーション部門が継続的にお客様のために、コスト削減、配送スピードの向上、セレクションの拡大をしていくことに貢献します。オペレーションの課題にデータ分析、データパイプライン構築、データ可視化などの最新の手法を提供することで、標準化、自動化、最適化を推進します。

本ポジションの魅力
非常に速いスピードで業務が展開され、日々多くの変化があります。事業が急速に拡大していく中、新しいことに積極的にチャレンジすることが可能な環境であり、ビジネスの成長と共に自分自身も成長することができます。また、データマネジメントの観点では以下のような環境です。

- データドリブンな組織で、ビッグデータを長期に渡ってビジネスに有効に活用する手法を学びます
- 多様なバックグラウンド・スキルを持つエンジニアのメンバー、ビジネス側のスペシャリスト達と共にプロジェクトを推進します
- KPI、BIダッシュボード、データパイプライン等の設計と構築において全工程で関与することができ、裁量を持って推進いただけます
- AWS（Redshift、S3、Lambda、QuickSight等）のスタンダードに基づいた開発ができるBIEとして成長できます

活躍していただける方
- フレキシビリティとスピード感を常に持ち、お客様とAmazonがより良くなるために主体的に課題解決やアクションに取り組める方
- 課題の本質を見極め、問題の根本原因を特定し、本質的な対策を考え、実行することができる方
- 社内の顧客にあたる部門、ステークホルダーと協力しながら、改善を進めていくことができる方

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities

- Build data pipelines and automate end-to-end processes

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Darmstadt - 2027
descriptionHtml:

Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern

title: Loss Prevention Expert – Military & Police Experience, Security & Loss Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for hands-on and detail-oriented professionals who want to join our team as Loss Prevention Expert. In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

These roles are a great fit for candidates with a police or military background. The skills and experience gained in law enforcement or military service—such as security awareness, risk assessment, incident management, investigation, leadership, decision-making under pressure, and maintaining high professional standards—can translate particularly well into a Loss Prevention role at Amazon. Whether you are transitioning from active service or looking to bring your policing or military experience into a new career, we value the skills and perspectives you can bring to our team.

Key job responsibilities
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external stakeholder (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards
• Own Security and Loss Prevention-related projects on the local, regional, and country level


A day in the life
As a Loss Prevention Expert, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area.

You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews.

Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in our processes and you identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality.

Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our Security and Loss Prevention plan.

About the team
Sitting within the Global Security Operations organization, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:


• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation



Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing re-occurrence.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in investigation or loss prevention
- Experience in law enforcement or a security-related profession
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Speak, write, and read fluently in German

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in security services, asset protection, loss prevention, risk management, inventory management, investigations, supply chain, auditing, compliance, or similar
- Experience making and influencing risk-guided decisions by leveraging data and metrics
- Valid driver's license with access to a personal vehicle for daily use
- Bachelor's degree or above in an advanced technical degree field

title: Data Center Facility Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers

Oversee the safety, security, availability, quality, and performance of the team, while driving a positive customer experience across multiple shift schedules

Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians and Facility Managers in all facets of their career

Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion

Ensure staffing levels are maintained and grow with expansions

Be actively involved in ongoing construction activities

Coordinate daily with a multitude of third-party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs

Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of in industrial electrical or mechanical systems experience
- 5+ years of in a managerial/supervisory role with 5 or more direct reports experience
- 3+ years of electrical or mechanical experience
- 3+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience conducting interviews and making effective hiring decisions
- Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units
- Experience communicating technical details verbally and in writing
- Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
- Experience hiring candidates, mentoring and developing employees in their careers
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, or 3+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience

title: Senior Solutions Architect - UK Healthcare, UK Public Sector -  Healthcare
descriptionHtml:
AWS is growing its UK Public Sector Healthcare team and looking for a Solutions Architect who wants to help transform how the NHS delivers care to 67 million citizens. You will be the technical partner for NHS trusts, national health bodies, and Health Technology organisations, designing cloud architectures that address real clinical and operational challenges at national scale. From patient engagement platforms serving millions of patients to clinical AI that returns time to frontline clinicians, the problems you work on will have a direct, measurable impact on patient outcomes and NHS workforce capacity. You will join a collaborative, supportive team that values deep domain knowledge, technical curiosity, and the ability to build trust with senior healthcare stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with NHS trusts, national health bodies, and Health Technology organisations to design and deliver cloud architectures that address clinical, operational, and data challenges at scale
- Lead technical engagements including discovery workshops, architecture reviews, and proof-of-concept builds for healthcare workloads spanning AI/ML, analytics, interoperability, and IoT
- Develop and present technical proposals to senior stakeholders including Chief Clinical Information Officers, Chief Technology Officers, and programme directors
- Collaborate with AWS service teams to shape healthcare-relevant capabilities and bring customer feedback into the product roadmap
- Create and share best practices, technical content, and reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and educate about AWS technology through workshops, meetups, public speaking, or conferences


A day in the life
One day you might be designing an architecture for a patient record system, the next running a proof-of-concept with a Health Tech ISV building for FHIR interoperability, the next advising an Integrated Care System on how clinical AI services can reduce administrative burden for GPs. You will work alongside Account Managers and senior NHS stakeholders, translating complex clinical requirements into practical cloud solutions. The work covers the full breadth of AWS services applied to problems that matter: connecting disparate health systems, enabling population-level analytics, and helping clinicians spend more time with patients. No two days look the same, and you will have the autonomy to play to your strengths.

About the team
This role is in our Healthcare team supporting NHS trusts, NHS national bodies, and Health Tech ISVs across the UK. Cloud technology is at the centre of how the NHS is modernising care delivery, from interoperable patient records to clinical AI, and our team partners closely with customers on long-term strategic programmes, not just one-off projects. We have grown over the last year, welcoming people from different backgrounds who bring unique experiences to our customers. Our tenured Solutions Architects mentor and share knowledge across the team. We are passionate about the impact we have on people across the UK, and we care deeply about our customers' missions. We enjoy working together in an environment that is supportive, inclusive, and fun. We respect that everyone has responsibilities and interests outside of work, and our roles afford the flexibility to be your best at work and at home.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field or military
- Experience in customer-facing roles
- Experience in a technical role involving cloud computing, systems design, software development, or infrastructure architecture
- Experience designing and building distributed systems or architectures in a production environment
- Experience with generative AI or machine learning technologies in an enterprise environment
- Experience communicating technical concepts across both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
- Experience working in or alongside UK healthcare organisations such as NHS trusts, Integrated Care Systems, or national healthcare bodies
- Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7 FHIR, DICOM) or clinical data governance frameworks (NHS DSPT, DTAC)
- Experience designing or deploying generative AI solutions at enterprise scale, including foundation model selection, retrieval-augmented generation, or responsible AI practices
- Understanding of UK public sector procurement processes and frameworks
- Experience mentoring or developing other technical professionals

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience

descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Connectivity and Network Availability (GCNA) is the backbone that connects the global AWS network. It is dedicated to controlling the internet traffic that allows users to access their information and applications regardless of where they are in the world. GCNA is responsible for building and designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between Data Centers and customers.

The ideal candidate will share our excitement about cloud computing and will be passionate about delivering high quality services. You will have good knowledge of distributed systems with design and implementation experience, as well as the ability to lead and mentor other engineers. You will be customer centric and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that requires excellent technical and communication skills. You will join a tenured team of Network Development Engineers and Software Development Engineers. This is an opportunity to build a new service utilizing AWS technologies.

We are looking for a candidate who will be comfortable working with a broad range of data sources and solving problems at scale. As a team we proactively support knowledge-sharing and we embrace opportunities to teach company-wide. Since every business at Amazon relies on a network that runs smoothly, the right candidate will guide the business and communicate value, work collaboratively to develop pragmatic yet flexible solutions and move forward in the face ambiguity. The candidate should be willing to build good working relationships within the team and across AWS.

Working at AWS on the GCNA Team

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer, you will oversee the complete software development lifecycle:
• Defining, prioritizing, designing, building, and testing new features.
• Operate an AWS business with globally distributed servers and customers at a massive scale.
• Understand what it takes to grow and operate a global business at our scale.

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer, you will problem-solve and innovate in an agile, sometimes ambiguous environment. You will build creative short-term and sustainable long-term solutions with others as passionate as you about this mission. You will use data to make decisions and validate assumptions. You will learn from others and help grow those in your team to achieve their best.

About the team
GCNA-D provides high-performing Internet connectivity for a wide range of use cases, such as retail (amazon.com), video streaming (Prime Video), content delivery (CloudFront), DNS (Route53), AWS services (such as EC2/S3), consumer devices (such as FireTV/Kindle/Echo), and more.

Within AWS Networking, the GCNA-D organization is responsible for connecting Amazon to the global Internet. With connections to thousands of unique external networks in hundreds of locations across the world, our mission is to deliver an Internet connectivity experience that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security, and cost, making Amazon the clear choice for our customers’ needs.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

descriptionHtml:

It’s Day 1 for Amazon’s next billion-dollar business and the Kuiper Government Solutions (KGS) business is looking for an entrepreneurial minded Sr. Program Planning & Scheduling Analyst to work in a start-up environment who is passionate about technology, who thinks/acts globally, and has the ability to create and implement solutions, processes and controls with a focus on the public sector.

The KGS team is focused on Government customers around the world, including U.S. DoD and other national security customers.

The successful candidate will be responsible for executing day-to-day program planning & scheduling tasks within KGS, providing qualitative and quantitative data analysis for program performance management, ensuring the business meets critical deliverables, program schedules (Integrated Master Schedule), as well as risk and opportunity tracking, management, and mitigation.

This leader will work cross-functionally alongside the program finance team, as well as the program management and engineering teams to ensure Government-funded programs are tracked and performed on cost and schedule.

As KGS grows and takes on more complex contract types, the successful candidate will be responsible for performing Earned Value Management (EVM) activities. While still in the start-up phase, KGS will be tracking EVM "lite" metrics from an internal management perspective for program performance.

The program planning organization will have responsibility for aligning our product roadmaps with Kuiper availability, ensuring we have products Government customers can use when Kuiper service comes online.

The Sr. Program Planning & Scheduling Analyst will also be responsible for creating integrated schedules that lay in both government program commitments as well as internal deadlines, and then align with Kuiper commercial on product availability and dependencies.

- 5+ years of applying key financial schedule indicators to analyses experience

- 5+ years of hands on experience with program planning/scheduling tools (i.e. Cobra, Open Plan, Microsoft Project, Primavera, etc.)
- 5+ years performing Critical path analysis, generating schedule analysis to advise Pm's on options to improve schedule performance and managing schedule metrics

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, eCS Data Engineering and Analytics
descriptionHtml:

title: Account Representative Intern 6 months - French Speaker
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.


Key job responsibilities
Work backwards from the customer, identifying inputs to grow brands and improve their performance across Amazon's retail categories.

Support vendor managers and cross-functional teams — including in-stock, marketing, and category teams — to deliver business growth.

Build an understanding of customer pain points, requirements, and potential value that can be delivered through retail, advertising, or merchant services.

Identify target accounts using market data and industry intelligence, and learn the advertising or merchant services portfolio.

Collect, analyse, and review data to develop analytical and problem-solving skills, uncovering insights that drive business improvement.

Identify opportunities to improve products, services, processes, systems, and tools across the business.

Work with product teams and technical support teams to implement improvement projects.

A day in the life
Every day is a little different as an Account Representative Intern. Depending on your team, you might be supporting a vendor manager to grow a strategic brand within a retail category, helping account managers create compelling advertising presentations for clients, or driving new business growth across Amazon's third-party merchants. You might spend your morning analysing market data and customer insights to identify target accounts and growth opportunities, then spend your afternoon working with category or product teams to implement an improvement project.

Amazon is a customer-obsessed business, so no matter which team you join, part of your role will involve working backwards from the customer to understand their pain points and deliver value. You'll gain a deep understanding of Amazon's e-commerce retail business, advertising products, or merchant services portfolio, and partner across functions to deliver results — building your analytical, commercial, and stakeholder management skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

About the team
The Amazon Business team at Amazon is focused on transforming how businesses purchase supplies and equipment by providing a seamless B2B shopping experience.

You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

descriptionHtml:

Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern

• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.

Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.

title: Senior Building Management System Specialist, Amazon Maintenance Operation Centre
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep.

Across the globe we have more than thousand Fulfillment Centers, thousands of Delivery Stations, tens of thousands of machines, and hundreds of thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time.

Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day. We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operation is built on the way teams’ bond and the work ethic that enables our business run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world.

Join us in the Amazon Maintenance Operation centre team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.
Purpose of job
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join our current team and support one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong technical foundation in BMS programming, coupled with good HVAC understanding. The successful candidate will spearhead efforts to maintain, enhance, and optimize our global services, ensuring seamless BMS functionality and delivering unparalleled customer experiences.


Key job responsibilities
- Maintain and optimize BMS technologies, IoT platforms, and data analytics of the BMS.
- Monitor and maintain ticket/work order processes and queues while ensuring customer care and quality meet the high bar.
- Monitor and analyze BMS data to proactively identify and action opportunities for optimization, energy efficiency, and cost savings.
- Design, implement and manage BMS Standard Operating Procedures, Policies and Processes which are scalable across the globe.
- Support the development and execute a comprehensive strategy for maintaining, improving, and expanding our global support services.
- Collaborate closely with WWRE, D&C, Sustainability, RME and other stakeholders to comprehend customer requirements, business objectives, and operational needs.
- Uphold compliance with the change management processes.
- Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and vendors, ensuring a customer-centric approach.
- Provides strategic insights and recommendations to management on BMS trends, improvements, issues, root causes, team skillsets, industry best practices, and emerging technologies.
- Take ownership of BMS initiatives, documenting white papers, managing timelines and stakeholders.
- Lead training sessions and development programs for internal teams and individuals to continuously enhance the capability, technical skills of field RME teams, and BMS Specialists.
- Drive a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team.
- Willing to work flexible shifts to provide 24/7 BMS support, ensuring global customers receive timely and reliable assistance.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Strong knowledge and troubleshooting of HVAC and BMS controls. Ability to remotely troubleshoot BMS communication issues, including fieldbus (BACnet, LON, Modbus via RS485), Network Gateways and IP-based protocols (Niagara Fox, MQTT, BACnet/IP, SNMP).
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Electronics/Communications Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
- Experience in BMS programming and commissioning, with a minimum of 3 years in building controls or related field.
- Ability to integrate multiple communications protocols such as BACnet, LON, Modbus, SNMP to a single platform with normalized data for standard visualization.

Preferred qualifications

title: FPGA Engineer, MQS Center for Quantum Computing
descriptionHtml:
The Models, Quantum, and Silicon (MQS) Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is a multi-disciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and technicians, on a mission to develop a fault-tolerant quantum computer.

We are looking for an FPGA Engineer to contribute to our quantum control platform. As a part of the control stack team, you will develop and integrate RTL designs and embedded software with an eye towards overcoming novel challenges in experimental quantum computing, such as high-throughput device characterization & calibration, or enabling real-time quantum error correction protocols. The ideal candidate will help us work backwards from our broader experimental goals, driving improvements to our control platform at the hardware/software interface while ensuring that high-level requirements (e.g. latency, bandwidth, resource utilization) are met.

This position is on-site at our lab, located on the Caltech campus in Pasadena, CA.

Work/Life Balance
At the MQS CQC, we understand that developing quantum computing technology is a marathon, not a sprint. Mental and physical wellness is encouraged within our team and throughout AWS. The work/life integration within Amazon encourages a culture where employees work hard and have ownership over their downtime. We are exploring more structured wellness elements including meditation scheduling, running group meet-ups, and a culture of sharing wellness tips.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We are committed to the growth and development of every member of the Center for Quantum Computing. You will receive career-growth-minded management and mentorship from a software and science team, and also have the opportunity to participate in Amazon's mentorship programs. You will work closely with quantum research scientists and have opportunities to learn about quantum computing technology and contribute to the development of scientific software for quantum computing at AWS.

Inclusive and Diverse Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Key job responsibilities
- Work with stakeholders to understand and refine hardware/software requirements.
- Propose architectural or micro-architectural updates to our control platform to meet requirements.
- Implement RTL subsystems in Verilog or SystemVerilog.
- Develop embedded software in C, C++ or Rust for high-performance near-real-time tasks.
- Verify & validate designs, both in simulation and in bench-top / real-world conditions.
- Ensure new features are successfully integrated into our Python-based experimental software stack.

We are looking for candidates with strong engineering principles, resourcefulness and a bias for action, superior problem-solving and excellent communication skills. Working effectively within a team environment is essential. As a member of a research organization, you will have the opportunity to work on new ideas and stay abreast of the field of experimental quantum computation.

A day in the life
The majority of your time will be spent on projects that extend the functional capabilities or performance of our existing control platform. This requires working backwards from the needs of our science staff in the context of our larger experimental roadmap. You will translate hardware and software requirements into design proposals balancing implementation complexity against time-to-delivery. Once a design proposal has been reviewed and accepted, you will drive the implementation and coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth roll out. Because many high-level experimental goals have cross-cutting requirements, you’ll often work closely with other software or hardware engineers on the team.

About the team
You will be joining the Software team within the MQS Center of Quantum Computing. Our team is comprised of scientists and software engineers who are building scalable software and hardware that enables quantum computing technologies.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 3+ years of industry experience with FPGA development
- Experience with a scripting language (bash, TCL, Python, etc.)
- 2+ years of experience in developing embedded software in C, C++, or Rust
- Experience performing hardware bring-up/debugging (e.g. Ethernet network adapters, SPI/I2C devices, etc...)
- Experience with standard communication interfaces (USB, PCIe, Ethernet)

Preferred qualifications

- M.Sc. degree, or equivalent, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or Computer Science
- Experience with soft core RISC-V implementation
- Experience with Xilinx SoC platforms
- Experience with high-level synthesis tools
- Experience developing real-time operating system (RTOS) applications
- Experience with low-level device driver and kernel development (esp. on Xilinx MPSoC or other ARM architectures)
- Experience with high-performance networking technologies (e.g. DPDK, RDMA)
- Experience with low-latency distributed computation
- Knowledge of Linux kernel internals and networking or storage subsystems architecture

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS’ Infrastructure Services & Supply Chain (AIS-SC) organization works to deliver leading-edge solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. You will lead a cross function team to deliver AWS roadmap and achieve manufacturing operation readiness for new product release in our global manufacturing locations. descriptionHtml:

Imagine designing the next generation of fulfillment centers that power Amazon's global supply chain. As the technical authority for your projects, you'll collaborate with suppliers and internal teams to transform ideas into reality. Once designs are approved, you'll partner with our Ops Engineering team to ensure successful installation and launch.

Your canvas will be diverse - from building new facilities from the ground up (green-field) to modernizing existing operations (brown-field) and strategic retrofits. You'll design fulfillment centers, cross-dock facilities, specialty sites for reverse logistics and hazmat, plus ground and air transportation hubs across North America and Europe. Some projects will follow proven templates while others will require completely fresh approaches.

You'll join a team of exceptionally talented engineers who thrive on innovation. This role offers immense growth potential as you tackle challenges that directly impact millions of customer experiences.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, drives results, and is eager to help shape the future of global logistics. If you're ready to make your mark on one of the world's most sophisticated supply chain networks, we want to talk to you.

Design automated material handling systems that efficiently move products through our fulfillment centers. descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about pioneering the future of generative AI and eager to help the world's largest and most complex financial institutions solve real-world challenges using AI solutions? The ASPI - Global Financial Services (GFS) team seeks an experienced technologist who possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. As a trusted customer advocate and Generative AI Solutions Architect, you'll partner with a focused portfolio of strategic banking, insurance, payments, and capital markets customers across North America to craft highly scalable AI architectures that address critical business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS's comprehensive AI stack.
This is not a high-volume role. You'll go deep, not wide — building lasting technical relationships with a small number of the most significant financial services organizations in North America. You'll join a specialized team of Solutions Architects dedicated exclusively to generative AI, working alongside account managers and account Solutions Architects to drive AI innovation across these strategic accounts. Our team's focused expertise has made us a valuable resource for customers seeking guidance on advanced AI solutions. You'll help organizations understand best practices and effectively implement generative AI capabilities within their existing cloud infrastructure — while navigating the stringent security, compliance, data sovereignty, and regulatory requirements unique to the financial services industry.
In this role, you will shape and execute strategies to build mind share and broad use of AWS's AI services within financial services customers. The ability to connect AI technology with measurable business value is critical, as you'll develop compelling demos and proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how generative AI can revolutionize business operations through intelligent automation and advanced reasoning capabilities. You'll design architectures that enable AI systems to process complex queries, interact with enterprise data sources, and efficiently complete multistep tasks with agentic AI — from fraud detection and risk modeling to regulatory reporting, customer service automation, and personalized financial insights.


Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the trusted technical advisor for generative AI strategy across a small number of the largest, most complex Global Financial Services accounts in North America
• Develop strategic technical roadmaps and implementation plans for generative AI solutions that align with customers' business objectives and existing architecture
• Design and implement generative AI architectures that orchestrate complex workflows across enterprise systems, leveraging AWS services like Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Kiro, and Amazon Quick
• Advise on agentic system architecture — RAG, tool-use patterns, memory and state management, multi-agent orchestration, and human-in-the-loop guardrails — with attention to auditability, explainability, and compliance
• Credibly advise senior technical and executive stakeholders on architectural trade-offs, risks, and long-term AI strategy, translating complex technical concepts into business language that demonstrates clear value and informs strategic decision-making
• Develop reference architectures and reusable assets that address financial services patterns — regulatory-compliant RAG, secure agent-to-data connectivity, and real-time decisioning
• Mentor team members and contribute to knowledge sharing within the organization to advance AI adoption and implementation best practices
• Lead thought leadership initiatives and externally represent AWS by evangelizing generative AI capabilities through public speaking at industry events (re:Invent and AWS Summits), publishing technical content (blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures), and sharing best practices with the broader AI/ML community
• Stay current with the latest advancements in generative AI research, AWS service and partner capabilities to improve system performance and recommend optimal technology stacks
• Define and implement evaluation frameworks for AI systems, including model performance benchmarking, output quality assessment, and operational monitoring (AIOps), ensuring deployed solutions meet enterprise reliability and governance standards

A day in the life
You'll join a focused, high-calibre group of specialist Solutions Architects supporting the world's most important financial services customers. The team operates on deeply technical, strategically significant engagements — solving problems that don't have off-the-shelf answers. Day-to-day, you'll:
• Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement generative AI solutions that can transform business outcomes
• Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how generative AI solutions can transform business processes
• Review retrieval, grounding, and agentic orchestration architectures, advising on governance models that satisfy regulators while enabling AI innovation
• Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
• Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AI research and AWS service capabilities
• Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help other SAs understand how to integrate generative AI solutions into customer architectures

About the team
The GFS Specialist Solutions Architect team is dedicated to accelerating generative AI adoption across strategic financial services accounts — including banking, insurance, payments, and capital markets — in North America. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic generative AI projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We value depth, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine desire to help customers succeed. We work at the intersection of frontier AI and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions that meet the rigorous security and compliance standards of the financial services sector.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. AFT builds and operates software, hardware, and processes that run the global network of fulfillment centers that move many billions of units of inventory, employ tens of thousands of people, and ensure that customers get what they want when we promised we would get it to them. We do this by building automated solutions to handle things that technology does well, while relying on people to handle things that humans do well.

descriptionHtml:
*Internship period: January to June 2027

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you interested in global supply chain operations, data, and process improvement? AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL) is seeking a detail-oriented Technical Program Management Intern to join our Business Intelligence team in Singapore. In this role, you'll help complete a major data platform migration, enhance documentation systems, improve data quality across our logistics operations, and support the business intelligence that AWS's global infrastructure supply chain runs on.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead documentation improvement initiatives across the team's reporting estate, building a documentation baseline that includes a dataset catalog, dashboard inventory, and runbooks
- Coordinate and track open migration items across teams, maintaining a named owner and a target date for each item through to completion
- Support the expanding scope and clean-up of data quality metrics spanning transportation, warehousing, and sustainability
- Help build self-serve data quality tooling so teams can answer their own data quality questions across operational domains

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to update and maintain knowledge management systems

You start with the migration tracker: what moved, what is blocked, and who owes the next step. Mid-morning you join the BI team sync, then follow up with the engineers on both sides of the migration to close out open items. Afternoons go deeper: documenting a dataset or dashboard, investigating a data quality issue raised by a stakeholder, or preparing data for an upcoming business review. You end most days having written something down that the team will still use after your internship ends.

AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL) manages a continuously evolving portfolio of shipments through a worldwide supply chain. We deliver the right product at the right time, cost, and place - ensuring our AWS supply chain is reliable. title: Graduate Shift Manager:in Raum Hannover/Bremen/Niedersachsen
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.

Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.
Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.
Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium vor dem Starttermin oder Abschluss innerhalb der letzten 24 Monate
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
- Interesse eine Führungsaufgabe und ein eigenes Team mit Mitarbeitenden aus der ganzen Welt zu übernehmen

- Erfahrung in einer Logistikumgebung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a talented, self-directed Principal Partner Marketing leader to drive joint strategic planning, thought leadership, and demand generation with Global System Integrator (GSI) partners and Business Consulting and Advisory Partners (BCAP) globally.

This is a senior marketing leadership position responsible for developing complex, enterprise-level marketing strategies and enabling the execution of programs that have significant cross-organizational impact and require C-suite level influence with strategic partners.

The role demands deep business knowledge to drive organizational alignment and growth, to establish marketing best practices, and to influence investment priorities across multiple stakeholder groups.
The position requires exceptional judgment in handling ambiguous situations, building consensus across global AWS and partner teams. Successful candidates must have prior experience in marketing and business development, working at a top technology vendor, a global system integrator, or a business consulting and advisory partner, and must use this understanding to align our partners and AWS business objectives.

• Represent complex strategic decisions to senior leadership (SVP level), articulating trade-offs and options with exceptional clarity
• Identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks

The Global Consulting Partner Marketing team serves as the strategic marketing catalyst for AWS's most impactful consulting partners. title: SLP Specialist, Security and Loss Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Security and Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses.

The Security and Loss Prevention Specialist (SLP Specialist) is a key hourly position within Amazon Operations. The SLP Specialist leads the effort to efficiently and effectively protect people, product and data (lives, physical property, equipment, inventory, data, & intellectual property) in a designated building. The SLP Specialist reports to the Security and Loss Prevention Cluster Manager responsible for their geographical area, and aids them in supporting the operational team, and cross functional teams throughout the organization.

Key job responsibilities
* Conduct confidential investigations and prepare prompt written reports of theft, fraud, and critical incidents
* Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement, data protection, physical security infrastructure) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
* Serve as department liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert for site leadership keeping them informed on key issues, strategies, and the department’s performance
* Develop strategies for alarm reduction and conduct system diagnostic for problematic devices by engaging and resolving issues with internal and external partners
* Domestic regional travel up to 25% of the time when applicable.
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).
* This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.


A day in the life
As a SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You will perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, and you contribute to developing mitigating measures to address them. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our fulfillment, logistics and retail operations locations by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems with subject matter experts and external suppliers to maintain their functionality. You will interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

- Experience in security service, loss prevention, asset protection, audit, investigations, law enforcement, risk management, data analytics, inventory control, quality assurance or a related field

title: Software Development Engineer , Leo Regulus
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is bringing satellite internet to 100+ countries — and before we can sell in any of them, an enormous amount of behind-the-scenes checking has to pass: is every customer charged correctly, is tax right for that country's laws, does money move to the right accounts, are the invoices legally valid, does the whole buy-and-activate experience actually work end to end? Today, dozens of teams work through this by hand, one step after another, for months. It's the single biggest thing standing between "we're ready" and "we've launched" — and we're replacing that entire process with AI.

Leo Regulus is an AI-native team building squads of autonomous agents that compress Leo's launch process from months to days. The agents run in parallel, share context across every domain a launch touches — tax, accounting, payments, legal, trade, and commerce — and get smarter with each country we ship. Crucially, we don't do the manual work; we build the agents that do it, and do it better each time. Instead of writing the checks by hand, we build agents that write, run, diagnose, and fix them.

This is a rare kind of problem: real autonomy with real stakes — these agents gate a global product launch — and genuine cross-domain reasoning, because a single launch spans law, finance, payments, and the shopping experience all at once, and the agents have to keep each other in sync. You don't need any background in testing or launch operations; you need to be great at building intelligent systems and excited by agentic AI as the product itself — designing how agents plan, act, check their own work, recover from failure, and learn. If building the AI team that launches satellite internet across the planet — in minutes instead of months — sounds like the most interesting thing you could work on, let's talk.

- Build orchestration systems that coordinate dozens of domain-specific agents working in parallel

A day in the life
An SDE on Leo Regulus will be responsible for designing, building, and operating autonomous AI agent systems that automate the end-to-end ecommerce launch lifecycle — from requirements generation through financial configuration, test execution, and validation — enabling Amazon Leo to scale country and feature launches across 100+ markets without proportional headcount growth.

We are a team building the AI infrastructure that makes Amazon Leo's 100-country launch possible. title: Software Development Manager, AIO Visualization and Reporting
descriptionHtml:
AWS customers commit to billions of dollars of Savings Plans and Reserved Instances to cut their bills by up to 72%. Tens of thousands of Amazon employees use this team's tools to execute those purchases, correct billing information, and keep the commitments accurate. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead the nine engineers who own them.

The scope covers two distinct areas. One is the commitment lifecycle: creating, modifying, and refunding customer commitments, and making sure the resulting numbers are correct everywhere they are reported. The other is the internal billing platform and the authorization service in front of it, which decides who is allowed to see which customer's data, millions of times a month. A senior engineer leads each area, and a product manager works across both, so you will lead through your engineers rather than assigning every task yourself.

The team inherited five services in the space of seven months, each below the bar for operational hygiene. Since then it has cut open security findings by 97%, closed the monitoring gaps that had let a data quality defect run undetected for months, and generally improved operational hygiene. What is left is the interesting work: replacing a deployment pipeline that has become the single biggest tax on the team's velocity, retiring end-of-life frameworks that predate 2015, and building the data auditing that a financial system of this size should have had from the beginning. You will do that while delivering funded commitments the business is counting on, including a new payment method with material financial impact for the business and the automation of a refund process that today runs on spreadsheets and manual safeguards.

There is also a strategic question waiting for whoever takes this role. Today the team maintains the access rules governing who may view customer billing data, and it executes 220+ document-based operating procedures on behalf of Legal, Finance, Sales, and Customer Support. The team owns the tooling but not the policies, which means it absorbs a steady stream of decisions it has no business context to make. Inverting that model is a design problem worth years of leverage, and it is yours to define.

We are looking for somebody to put their stamp on this team and decide what it becomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the charter, roadmap, and multi-year architecture across both areas. Decide what gets built, what gets decommissioned, and in what order.
- Directly hire, coach, and develop engineers from entry level through senior. Two positions are already open, and you will define what they are.
- Delegate component and operational ownership to your senior engineers, and grow them as leaders rather than becoming the decision bottleneck.
- Be accountable for the operational health of financially material services: security posture, deployment health, monitoring, and the audit mechanisms that prove your numbers are right.
- Balance funded business delivery against the modernization the platform needs, and be able to defend that sequencing to senior leadership.
- Represent the team in weekly operational reviews and in your organization's annual planning process.
- Build the relationships that make the work possible, with product management, with the operations teams who use your tools every day, and with partner engineering teams across AWS.

A day in the life
Most days split four ways: unblocking your team, following up on something affecting a customer or an internal operator, hiring and coaching, and thinking past the current quarter. You will spend real time in design reviews and in the details of your systems, because the judgment calls in this space are technical ones. You will also spend real time writing, because the decisions that matter here are argued in documents and reviewed by people several levels above you.


About the team
You will join the AWS Insights organization, which helps customers understand what they spend, forecast what they will spend, optimize the cost of what they run, and get alerted when costs surprise them. This team sits at the financial core of that mission. The work is unusually concrete: when it goes well, customers save money and internal operators stop doing things by hand.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
