title: Data Scientist II, Data Scientist, Decision Science
descriptionHtml:
What will customers want from Amazon Devices one, two, or three years from now? As a Data Scientist II on our Devices forecasting team, you will answer that question by building econometric and machine learning models that project long-term demand, assess the incrementality of new products, and quantify willingness to pay for specific features. Your analysis will directly shape portfolio decisions, helping product managers decide what to build next. This is a team that is investing in AI to accelerate how science informs business strategy, making now a particularly exciting time to join.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and validate econometric and machine learning models that generate long-term demand forecasts for Amazon Devices, selecting the right methodology based on data characteristics and business context.
- Assess the incrementality of new products and quantify willingness to pay for product features, translating model outputs into clear narratives that help product managers adjust their portfolio strategy.
- Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to scope analytical projects, define metrics, and identify the data requirements needed to answer ambiguous forecasting questions.
- Communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences through clear documentation, effective visualizations, and well-structured presentations that drive informed decisions.
- Mentor less experienced data scientists through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and active participation in scientific discussions and team planning.

A day in the life
You might spend your morning refining a demand forecast model, testing how a new product feature variable improves prediction accuracy. After lunch, you could be walking product managers through your incrementality analysis and aligning on what the numbers mean for their roadmap. Later, you might review a teammate's willingness-to-pay study or experiment with an AI-based approach to accelerate your modeling pipeline. Your work moves between deep independent analysis and collaborative sessions where you translate complex results into actionable recommendations.

About the team
Our team owns long-term forecasting and product analytics for Amazon Devices. We build the science that tells the story of where customer demand is headed and what drives it. You will work alongside scientists, engineers, and product managers who value rigorous analysis and practical impact. We are currently expanding our use of AI to accelerate how we deliver insights, and we are looking for people who are curious, collaborative, and ready to help shape that direction.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment

Preferred qualifications

title: Aerospace Transformation Business Dev leader, Auto & Manufacturing Industry Specialists and Solutions
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to join the Industry Specialists team and help build our dedicated Aerospace footprint across EMEA.

In this role, you will own business development for aerospace workloads across the commercial aviation, defense-adjacent, and space value chains — including supply chain optimisation, predictive maintenance and MRO, digital twin and PLM, connected aircraft, and AI/ML for engineering.

You will engage directly with C-suite executives and VPs at leading European airframe OEMs, propulsion suppliers, Tier-1 systems integrators, and MRO providers to translate their most complex operational challenges into cloud-enabled opportunities, build a qualified pipeline, and shape AWS's aerospace-specific go-to-market plays and partner motions.

The ideal candidate will have deep aerospace industry expertise combined with a business development, consulting, or solutions background — with demonstrated experience engaging CxO/VP-level stakeholders at major aerospace companies.

You should understand the tightly coupled aerospace value chain, where product design changes, certification delays, and supply constraints cascade across company boundaries.

This is an individual contributor role for a builder who thrives in ambiguity, can create structure where none exists, and has the ownership and scrappiness to incubate a new segment from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and execute the EMEA aerospace BD strategy aligned with the global OneAWS Aerospace roadmap, identifying priority customer targets, use cases, and partnership opportunities across commercial aviation, defense-adjacent, and space segments.

- Engage C-level and VP stakeholders (CEO, COO, CTO/CIO, VP Engineering, VP Supply Chain, VP MRO, VP Digital) at target European aerospace companies to understand their strategic priorities, build trust, and position AWS as a long-term transformation partner.

- Develop and manage a high-quality business development pipeline by identifying, qualifying, and advancing opportunities across aerospace-specific workloads: supply chain visibility and optimisation, MRO predictive maintenance, digital twin and simulation, PLM modernisation, connected product / IoT, compliance (CMMC/ITAR), and AI/ML for engineering.

- Lead the "Reuse, Adjust, Build" approach for EMEA — leveraging proven Automotive & Manufacturing solutions (digital twin, predictive maintenance, supply chain, IoT) and adapting them for aerospace-specific requirements such as MRO workflows, regulatory compliance (FAA/EASA, CMMC, ITAR/EAR), sovereignty, and aircraft lifecycle management.

- Drive strategic partner motions in EMEA with ISVs and system integrators to create differentiated joint solutions for European aerospace customers.

- Provide thought leadership on aerospace digitisation through executive briefings, industry events (Farnborough, Le Bourget, MRO Europe, Hannover Messe), workshops, and published content — positioning AWS as the aerospace industry provider with production-grade AI deployments and measurable business outcomes.

- Leverage Pan-Amazon proof points (Amazon Leo satellite constellation, Amazon Air fleet operations, Amazon Robotics) to build credibility and demonstrate how AWS technologies solve real-world aerospace challenges at scale.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with AWS field sales (AWSI, AGS), solutions architects, professional services, WWPS (for defense-adjacent workloads), partner teams, and product teams — acting as the single-threaded aerospace specialist who brings coherence across organisational boundaries.

- Serve as the "voice of the customer" internally, synthesising aerospace-specific market trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and customer feedback to influence AWS product and solution development.

A day in the life
No two days look the same in this role — and that's the point. You might spend the morning in Toulouse whiteboarding on how to modernise PLM architecture, and the afternoon on a call with a Tier-1 engine manufacturer's VP of MRO exploring how predictive maintenance could cut unplanned downtime. In between, you're swapping notes with your partner counterpart on a joint MRO workshop you're co-building, or briefing an AWS Solutions Architect on a customer's sovereignty and ITAR constraints before a technical deep-dive.

On any given week, you could find yourself:
- Preparing an executive briefing for a CSCO who wants to understand how AWS can help untangle a multi-tier supply chain visibility problem
- Co-developing an aerospace-specific use case (digital twin, engine health monitoring, connected aircraft) with the SA team to present at MRO Europe or Farnborough
- Reviewing competitive intelligence and drafting a plan leveraging Pan-Amazon proof points

- Running an internal "Aerospace Deep Dive" to educate field sales on why generic manufacturing messaging doesn't land with aerospace customers

- Aligning with the WWPS team on CMMC compliance positioning for a defense-adjacent account

- Updating shared account plans and tagging opportunities in the CRM so the broader team has visibility

- Drafting a 2-pager for leadership on a market signal or a customer win that could shape the GTM playbook

The common thread: you're always at the intersection of deep industry knowledge and cloud technology, building credibility with senior aerospace leaders while creating structure and momentum in a segment AWS is standing up from scratch.

About the team
AWS is building a dedicated Aerospace go-to-market capability within the Industry Specialists organisation. Our approach leverages the deep structural overlap between aerospace and our proven Automotive & Manufacturing solutions portfolio — reusing what works, adjusting for aerospace-specific requirements, and building only where critical gaps exist.

We combine AWS's breadth in AI/ML, IoT, HPC, and sovereign cloud with Pan-Amazon proof points (Leo, Amazon Air, Robotics) and a curated partner community to deliver measurable outcomes — not generic cloud messaging.

If you're energised by the prospect of building a new industry vertical from the ground up, working with some of the world's most iconic aerospace companies, and shaping AWS's position in a market where the next 12–18 months will define competitive positioning for a decade — we'd love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- 8+ years of experience in the aerospace industry — in roles such as business development, management consulting, solution sales, product management, or programme management — spanning one or more of: commercial aviation, defense, space, or MRO.
- Demonstrated track record of engaging and influencing C-level and VP executives at major aerospace companies (OEMs, engine manufacturers, Tier-1 suppliers, or MRO providers).
- Strong understanding of the aerospace value chain and its key operational challenges: supply chain complexity and multi-tier visibility, MRO and predictive maintenance, digital engineering and PLM, regulatory compliance (FAA/EASA, CMMC, ITAR/EAR), and sovereignty requirements.
- Familiarity with enterprise platforms and technologies used in aerospace (e.g. SAP, PTC Windchill, Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE, Siemens Teamcenter, IFS) and how cloud and AI/ML technologies complement or transform them.
- Proven ability to develop and execute market development strategies in complex, matrixed environments that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue results.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building and maintaining C-level client relationships
- MBA or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, or related field.
- Experience with aerospace-specific technologies and concepts: digital twin for aircraft simulation and fleet monitoring, predictive maintenance for engine health and component failure, MRO transformation, HPC for CFD/structural analysis, CMMC/ITAR compliance frameworks, and connected aircraft / IoT.
- Experience working with or for a major aerospace company (e.g. Airbus, Safran, Rolls-Royce, Thales, Leonardo, BAE Systems) or a management consultancy on aerospace transformation engagements (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Roland Berger, Deloitte, Accenture, Capgemini).
- Understanding of the defense-industrial base and its intersection with commercial aerospace — including dual-use technology considerations and cross-sector compliance requirements.
- Track record of evangelising new technologies at aerospace industry events (Farnborough, Le Bourget, MRO Europe, Paris Air Forum, Aeromart).
- Experience incubating new market segments or industry verticals — building go-to-market from zero, not just executing established playbooks.
- Proficiency in French is a strong advantage given the Toulouse/Paris aerospace hub; German, Italian, or Spanish are a plus.
- Willingness to travel across EMEA and occasionally to the US (estimated 30–40%).

title: Applied Scientist, AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about solving complex problems and protecting one of the world’s largest cloud platforms? The AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention team is looking for an innovative Applied Scientist to help keep AWS a safe and trusted environment for millions of customers worldwide.
In this role, you will design, build, and deploy machine learning models that detect, prevent, and mitigate fraudulent activity across the AWS ecosystem. You will work with massive, real-world datasets, develop new detection strategies, and apply advanced and practical technologies to tackle ever-evolving threats. You will also explore Generative AI (GenAI) techniques to uncover new fraud patterns and strengthen our fraud defenses.
At AWS, we support hundreds of thousands of businesses, powering billions of transactions every day. Fraudsters are constantly innovating — and so are we. If you enjoy thinking like a fraudster, building resilient defenses, and making a real-world impact, we invite you to join us and help shape the future of secure cloud computing.

Key job responsibilities
* Design, build, and deploy machine learning models to detect, prevent, and mitigate fraudulent activities across the AWS platform.
* Analyze large-scale behavioral, transactional, and historical datasets to uncover fraud patterns and emerging threats.
* Explore and apply GenAI techniques, including large language models (LLMs), synthetic data generation, and adversarial simulations to enhance fraud detection capabilities.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Experiment, prototype, and iterate on new detection strategies, algorithms, and evaluation metrics.
* Continuously monitor model performance and improve robustness against adversarial behaviors and evolving fraud tactics.
* Communicate findings and technical insights clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Contribute to the broader fraud prevention strategy, driving innovation and best practices across the organization.

About the team
AWS Payments and Fraud Prevent is responsible for detecting & mitigating AWS account risks. You’ll be part of a team of Scientists, Analysts, and Technical & non-Technical Program Managers. The team’s goal is to identify and neutralize fraudsters from unauthorized access to legitimate AWS customers accounts.

We have a formal mentor search application that lets you find a mentor that works best for you. Your manager can also help you find a mentor or two, because two is better than one. In addition to formal mentors, we work and train together so that we are always learning from one another, and we celebrate and support the career progression of our team members.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in fraud detection, cybersecurity, anomaly detection, risk modeling, or adversarial machine learning.
- Hands-on experience applying GenAI techniques such as synthetic data generation, adversarial simulation, or large language model (LLM) insights.

title: Senior Data Center Electrical Engineer , Mechanical Products and Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you passionate about designing and optimizing the critical systems that power some of the world's largest and most reliable infrastructure? As a Senior Data Center Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of data center infrastructure systems. Your work will directly influence the availability and efficiency of the physical backbone that supports millions of customers worldwide.

In this role, you will tackle complex, ambiguous problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, influence facility strategy, and set standards for engineering excellence. Whether you are leading the design of new infrastructure systems or resolving root causes of endemic issues, your contributions will have a meaningful, long-term impact on how Amazon builds and operates its data centers.

Key job responsibilities
• Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers.
• Lead the electrical aspect of new product design and development for mechanical cooling equipment, including motor controls, VFDs, power distribution panels, control wiring, and instrumentation integration.
• Collaborate with other disciplines such as mechanical engineering, structural engineering, controls/automation, reliability, QA/QC, and compliance to create well-thought-out products.
• Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes.
• Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements while delivering a return on investment.
• Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical components, devices, and bill of materials for AHUs, skids, and ADACs.
• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries, including UL, CE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, and other applicable standards for mechanical cooling equipment.
• Prepare, review, and approve product design and drawings including electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, and bill of materials.
• Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.
• Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly set up test processes and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems within mechanical cooling products.
• Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.
• Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
• Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment.
• Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
• Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing design documents for a new infrastructure deployment, providing feedback that strengthens the overall architecture. By midday, you could be leading a cross-team project review, aligning engineers across regions on a shared technical approach. In the afternoon, you may dive into root-cause analysis of a recurring facility issue, proposing a mechanism to prevent future occurrences. Throughout it all, you will coach teammates, share expertise, and help shape the direction of critical infrastructure at Amazon.

About the team
Our team is focused on ensuring that Amazon's data center infrastructure is reliable, efficient, and ready to meet the demands of tomorrow. We work at the intersection of electrical engineering, mechanical systems, and operational technology to design and maintain the physical environments that support Amazon's global services.

We value collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement. If you are excited about working on large-scale infrastructure challenges alongside a talented group of engineers, we would love to hear from you.

Preferred qualifications

title: Learning Specialist, EU E2E Learning, Central Programs
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to shape how hundreds of people learn, grow, and do their best work? As our Learning Specialist, you won't just build training, you'll own the strategy behind it: designing, governing, and optimizing the learning ecosystem across multiple functions, solving real business problems, and designing learning that scales across teams and countries.

This is a role for someone who loves both the creative side of learning and the rigor of getting things done. You'll independently lead complex learning programs from idea to launch, design scalable solutions to problems where the answer isn't obvious yet, and partner with senior leaders to turn business priorities into learning that actually moves the needle. You'll set the "what" and the "how" that our Learning Coordinators bring to life, and you'll raise the bar on our methodology and standards along the way.

If you're energized by continuous improvement, comfortable managing multiple projects at once, and motivated by seeing measurable capability lift across an organization, you'll thrive here. You'll join a team that cares deeply about the learner experience, champions innovation, and gives you the autonomy to make a real, lasting impact.

Beyond the day-to-day, there's plenty of room to stretch. You might pilot how AI can transform the way we design and deliver learning, represent the team in cross-European initiatives, take the lead on org-wide programs, or mentor and shape the next generation of learning talent. If you bring the curiosity and the drive, this role will keep giving you bigger problems to solve.

Key job responsibilities
KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Learning Design & Program Management
- Own the full ADDIE lifecycle for assigned functions, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and delivering high-quality training content.
- Apply expertise in adult learning theories and instructional design to solve complex learning problems where the problem is understood but the solution is not.
- Design and implement innovative learning solutions across multiple modalities (digital, classroom, experiential, self-paced, blended).
- Plan, launch, and manage end-to-end learning programs, owning scope, timelines, milestones, risks, and deliverables from concept to rollout.
- Manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities, keeping stakeholders informed with clear status, ETAs, and success metrics.
- Provide support and mentoring to Learning Coordinators across ES and UK.

Project Management & Delivery

- Lead learning projects using structured project management practices (planning, RACI, dependency and risk management, stakeholder communication, and delivery tracking).
- Maintain project governance mechanisms (trackers, dashboards, and reporting cadences) to ensure visibility and on-time delivery.
- Anticipate blockers and dependencies, build contingency plans, and drive projects to closure with clear owners and deadlines.

Continuous Improvement

- Apply continuous improvement methodologies to raise the quality and efficiency of learning programs and processes.
- Establish feedback loops (surveys, focus groups, defect and performance data) to systematically identify opportunities and implement improvement actions.
- Use data to prioritize improvements, define success metrics, and measure impact, driving measurable gains in learner experience and business outcomes.
- Standardize and document processes (SOPs, templates, reusable frameworks) to ensure sustainability and scalability.

Standards Ownership

- Own and evolve training standards, ensuring consistent quality across the learning ecosystem.
- Create engaging content that drives participant retention and knowledge application.
- Embed instructional design best practices and quality controls (e.g. Bloom's Taxonomy, Kirkpatrick evaluation) as the baseline for quality audits.

Stakeholder Partnership

- Act as the strategic learning partner to function leaders, translating business priorities into learning roadmaps.
- Partner with org-level stakeholders to secure resources, scope efforts, set priorities, and drive delivery.
- Work with partners across Europe to ensure alignment with best practices, processes, and technology.
- Lead change management for new programs and process changes, ensuring smooth adoption across teams.

Data-Driven Governance

- Define learning metrics and conduct Training Needs Analysis to identify knowledge gaps.
- Develop evaluation methods to measure training effectiveness and present insights and recommendations to leadership.
- Monitor program performance against targets, report trends, and translate data into action.

A day in the life
No two days look the same on the EU E2E Learning team, Central Programs, and that's part of the fun. One moment you're digging into program metrics, spotting a dip in a function's training scores and designing a scalable new module to close the gap; the next you're partnering with a function leader to turn a business priority into a learning roadmap. You'll mentor Learning Coordinators across ES and UK to bring your programs to life, jump between multiple projects, and get ahead of risks before they become blockers. AI is part of how you work every day: you'll use it to design content faster, analyze feedback and performance data for insights, evaluate learning objectives against business needs, and pilot new formats like interactive simulations and audio guides that make learning stick. Along the way you'll apply continuous improvement thinking to make the team a little faster and better every quarter, and you'll turn data into a clear story of impact for leadership. Some days you'll be deep in creative design work, others you'll be influencing senior stakeholders or championing how AI can transform the way our whole team learns and delivers. If you love that mix of creative design, strategic influence, hands-on delivery, and relentless improvement, this is the kind of day you'll look forward to.

About the team
The EU E2E Learning, Central Programs team is the learning and development engine for central functions across all three miles (first, middle, and last). We own the end-to-end learning journey, from Day 1 onboarding for new joiners through continuous development for tenured employees, so every person we support is ready to deliver from day one and keeps growing in their role. Alongside this, we set and evolve learning standards, audit standard operating procedures, and measure training effectiveness, all with a data-driven, continuous improvement mindset (increasingly powered by AI) to raise the bar on the learner experience and scale our impact across the central functions we serve.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Supply Chain, Economics or Business Administration
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience managing training/learning related projects or programs
- Experience in formulating and implementing training strategies, policies, and procedures for standardisation and delivery of training methodology throughout the organisation

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience with instructional design, curriculum architecture, or training program development

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Amazon Connect
descriptionHtml:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Amazon Connect is a highly disruptive cloud-based contact center that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. Amazon Connect is the result of the ten years of development that went into building the tools Amazon uses to provide its award winning customer service at massive scale and launching it as a publicly available AWS service. With Amazon Connect, you can create your own cloud-based contact center and be taking calls in minutes. Amazon Connect leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence and the large ecosystem of AWS services such as Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3 and Amazon Kinesis to provide a truly frustration free, easy-to-use, extensible, and natural customer experience. With this technology, we are transforming an industry and the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them.
See our section in Andy Jassy 2020 re:Invent keynote

We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems. We are looking for passionate and talented Technical Program Manager to join us to innovate on this new service that addresses customer needs to build modern contact centers in the cloud. The position represents a rare opportunity to be a part of a fast-growing business soon after launch, and help shape the technology and product as we grow. You will be playing a crucial role in developing the next generation contact center, and get the opportunity to design and deliver scaleable, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

We are looking for a highly effective Senior Technical Program Manager that can lead a team to quickly design and deliver systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

The Technical Program Manager for this team needs a sound understanding of the fundamentals of communications and practical experience building large-scale distributed systems. If you become the Senior Technical Program Manager, you will work with design, technical, and business leaders to set strategy and define the product. You will drive, track, and report the development effort to leadership and partners. You will define the engagement model and manage internal/external dependencies and relationships. You will be key leader responsible for delivering the distributed systems and analytics that will enable AWS to continue changing the software industry by delivering more capabilities to more customers.

title: Electrical Engineer, Amazon Leo Optical Inter-Satellite Link
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

The Electrical Engineer will be a member of Amazon Leo's Inter-Satellite Link Avionics team, focusing on the design of electrical functions including analog sensor signal conditioning and processing, motor and actuator control, embedded digital electronics, power regulation, and overall monitoring and control across spacecraft interfaces.

title: Senior Design Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Customers choose us to create cloud solutions that solve challenges that were unimaginable a short time ago—even yesterday. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world.

In this role, you will develop automation to enable physical design teams to execute Package and PCB products from floor planning through tape out and manufacturing release, working closely with senior engineers, SI/PI, thermal, and manufacturing teams to deliver production-ready designs that meet performance, density, and reliability targets.

• Develop and deploy efficient design methodologies to support Package and PCB layout tasks across the design cycle: die floor planning, bump/pad assignment, RDL routing, substrate design, verification, and tape out release.

Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. OTS provides 24x7 global IT support to Amazon Operations, including Fulfillment, Sortation, Logistics, and Last Mile. Together, we take ownership for what we do — whether supporting IT infrastructure, developing new technology in-house, launching a new Amazon Fulfillment Center, or delighting our customers by delivering packages directly to them.

When we hire you at Amazon, we hire for the future. With unlimited career opportunities, Amazon invests in ensuring our teams are consistently inspired, constantly learning from each other, and are creatively contributing to our next big idea. You will be surrounded by the best innovators of our time. We value diversity! See why diversity is important to us at amazon.com/diversity. We are looking for self-motivated individuals to take on new challenges and motivate teams in fostering solutions to the hurdles we face. Your role as a leader will be to confront obstacles others avoid and create a team that embodies our leadership principles.

About The Role
You will be leading a team of IT professionals with various skill sets to provide truly innovative technical support to Amazon’s Operations team who fulfill our customer promises millions of times a day. The technology varies between our different facilities, but Amazon’s core IT infrastructure is fully redundant and relies upon top tier vendor hardware networked over fiber optic, copper, and wireless topologies. Your internal customers, whether human, robotic, or mechanical, use mobile computing devices, thin clients, integrated computer, and PCs running Windows, Linux, and Android operating systems to virtually and physically move e-commerce items from our suppliers into our fulfillment centers shelves, from those shelves into packaging, those packages into cars, trucks, and airplanes for delivery to front doors around the world.

• Develop and maintain policies, procedures, and processes.
• Oversee management of equipment and parts inventory.

descriptionHtml:
RBS (Retail Business Services) Tech team works towards enhancing the customer experience (CX) and their trust in product data by providing technologies to find and fix Amazon CX defects at scale. Our platforms help in improving the CX in all phases of customer journey, including selection, discoverability & fulfilment, buying experience and post-buying experience (product quality and customer returns). descriptionHtml:

Amazon Transportation Services(ATS)部門の輸送オペレーションセンターでは、年間数億にのぼる商品を、お客様とお約束したお届け日時を正確に守るため、幹線輸送ネットワークを管理・運営しております。
お客様との約束通り商品を適時お届けすることは、当社サービスの基盤となっていますが、ECの普及などに伴い、物流・小売業界環境は変化し、競争が激化する一方で、国内の物流需要と供給のバランスは厳しさを増しています。
このような中で、サービス品質の向上は不可欠な課題となっています。
今回、全国規模の倉庫と配送拠点を結ぶ幹線物流の管理運営部門であるRelay Operation Center(ROC)のうち、キャパシティコントロールについてオペレーション・業務改善を行うOps-Capacity Procurement（OCP）メンバーを募集いたします。
Ops-Capacity Procurement（OCP）チームは、ROCの中において幹線輸送の発注、キャパシティコントロール、緊急増便におけるオペレーションプロセスを確立、正確性を担保しお客様の信頼を維持しながらコストを最小化し、Amazonに収益性をもたらす役割を担っています。

今回募集する物量管理スペシャリストは、Amazonの貨物に対する集車率を増加させ、Network全体での配送物量最大化を目的としています。具体的には発注された台数に対して適切なキャパシティコントロールを行い、お客様へのお届け予定日のお約束を守る事と出荷物量の最大化を両立するために、Last mile Teamと連携して業務フローの整理・実行を行います。
全国規模のネットワークを俯瞰的かつ最適な視点から業務を管理頂ける方を募集いたします。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

title: Area Manager / Kierownik obszaru
descriptionHtml:
Dział operacyjny to serce firmy Amazon. Ten kluczowy segment naszej działalności zapewnia, że realizujemy i wysyłamy zamówienia w sposób efektywny, dzięki czemu nasi klienci otrzymują swoje zakupy na czas. Osoba na stanowisku Area Manager dokłada wszelkich starań, aby centrum logistyczne, w którym pracuje działało sprawnie, co pozwala nam wychodzić naprzeciw oczekiwaniom klientów. Kieruje zespołem, który troszczy się o zachowanie bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i wysokiej jakości naszych działań, a także podejmuje się realizacji wielu projektów w całej naszej sieci, mających na celu zwiększenie wydajności.

Key job responsibilities
- Tworzenie, nadzorowanie i promowanie kultury bezpieczeństwa i zadowolenia z pracy
- Analizowanie i wdrażanie modyfikacji w celu zapewnienia jakości i wydajności na stałym, wysokim poziomie
- Nadzorowanie projektów mających na celu usprawnienie procesów, optymalizację wydajności i podniesienie jakości usług dla klientów w obrębie swojego obszaru odpowiedzialności
- Analizowanie wydajności zmiany w stosunku do stosownych celów biznesowych i wprowadzanie działań mających na celu osiągnięcie doskonałości operacyjnej
- Współpraca z innymi managerami w celu standaryzacji procesów na zmianach

A day in the life
Osoba na tym stanowisku pracuje w systemie zmianowym w jednym z naszych centrów logistycznych, zapewniając jego najwyższą możliwą wydajność. Głównym zadaniem Area Managera jest kierowanie i napędzanie kultury bezpieczeństwa oraz utrzymywanie jakości i standardów wydajności na zmianach. Area Manager nadzoruje również usprawnienia procesów w swoim obszarze i napędza ich wdrażanie. Typowy dzień jest tutaj niezwykle zróżnicowany i obejmuje rozmaite czynności, od rutynowego zarządzania zespołem i codziennych obowiązków operacyjnych, po doskonalenie procesów i szeroko zakrojone zadania operacyjne w sytuacjach awaryjnych. Osoba ta jest również mentorem dla nowych managerów.




About the team
Centrum logistyczne to miejsce, w którym firma Amazon stawiała swoje pierwsze kroki. Ze skromnego zespołu sprzedawców książek przekształciło się ono w wysokorozwiniętą korporację o zasięgu ogólnoświatowym, która każdego dnia obsługuje ponad 1,5 miliona zamówień. Osoby pracujące w centrach logistycznych stanowią fundament naszej działalności, a ich wysiłki pomagają nam w ekspansji naszej firmy na nowe rejony oraz w rozszerzeniu wachlarza świadczonych przez nas usług. Korzystając z najnowszych technologii, stale poszukujemy sposobów na zwiększenie i udoskonalenie gamy oferowanych przez nas produktów – dostarczanych szybko i tanio.
Nasze zespoły w centrach logistycznych są pierwszym ogniwem w łańcuchu dostaw przyczyniającym się do realizacji zamówień klientów w tempie, z którego tak słyniemy. Pracujemy w centrach logistycznych, które stanowią serce prężnej sieci operacyjnej firmy Amazon i określane są niekiedy jako „pierwszy kilometr”, ponieważ to właśnie tutaj większość przesyłek rozpoczyna swoją podróż. Pomagamy również zarządzać dynamicznie zmieniającymi się składami magazynowymi i umożliwiamy realizację szybkich dostaw 24 godziny na dobę.
W naszych centrach logistycznych pracuje wiele różnych osób, bo oferujemy perspektywy dla osób o każdym poziomie umiejętności i wykształcenia. Niektórzy z nas zajmują się bezpośrednio towarami, inni analizują dane, pomagając wszystkim w firmie w podejmowaniu trafnych decyzji.

Basic qualifications

- Wykształcenie wyższe
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w kierowaniu zespołem
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w komunikacji z szerokim gronem partnerów biznesowych, w tym ze współpracownikami i z przełożonymi
- Umiejętność wykorzystywania danych analitycznych i empirycznych do podejmowania decyzji i rozwiązywania problemów
- Biegła znajomość języka angielskiego i polskiego w mowie i piśmie

Preferred qualifications

- Preferowane kwalifikacje nie są wymagane do starania się o stanowisko w Amazon. Z przyjemnością zapoznamy się z kandydaturą osób, które posiadają wszystkie wyżej wymienione kwalifikacje podstawowe.
- Doświadczenie z narzędziami Lean, Six Sigma i technikami Kaizen
- Doświadczenie nabyte w innym środowisku logistycznym
- Odpowiednia znajomość pakietu MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

title: Business Dev Manager, Performance Marketing, IN PLX, IN Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

We are looking for a Business Development Manager to own end-to-end strategy and execution for three new verticals under the Associates program: AI Content, Shoppable Media and Monetization. This is a charter-building role. You will take these verticals from 1 to 10, partnering with cross-functional teams inside Amazon and influencing CXO-level stakeholders at India's top publishers to build Amazon's distributed commerce engine.

This role is part of the Amazon India Performance Marketing team.

What Makes This Role Exciting

You will build, not just manage. Shoppable Media, AI Content, and Monetization are new verticals with significant potential. You will define the strategy, build the partnerships, and shape how Amazon India approaches distributed commerce.

You will operate at the intersection of media, commerce, and AI. This is one of the few roles where you get to work across publisher CXOs, Amazon Ads leadership, WW product teams, and Retail category heads, all in service of building something new.

The charter is real and the ambition is high. You are joining a team that is taking new verticals from 1 to 10 through strategy, meticulous execution, and fast experimentation. The opportunity to shape what comes next is wide open.

Who You Are

You have deep knowledge of India's digital media landscape, publisher business models, and content monetization trends. You know the key players and how deals get done.

You have a track record of building partnerships or programs from the ground up, not just managing existing ones. You are comfortable with ambiguity and move fast through it.

You think strategically about long-term business trends while staying grounded in meticulous execution. You can see where the market is heading and build plans to get there.

You bring analytical rigor to decision-making. You can build compelling, data-backed value propositions and use numbers to tell a story.

You are effective at influencing without authority, working cross-organizationally across product, category, ads, and leadership teams to build alignment and drive outcomes.

You are willing to roll up your sleeves and operate with limited guidance. You bring curiosity, commercial instincts, and strong business judgment.

Key job responsibilities
Own the strategy for AI Content development and Shoppable Media. You will set the direction, build the playbook, and drive execution through fast experimentation.

Build acquisition engine for Shoppable Media by partnering with India's largest Media and Lifestyle publishers. Define the value proposition, lead CXO-level conversations, and close partnerships that scale.

Partner with Ads, Category, and Finance stakeholders to build strong processes that scale monetization across Sponsored Products, Amazon Ads, and Co-op programs.

Develop and drive monthly, quarterly, annual, and long-term content acquisition objectives through Media and Lifestyle publishers. Own growth targets and path to get there.

Accelerate adoption of Amazon Storefronts and supporting tools - Advertising APIs, education resources, Automated Product Tagging and reporting to power AI and Shoppable Media at scale.

Work closely with leadership and World-wide product teams to inform the product roadmap, providing structured feedback on product requirements grounded in publisher and creator needs.

Bring industry insights, trends, and Voice of Customer into every decision. Partner with the Research and Insights team to build an outside-in view that shapes strategy and investment priorities.

Partner with Marketing, Ads, and Retail category leaders to support strategic Amazon businesses and unlock cross-functional growth.

About the team
Amazon Associates program sits at the intersection of customer intent and commerce, connecting shoppers with products through a large partner network of publishers and associates. The program is a core pillar of Amazon India's performance marketing engine.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience
- 3+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
- Experience in setting up and managing a sales pipeline
- Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
- Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in online advertising or high-tech products/services

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.
Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

This is a night shift/overnight role: It will require working overnight hours between approximately 6pm-8am. Work schedule may not be a standard 40hr work week. Specific days and hours may vary depending on specific site and/or schedule needs.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
-Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, and carrying out routine network, server hardware, and operating system repairs to contribute to the overall availability of AWS services
-Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
-Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
-Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
-Helping to interview, train and onboard new team members

Physical Requirements:
-Lifting and moving material up to 40 pounds each
-Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
-Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
-Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
-Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

Work in an industrial environment
-Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).
-This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
-Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
-Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
-Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they:

-Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
-Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
-Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
-Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
-Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support
-Improve effectiveness through process innovation

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting experience, or experience related IT
- 2+ years of computer layer 1/2 networking (including troubleshooting and repair) experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of network design, protocols and troubleshooting
- Knowledge of Linux/Unix Administration
- Bachelor's degree in an IT-related field (e.g., Computer Science, Network Engineering), or experience in professional or military IT-related roles
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment

title: Principal Program Manager, Whole Foods Market Central Kitchen Strategy, Whole Foods Market Culinary Merchandising
descriptionHtml:
Whole Foods Market is seeking a Principal Program Manager to help shape the future of how we produce freshly prepared food in centralized commissary kitchens. This is a strategic, senior role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and can define strategy where little exists today. Working across Amazon VP organizations and with senior leadership at WFM and Amazon, you will lead a significant, complex initiative from concept through execution, building the business case, aligning stakeholders, and standing up the mechanisms needed to deliver. The ideal candidate pairs deep strategic program management experience with a strong understanding of food service, kitchen production, supply chain, food safety, and multi-unit retail operations, and can influence and align senior leaders across culinary merchandising, supply chain, operations, finance, and technology.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for a significant, complex initiative, driving clarity where the business problem and strategy are not yet fully defined.
- Build out business cases and financial plans, framing capital, operational, and strategic tradeoffs for senior leaders and grounding recommendations in data.
- Partner across merchandising, supply chain, operations, quality assurance and food safety, finance, technology, and other functional teams to align the organization on a coherent operating model and clear ownership.
- Establish the planning, forecasting, and performance mechanisms needed to run the program and measure its success.
- Design and launch pilots to validate our strategy, including clear learning plans, and create the stage gates that govern how and when the program scales.
- Prepare and drive executive-ready reviews, business cases, and PR/FAQ and narrative documents, representing complex decisions and tradeoffs clearly to VPs and, when needed, SVPs.
- Identify and mitigate program risks, building in the redundancy and contingency needed to protect continuity of service to stores and customers.
- Actively develop the program management community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and best-practice sharing.
- Travel Requirements: Approximately 30% travel to facilities, stores, and partner sites may be required.

About the team
Our team is at the heart of transforming how customers experience fresh, prepared food at Whole Foods Market and Worldwide Grocery Stores. We set the category strategy and define production models that shape what lands on shelves and in shopping baskets across hundreds of stores nationwide. We work at the intersection of food, data, operations, and retail, partnering closely with supply chain, private brands, operations, e-commerce, finance, and technology to bring innovative, high-quality food programs to life. Our culture rewards curiosity, deep ownership, and creative problem-solving. If you are energized by building something new that directly shapes what customers eat every day, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of program or project management experience
- 7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience owning program strategy and end to end delivery
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Experience in food production
- Deep knowledge of food production and kitchen operations, supply chain and distribution, and the associated food safety and regulatory controls.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience delivering projects within scope, time, budget and quality
- MBA
- Experience working in a physical store
- Experience designing or scaling fresh food production and distribution networks.
- Working knowledge of food safety systems (HACCP), allergen and labeling requirements, and quality assurance at scale.

descriptionHtml:
This position requires in-role training at an operating site which will be up to 10 weeks in duration.

This training will be located 50+ miles away from the home site location. All travel accommodations for training will be booked and paid for by Amazon

Please note: this role requires open flexibility to work 10 hour overnight shifts (late afternoon to early morning hours) and will be scheduled on a front-half (Sunday – Wednesday) or back-half (Wednesday – Saturday) schedule. Shifts will be assigned upon starting in the role and could be subject to change based upon business need.


ABOUT AMAZON

Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly employees and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Rapid and Rural Logistics (R2L) is an exciting organization within Amazon specializing in delighting our customers with speed in which we can make items appear on their doorsteps. Rural Super Rural (RSR) is a subset of R2L, dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to continually strive to innovate the last mile delivery process while bringing smiles to our customer’s faces. Come build the future with us!

Key job responsibilities
- Support, mentor, and motivate your team
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Ops Integration, Loss Prevention and Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, as well as continuously climb and descend stairs
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments, and grocery locations include refrigerated environments)
- Work a flexible schedule (weekends and/or overnight shifts)

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience

title: Senior Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician
descriptionHtml:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. In this role, you’ll pay close attention to our processes to help maintain our high standards, and you’ll put in place upgrades to take that standard even higher.

Key job responsibilities
• Demonstrate best practice on using equipment safely and monitor teams to ensure everyone follows the correct processes
• Keep track of equipment performance through visual checks, condition-based monitoring, and preventative maintenance tasks and schedule additional servicing when required
• Supervise technicians on shift to support their development and act as the first point of contact for Reliability Maintenance Engineers
• Solve issues in equipment to reduce downtime for operations so they can process packages as quickly as possible
• Support in finding ways to continually improve systems and standardise processes across the EU network


A day in the life
In every shift, you’ll be leading a team to make sure everyone has the equipment they need and that it’s running properly. That involves monitoring processes so that regulations and policies are followed and ensuring that preventative maintenance is carried out to increase equipment uptime.

With everything you observe on your shifts, you’ll suggest improvements to make our systems more efficient and productive and then implement those improvements across an EU-wide function. You’ll also be monitoring processes with tools like Scada to guarantee their performance, as well as working closely with your line manager to assist with admin tasks.

This role is located at one of our operational sites. You’ll work shift patterns, which may include some weekends and nights. As you develop your experience within this exciting part of Amazon, you’ll be well-placed to progress into more senior roles.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or cutting-edge tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- NVQ Level 3 in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics, or completed a 4-year UK certified apprenticeship
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Experience in electrical or mechanical engineering
- Experience in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments, or experience in similar environments
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience leading engineering teams as a mentor or tech lead

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic maintenance
- Experience of multi-contractor management
- Experience with PLC-controlled automation
- Experience working with CMMS software, or experience in planning, scheduling and auditing maintenance activities
- Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering (any domain), Operations, Business Administration, or a related field

title: Logistics Supervisor, AMZL
descriptionHtml:

First and foremost, support the overall, daily management of operational duties. This will mean deputizing for the Shift Manager, as and when required: you’ll step in on their behalf where necessary.
You will be expected to prioritize and continually improve the safety at the delivery station. You will be supervising logistics assistants, coordinators and delivery associates to ensure that every shipment is delivered meeting and exceeding the set operational KPIs.
You will be monitoring the coordinator and associate performance and coaching them when needed, partnering with supporting departments to improve logistics processes and operations, communicating with our delivery service providers to set our expectations and raise the bar on quality on their deliverables.

title: Senior Software Development Manager, AWS Global Bill Generation
descriptionHtml:
AWS Bill Generation (BillGen) converts over 20 petabytes of metering data into billions of dollars of revenue every month, running the billing system for one of the largest hyperscalers on the planet. We're looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead our ~40-person Bill Run Orchestration organization within BillGen. The Orchestration organization's mission is to transform AWS bill run from a batch-based process to a fully autonomous real-time streaming process, while ensuring accurate, timely, and clear bills for customers.

The role is technically challenging with elements of scale, precision, and speed. Millions of customers, a global footprint, per-second billing. Customers demand penny-level precision. Real-time billing is critical for GenAI cost control. How do you recompute a customer's entire billing state in minutes when a single retroactive pricing change cascades across months of usage data? How do you orchestrate 21 million accounts through a computation pipeline where a single misrouted event can have customer-visible impact? In this role, you will own end-to-end bill run execution across all AWS partitions, drive the technical vision for autonomous billing operations, and build the team that ensures every customer receives an accurate cost estimate in minutes and an accurate bill on time, every month. You'll lead the migration from reactive war rooms to intelligent agents that detect, diagnose, and resolve issues before customers notice.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow a multi-team organization of engineers and engineering managers, building an inclusive culture of operational rigor and accountability.
- Own the end-to-end reliability of bill run execution across all AWS partitions, from scheduling through computation, validation, and artifact delivery, driving the transformation from batch-based monthly processing to continuous, real-time operations.
- Define and execute the long-term technical strategy for the orchestration platform, leveraging distributed systems, AWS Step Functions, Lambda, AgentCore, and DDB to build autonomous capabilities that detect, diagnose, and remediate billing anomalies before customers are impacted.
- Inspect and audit architectural decisions and operational processes using data-driven methods, identifying systemic risks and driving changes that prevent recurrence of issues across large-scale billing events.
- Partner with other AWS organizations to drive resolution across organizational boundaries, and represent the team in senior leadership reviews and cross-organization forums.

A day in the life
Your morning might start by reviewing operational dashboards for overnight bill runs across global partitions, then joining a stand-up with your engineering managers to triage any anomalies flagged by your automated detection systems. Later, you could be deep in a design review for the next phase of the real-time billing migration, working alongside principal engineers to evaluate trade-offs in the orchestration pipeline. You will also develop a deep understanding of AWS billing systems and how AWS prices its services at scale, building expertise that opens doors to broader leadership opportunities across the billing and pricing domain.

About the team
AWS Bill Generation (BillGen) turns every AWS customer's usage into accurate, timely bills. Within BillGen, the Bill Run Orchestration organization owns the scheduling, sequencing, monitoring, and delivery of billing artifacts across all AWS partitions globally. We detect, diagnose, and fix billing issues, and increasingly build systems that do this autonomously.

We're transforming from monthly batch processing and manual war rooms to continuous billing, autonomous agents, and self-healing infrastructure. We believe operational burden is a technical problem, not a staffing problem. Distributed across {ADDRESS}, {ADDRESS}, and {ADDRESS}, we value automation over heroics and shipping over perfecting.

- 5+ years of engineering team management experience
- 10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience

- Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications

We're building the autonomous system that decides what every satellite in our constellation does, when it does it, and how it recovers when something goes wrong — all without a human in the loop for routine operations. This isn't about building another web service; it's about creating software that continuously manages an entire fleet of satellites at scale, making critical decisions under real physical constraints.

This Senior role offers a rare combination: the depth of hard systems problems — planning and scheduling under physical constraints, coordinating across a large fleet, designing safeguards you have to trust with spacecraft — alongside the ownership that comes with a small team and an expanding charter. Because the constellation and its software are both still growing, the architecture decisions you make now will run for the life of the fleet, and your work connects directly to delivering reliable broadband to people who don't have it today.

A day in the life
You start the day with your team, aligning on what's shipping and where you can unblock each other. You work closely with operators and mission teams, watching how they handle tricky situations, spotting patterns, and turning them into automation. You'll also take turns supporting the systems you build, which keeps you close to how they behave in the real world.

About the team
Our mission is to operate a satellite constellation autonomously. We're building software that changes how satellites are managed: the ground sets the intent and guardrails, and the system schedules work, coordinates across the fleet, and recovers from faults on its own — with people supervising outcomes instead of issuing commands one at a time.

We're a small team with a large and expanding charter, which means engineers here have real influence over architecture and direction. We care about operational excellence, clear thinking, and building systems we can trust with spacecraft. You'll collaborate closely with operations, mission planning, and hardware teams, and you'll see your work make a direct difference for customers who don't have reliable broadband today.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Lambda
descriptionHtml:
Serverless technologies are dramatically changing the business landscape for AWS customers large and small. AWS Lambda changed how the world builds software. Developers write code, and Lambda runs it: no servers to provision or patch, and no capacity to plan. Every month, Lambda runs trillions of invocations for millions of customers, from startups to the largest enterprises. It powers web backends, APIs, data pipelines, event-driven apps, and AI agents.

We're looking for experienced engineers to help lead our global-scale Lambda data plane. The data plane is the set of distributed systems that receive, route, place, scale, and run every function invocation. It has to be fast, secure, and highly available at huge scale. We're also taking serverless into new areas. That includes new compute options like Lambda Managed Instances, first-class support for web applications, and richer ways to process events at scale. As a senior engineer, you'll set the technical direction for these capabilities and turn it into production systems. A successful team member will exhibit creativity, empathy, and optimism as we push the boundaries of serverless computing in the cloud. We are inspired by what has come before and motivated to create what comes next.

You'll thrive in this role if you are interested in large scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems, low latency request processing, and p100 anomalies. You are capable in one or more programming languages and open to learning new ones. You include customer experience when discussing engineering alternatives and value creating APIs that make "the right thing, the easy thing." You value operational sustainability and advocate for eliminating flaky tests as soon as possible. You also think having fun goes together with tackling hard problems like supercomputing, high availability, and building loosely coupled gRPC-based microservices, all while continuing to securely and reliably handle massive traffic with millisecond latency.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the architecture and design of large-scale, highly available, low-latency data plane systems that handle customer traffic across AWS Regions
- Set technical direction across teams, balancing near-term delivery with long-term architecture, and influence the Lambda roadmap
- Own complex, ambiguous problems end to end, from customer need to design, implementation, deployment, and operations
- Drive major improvements in invoke latency, scaling speed, efficiency, security, and resilience
- Help define and deliver new serverless compute experiences for web, event-driven, and instance-based workloads
- Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, and raise the engineering bar across the organization
- Lead operational excellence: set standards for observability, deployment safety, and incident response, and drive lasting fixes
- Work with product managers, engineering leaders, and partner AWS teams to deliver results for customers

A day in the life
You might start the day leading a design review for a new scaling mechanism, spend the afternoon digging into a tail-latency problem across the invoke path, and wrap up mentoring an engineer through their first major design document. You'll work directly with customer feedback and production metrics, and your decisions will shape how Lambda evolves over the next several years.


About the team
AWS Lambda is part of AWS Serverless Compute. The Lambda data plane teams own the core invoke path, the worker fleet and virtualization layer, scaling and placement, event processing, and new compute models such as Lambda Managed Instances. We value ownership, operational excellence, and simplicity, and we invest in growing engineers at every level.
