title: Principal Global Account Manager - IT/ITeS Industry, AGS-APJ-India-ITS
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to own the global cloud relationship with one of the world's largest System Integrators and drive its transformation on AWS? AWS is seeking a Principal Account Manager to serve as the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI, owning AWS revenue and adoption across the customer's worldwide operations.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

As the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI, you will own the end-to-end global sales relationship with a customer that operates across dozens of countries and hundreds of thousands of employees. This is a role for a leader with roughly twenty years of experience who can operate at the highest level of ownership, set global account strategy, and orchestrate a large, distributed virtual team across geographies. You will be the single global owner of the account, aligning regional sellers across NAMER, EMEA, and India, and driving AWS adoption across the customer's internal platforms, engineering environments, and lines of business. You will engage the customer's most senior executives, define a multi-year global strategy, structure the largest and most complex commercial constructs, and represent the voice of the customer inside AWS to shape product roadmaps and investment priorities. Success is measured by global revenue growth, consumption, and the depth of AWS's strategic position within the account worldwide.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the Global Account Strategy: Serve as the single global owner for the account. Define and drive a multi-year global account plan that aligns AWS capabilities with the customer's worldwide business objectives and technology roadmap.
• Drive a Large-Scale Global Migration Motion: Lead the migration of the customer's on-premises, co-located, and competitor-cloud workloads to AWS at global scale. Build and execute multi-year migration and modernization programs across the customer's internal platforms, data centers, and delivery environments in every region, and drive the consumption growth that follows.
• Accelerate Enterprise-Wide AI Adoption: Position AWS as the customer's platform of choice for AI and GenAI. Drive adoption of Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and the broader AWS AI and data stack across the customer's engineering, product, and internal-productivity use cases worldwide, and convert early experimentation into production workloads at scale.
• Drive a Global, Multi-Geography Sales Motion: Lead one consistent global motion across NAMER, EMEA, India, and other regions. Set global revenue objectives, then align and mobilize regional account teams to execute against a single coherent plan rather than disconnected local efforts.
• Executive Relationship Building at the Highest Level: Establish and sustain relationships with the customer's most senior global executives, including the CEO, CTO, President, and business unit and delivery leaders. Position AWS as the customer's primary strategic cloud provider and influence board-level technology decisions.
• Structure the Most Complex Global Deals: Lead the large multi-year, multi-region commercial engagements, including PPAs, global framework agreements, and custom pricing constructs. Navigate complex global procurement, legal, and commercial processes across multiple jurisdictions.
• Orchestrate Extended Teams: Operate as the single-threaded global leader, orchestrating across regional Account Managers, Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver unified outcomes for the customer.
• Global Revenue Ownership and Forecasting: Own global revenue targets for the account, build and manage a healthy worldwide pipeline, forecast accurately across regions, and drive consumption growth across GenAI, data and analytics, migration, and modernization.
• Segment Strategy Shaping: Contribute to AWS's global GSI segment strategy by identifying trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace across the account. Provide inputs that shape go-to-market priorities and product direction.
• Lead Without Authority: Set direction for a large virtual team that does not report to you. Align senior stakeholders across AWS regions and functions, resolve conflicting regional priorities, and drive execution through influence.
• Mentor and Raise the Bar: Coach senior and junior Account Managers across the account team, share best practices for global account management, and act as a role model for how AWS engages its most strategic customers.


A day in the life
As the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI, you own the worldwide sales relationship and are responsible for the customer's global cloud journey on AWS. Your day combines global strategy, senior executive engagement, cross-region orchestration, and complex deal leadership.

A typical day may include:
• Global Strategy and Alignment: Reviewing the global account plan, analyzing consumption and pipeline across regions, and aligning NAMER, EMEA, and India account leads on shared priorities and resourcing for the largest opportunities.
• Executive Engagement: Running global steering committees and executive briefings with the customer's senior leadership, and joining regional business reviews to keep the worldwide plan on track.
• Internal Orchestration: Engaging Solutions Architects and Product teams on technical proposals and roadmap needs, and coordinating across time zones with regional account teams.
• Deal Leadership: Advancing the most complex global commercial engagements, structuring multi-region agreements, and removing blockers across legal, procurement, and commercial functions in multiple countries.
• Advocacy: Bringing the voice of the customer into AWS, informing product roadmaps and investment decisions, and representing AWS at senior customer and industry forums.

AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative people leader to join our team. This role is fundamental to laying the technical foundation for real-time graphics elements, translating design intent into robust, operator-ready templates while keeping scene logic, control, and data integration functioning reliably on air.

The Graphics Tech Artist works in constant contact with vendors and internal stakeholders providing hardware, software, and creative elements, ensuring everything stays on schedule and works within the framework the team is building. This includes staying current on all software and hardware specs and making updates as needed.

descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead the design and development of our power and motion control systems for our robotic systems. This role will select, define and design the future of our robot actuators with a focus on motor control and power delivery. The right candidate has proven experience in shipping products with elements of power electronics and BLDC control.


Key job responsibilities
- Develop conceptual designs and conduct trade studies to support actuator selection and design

- Lead the design, layout, and validation of PCBs for power distribution, motor controllers, gate drivers, and sensor integration for actuator and motor control systems.

- Develop test and measurement infrastructure for power electronics and motor control

- Collaborate with firmware engineers on real-time control strategies

- Work with mechanical engineers to integrate thermal management solutions for high-power electronics and motors

- Support integration, bring-up, debugging, and testing of prototype actuators, working closely with firmware and mechanical teams

- Ensure EMI/EMC compliance, signal integrity, and thermal design best practices for high-reliability electronics in a compact mobile system

Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
- Experience developing products for large volume production
- 7+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience
- 4+ years of motor controls (motor starts, variable frequency drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components) experience
- Experience with power electronics, DC-DC Converters, switching regulators, or battery management
- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
- Strong PCB design and layout skills (Altium, Cadence, or similar) with an understanding of high-power circuits, signal integrity, and thermal constraints
- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, including experience with oscilloscopes, power analyzers, and motor test benches

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in robotics, automotive, aerospace, or other real-time electromechanical systems
- Experience with Ltspice or similar simulation tools
- Experience with small form factor PCBAs, including flex and rigid-flex
- Experience with electromagnetic design
- Foundations in control theory

title: Software Development Engineer, ML Acceleration, Trainium AI Systems, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs designs the silicon behind AWS machine learning acceleration. Trainium and Inferentia servers train and serve the largest models our customers run, and before any of that hardware carries customer traffic it has to prove it works. MLA Vetting owns that gate. We build the diagnostic tests that every accelerator server runs before it becomes sellable, and we decide which failures block a host, which route to a technician for repair, and which are noise.

That gate only works if we can see through it. We are hiring a Software Development Engineer II to build the data and analytics systems that tell us what our tests are actually doing across the fleet. You will build the pipelines that ingest diagnostic results from tens of thousands of servers, the dashboards that make test behavior legible, and the metrics and alarms that tell us a test has started failing on a hardware generation before it costs us a week of capacity. When the team decides whether a diagnostic has enough evidence to move from observation into blocking production, your data answers that question.

This is a software engineering role, not a reporting role. You will write and operate production code, own the alarms and metrics that page us, and build detection for trends nobody is watching yet. You will work directly with hardware, firmware, provisioning, and data center operations teams who act on what you build.

You are fluent in Python and SQL and have built production data pipelines at scale. Experience with Amazon Redshift, Apache Spark, workflow orchestration, and dashboarding in Grafana or QuickSight maps directly to what you will work on here. Experience with telemetry or diagnostic data from a large server fleet, or with defining metrics and anomaly detection on operational time-series data, will have you productive faster. Familiarity with server hardware or data center operations is a plus, not a requirement — we will teach you the hardware.

Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and operate production data pipelines that ingest diagnostic, telemetry, and repair-ticket data from the Trainium and Inferentia fleet into a warehouse other teams query with confidence.

Build and own the metrics, alarms, and anomaly detection that surface test regressions, failure-rate shifts, and new failure signatures across hardware generations without a human going looking for them.

Build dashboards and visualizations that make fleet and test health legible to engineers, hardware partners, and leadership, covering failure rates, failure-signature breakdowns, first pass yield, and repair latency.

Analyze large-scale fleet data to find root cause behind failure trends, and separate genuine hardware faults from software defects and test noise — a distinction that decides whether a failure reaches a technician or an engineer.

Define the evidence standard that gates operational decisions, including whether a diagnostic has soaked long enough and cleanly enough in the fleet to move from observation mode into blocking production.

Improve data quality and pipeline reliability so downstream consumers trust the numbers without re-deriving them.

Write clear analyses and design documents for technical and non-technical readers, including leadership.

A day in the life
You start by checking an alarm that fired overnight: a diagnostic's failure rate climbed on one server generation. You query the failure signatures, find the increase concentrates in one component and one data center, and hand the breakdown to the hardware team by mid-morning. The rest of the day goes to a pipeline you are building to join repair outcomes against diagnostic results, so the team can measure how often a repair actually fixes the fault it was dispatched for. You close the day reviewing a teammate's code review and answering an operations partner who needs a new cut of yield data.

About the team
MLA Vetting sits between hardware manufacturing and customer-ready capacity. We own the diagnostic test suites and the triage framework that turn a raw hardware failure into a specific, actionable repair, and we own the fleet-scale evidence that drives hardware and firmware improvements upstream. Our work is measured in how fast a server reaches sellable and how often it gets there on the first try.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Applied Scientist - Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing, Amazon Braket
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Braket is investing in fault-tolerant quantum computing capabilities. We are looking for an Applied Scientist to own resource estimation and workload benchmarking for fault-tolerant quantum workloads on AWS. You will answer the fundamental questions: how many physical qubits are needed, what gate depths are achievable, and what error budgets are realistic for a given algorithm on a given device. Your models will inform technical decisions, customer conversations, and our roadmap.

This role requires more than resource estimation methodology alone. You need a broad foundation in quantum error correction research to reason about the full picture: how code choices affect resource requirements, how logical circuit structure impacts physical costs, and how benchmarking results feed back into the system. You will be part of a small team of scientists and engineers, and we expect you to codify your solutions in production-quality code and contribute directly to the codebase alongside your teammates.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and maintain FTQC resource estimation models that determine qubit counts, gate depths, and error budgets for target algorithms
- Develop benchmarking frameworks that evaluate compilation quality against realistic hardware constraints
- Produce resource estimates that inform technical decisions and feed into customer readiness work led by the Applications & Engagement team
- Collaborate with the QEC compilation scientists on how resource estimates feed back into code selection and optimization
- Connect benchmarking outputs to published materials in coordination with Braket's science and product teams
- Stay current with the rapidly evolving QEC literature and incorporate new results into estimation models

title: Operations Designer, Operations Design Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Engineering Services (GES) is seeking an experienced Operations Designer to join the International Operations Design Team (ODT). This individual will be responsible for leading composite design delivery for a portfolio of fulfillment center projects within the EMEA network.

The Operations Designer owns the end-to-end design collaboration process within their assigned portfolio (defined by building type or technical capability), ensuring high quality of deliverables, standards applicability and quantities compliance of composites. They participate actively from Concept Design phase (REVO) through As-built, identifying challenges and influencing their resolution before composite initiation.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in warehouse/logistics design using BIM and CAD tools, with a detail-oriented and data-driven mindset. They will possess problem-solving skills and knowledge of operations processes, design dependencies and execution for construction and fit-out environments. The role requires an 80% tactical / 20% strategic focus, with the designer addressing innovation (clash detection) and value engineering opportunities while supporting cost and speed-to-serve objectives.

The role will be based in Spain, with travel expected for up to 50% of the time depending on the project portfolio

Key job responsibilities
You will lead the full design coordination lifecycle for a portfolio of fulfillment center projects, managing architectural, mechanical handling equipment, and mechanical/electrical/plumbing models with vendors to deliver detailed design packages on time and within specification

You will coordinate warehouse layout designs — from complex machinery placement to floor markings — collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to identify requirements and resolve design challenges from concept through as-built phases

You will assess and communicate project design status to relevant stakeholders and forums, fostering collaboration across programs to address inconsistencies and deliver consistent execution across all sites in your portfolio

You will support field teams by providing layout designs that solve on-site challenges, while tracking the resolution of design issues and facilitating timely design reviews to meet regulatory compliance

You will contribute to the standard design library and drive continuous improvement activities, identifying opportunities to enhance quality and efficiency across the design process

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering (any domain), Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
- Knowledge of IE fundamentals (e.g., basic spatial layouts of processing lines, process paths, etc.)
- Experience as an industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment
- Experience using one or more of the following technologies (e.g., AutoCAD, Rhino, Revit, SolidWorks, CREO, SketchUp, KeyShot, etc.) to deliver high quality models and designs

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, and decision making
- Experience with design-in-safety
- Experience with process design based on Lean Principles
- Experience working with the designs of complex automated material, handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems including robotics and high-speed manufacturing
- Experience communicating technical concepts and processes using clear, simple language and visuals
- Additional language skills (French, German, Polish, Arabic, Portuguese, Turkish, Chinese (Mandarin), Afrikaans and Zulu ) are beneficial for cross-regional project coordination across EMEA

title: Specialista Sicurezza sul Lavoro, AMZL Italy WHS
descriptionHtml:
In Amazon, la sicurezza e il benessere dei nostri dipendenti è una priorità assoluta. I nostri Specialisti della Sicurezza svolgono un ruolo fondamentale per renderlo possibile. In questo ruolo, metterai in atto le misure necessarie per garantire che tutte le persone del tuo sito lavorino in un ambiente sicuro e salutare. È un'opportunità concreta per fare la differenza nella vita delle persone ogni giorno. Mantenendo proattivamente la loro sicurezza, li aiuterai anche a sentirsi sicuri nel proprio ruolo e motivati a dare il meglio.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL per i dipendenti del settore Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione . La posizione è inquadrata al livello 2 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

Key job responsibilities
- Monitorare le prestazioni del sito rispetto ai KPI stabiliti e creare piani di miglioramento dei processi.
- Implementare programmi di sicurezza e salute sul lavoro e organizzare sessioni di formazione.
- Analizzare le metriche di sicurezza e le tendenze degli incidenti per aiutare i colleghi a pianificare le risorse appropriate nelle aree a maggior rischio.
- Effettuare audit per verificare la conformità del sito alla legislazione vigente in materia di sicurezza e salute e implementare soluzioni dove si identificano rischi.

A day in the life
Lavorerai in sede presso uno dei nostri siti, che può essere un centro di distribuzione, un centro di smistamento o una stazione di consegna. Essere sul posto ti permette di tenere sotto controllo i processi. Oltre ad aiutarci a mantenere la conformità in materia di sicurezza e salute, individuerai potenziali problemi e opportunità di miglioramento. Questo significa lavorare a stretto contatto con le persone di tutta l'azienda per conoscere i rischi che affrontano e raccogliere dati per identificare modi più intelligenti e sicuri di lavorare. Organizzerai anche programmi di formazione per aiutare tutti a seguire i nuovi processi di sicurezza e raggiungere nuovi standard.

About the team
Il team Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire il benessere mentale e fisico dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro. Il nostro team collabora con responsabili, associati e autorità locali in tutti i nostri siti, assicurando il rispetto delle politiche di Amazon e delle normative vigenti, e garantendo la sicurezza dei nostri ambienti di lavoro. Il team offre una varietà di opportunità, dai Safety Technician ai Programme Manager. Indipendentemente dal tuo ruolo, contribuirai allo sviluppo e all'implementazione della strategia di sicurezza sull'intera rete.

Basic qualifications

- Una laurea, oppure una qualifica equivalente conforme al Quadro Europeo delle Qualifiche (EQF), preferibilmente in Tecniche della Prevenzione nell'Ambiente e nei Luoghi di Lavoro, Ingegneria della Sicurezza, o in una disciplina affine
- Certificazione ASPP o RSPP.
- Conoscenza della legislazione italiana in materia di sicurezza e salute sul lavoro.
- Padronanza dell'italiano e conoscenza avanzata dell'inglese (B2), scritto e parlato.

Preferred qualifications

- Le qualifiche preferenziali non sono necessarie per candidarsi a una posizione in Amazon. Se possiedi tutte le qualifiche di base sopra indicate, saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura.
- Esperienza con metodologie Lean, 5S o Kaizen.
- Esperienza nella pianificazione o gestione di iniziative attente all'ambiente.
- Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e in team.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

The Developer Experience AI Tools team is transforming how internal teams create and deploy AI solutions. You'll design and launch features aligned with industry-standard AI frameworks, lead projects that drive innovation for customers, and work at the intersection of developer experience and AI technology. This is a unique opportunity where your work removes friction for builders across Amazon — democratizing AI development through robust, scalable tooling.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop scalable software systems that support the full development lifecycle of AI tools and services
- Lead technical projects from conception to completion, collaborating with stakeholders to deliver high-impact solutions
- Participate actively in code reviews, providing meaningful feedback to team members and ensuring code quality across the platform
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while implementing improvements that enhance system reliability and performance
- Work with customers and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions for AI development tools

A day in the life
You'll lead technical projects end to end, guiding them from design through successful delivery while identifying new opportunities to enhance our AI development platform. Your day may involve optimizing Machine Learning Platform server performance, designing new capabilities for partner agents, or defining the next generation of developer tooling. title: Sr. HW Regulatory Compliance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, Echo, Ring, and Blink — icons of ambient computing reaching hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. What will you help us create?

The Hardware Safety & Compliance (HWSC) team is the critical bridge between bold hardware innovation and worldwide market access. We don't just check boxes — we embed compliance into the DNA of product design from Day 1, ensuring that hundreds of millions of devices meet the highest standards for safety, electromagnetic compatibility, and radio frequency performance across 100+ countries.

We're looking for a Sr. HW Regulatory Compliance Engineer based in China who excels at hands-on execution of compliance testing, certification, and factory-level validation across our product portfolio. You will work closely with contract manufacturers (CMs), in-region test laboratories, and cross-functional engineering teams to drive EMC and RF compliance from engineering builds through mass production. You will be experienced in Radio Frequency (RF) and ElectroMagnetic Compatibility (EMC) testing, debugging, and product certification processes. You will have strong familiarity with North American and international regulatory standards. You will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to validate and certify innovative wireless consumer electronic products.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused engineering role where your work directly determines whether Amazon can achieve certification milestones on schedule and maintain compliance across production lines. You will be the HWSC team's on-the-ground presence in China — coordinating test lab activities, supporting CM builds, debugging compliance issues in real time, and ensuring production units meet all certification requirements. This role requires approximately 20% travel to test laboratories and CM sites. You must be analytical, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively across multiple teams and time zones. Additionally, you must excel at communicating compliance status and technical findings clearly to both local engineering teams and global HWSC leadership.

Key job responsibilities
• Execute end-to-end compliance testing and certification activities for product programs — from engineering builds through mass production, ensuring all regulatory milestones are met on schedule
• Work closely with the product design team by researching and specifying regulatory and industry compliance requirements, with emphasis on China, FCC, IC, CE, and other international certification schemes
• Drive hands-on EMI/EMC and RF compliance testing and debugging — partnering with Electrical, Mechanical, and Wireless engineers to resolve compliance issues at the circuit, layout, firmware, or mechanical design level
• Manage day-to-day relationships with in-region 3rd party test laboratories — planning, scheduling, and directing compliance testing to drive first-pass certification success
• Support CM site compliance activities — validating that production configurations, shielding, grounding, and assembly processes maintain compliance established during development
• Debug compliance failures at the root-cause level — understanding why at the circuit, layout, firmware, or mechanical design level, and driving the fix with engineering teams in real time
• Coordinate with global HWSC team members to align on compliance strategies, share test results, and escalate issues that may impact product launch timelines
• Perform detailed, independent research and literature reviews to yield actionable conclusions to ambiguous regulatory compliance issues
• Deliver concise and informative compliance status updates to global HWSC leadership, translating test results and certification progress into clear schedule impact assessments
• Work with manufacturing partners to test and ensure all in-production devices remain compliant with all certifications, including production line testing validation
• Maintain compliance documentation, test reports, and certification records with thoroughness and accuracy to support audits and market access filings
• Contribute to best practices and mechanisms that prevent repeat compliance issues and improve certification efficiency across the device portfolio

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Experience in a consumer electronics lab environment
- Working proficiency in Mandarin and English (written and verbal) to coordinate across local and global teams

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Experience working with Contract Manufacturers (CM) and test lab on compliance-related issues and certifications.
- Experience with wireless technologies such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee/Thread, UWB, or Cellular

title: Ground Systems Hardware Development Engineer, Amazon Leo Ground Systems Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

As a Hardware Development Engineer on the Ground Systems team, you will contribute to the design, development, integration, and validation of Telemetry, Tracking & Command (TT&C) and Ground Gateway hardware, and operate as an autonomous technical contributor who independently designs hardware components and significant technical portions of subsystems for tightly coupled and often ambiguous aerospace systems. These systems support satellite launch, early orbit operations, and ongoing command and control of the Leo constellation using full-motion tracking antenna terminals and their associated RF electronics.

You will be expected to perform under a combination of constraints, to include: satellite-system deployment consequences, limited post-deployment access, tight regulatory and export-control constraints, and immature supplier reference ecosystems that often require first-principles development.

You will be expected to make design decisions with awareness that reliability and quality must be established before deployment because repair, RMA, or post-deployment correction may be impractical.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
You will work alongside senior engineers and cross-functional partners to deliver hardware from concept through production and global deployment. Key responsibilities include:

- Support the design, development, and validation of RF hardware and electronics subsystems for TT&C and Gateway terminals, including antenna feed assemblies, RF front-end chains, and ancillary equipment.
- Perform CAD functions for new designs and improvements to our deployed infrastructure, and drive these through installation and implementation.
- Execute bring-up, hardware integration, and test campaigns for Gateway and TT&C subsystems.
- Develop and execute verification and validation plans to ensure hardware meets performance, environmental, and reliability requirements.
- Support root cause analysis and failure investigations on ground station hardware.
- Collaborate with internal teams and external suppliers to drive hardware development, procurement, and integration activities.
- Contribute to design review documentation, test reports, and engineering change processes.
- Support the transition of HW designs from development through qualification and into production and field deployment.
You will work closely with RF systems, mechanical, thermal, software, and operations teams to ensure TT&C and Gateway ground stations meet performance requirements and are deployable at global scale.

About the team
The Ground Systems team is developing globally distributed high data rate satellite communication terminals, which operate off of automated software driven systems and which maintain critical connectivity from the ground to the complete Leo constellation. This team is driving the development, deployment and long-term operability of Leo ground station terminals.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent engineering science

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of satellite communications ground systems and operations experience

title: Technicien de Centre de Données / Data Center Technician, Opérations de centres de données/Data Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
Technicien de centre de données

Amazon Web Services (AWS) est en forte croissance et est à la recherche d’un technicien de centre de données pour rejoindre son équipe d’exploitation des infrastructures en pleine expansion.
Amazon Web Services (AWS) est une entreprise de technologie très dynamique et leader mondial dans le domaine des centres de données. Le poste permettra d’assurer la disponibilité et la fiabilité globales pour atteindre ou dépasser les niveaux de service définis pour les opérations du centre de données. Ce poste comprend des diagnostics de matériel informatique et de réseaux, ainsi que de la réparation physique. Ce poste peut aussi inclure la participation à une rotation de garde. Tous les candidats doivent être capables de travailler de façon autonome et en équipe. L’établissement des priorités de travail, les compétences organisationnelles, la communication efficace et la capacité de réagir rapidement sont essentiels à la réussite. En plus de la réparation de matériel informatique et des réseaux, le candidat devra installer des équipements, produire de la documentation, apporter des solutions novatrices et résoudre des problèmes à l’intérieur du centre de données. Cette équipe travaille dans un environnement qui fonctionne 24 h/24 et 7 j/7.

Nous sommes ouverts à l'embauche de candidats pour travailler dans l'un des endroits suivants :
Lasalle, QC, CAN

Amazon est un employeur d’action positive pour l’égalité des chances — minorités, femmes, personnes handicapées, anciens combattants, identité de genre, orientation sexuelle.

Le candidat retenu doit être en mesure d’obtenir et de conserver une autorisation de sécurité sur le personnel canadien au niveau requis, comme en tant que condition d’emploi.

Tel qu’énoncé dans la Norme sur le filtrage de sécurité, le filtrage de sécurité sur le personnel évalue la fiabilité et la loyauté d’une personne envers le Canada. Cela implique :

* la collecte de renseignements personnels auprès de personnes, avec leur consentement
* des renseignements provenant d’organismes d’application de la loi, d’organismes de renseignement et d’autres sources

Ce processus comprend une série de vérifications en fonction du niveau requis.

Ces vérifications sont effectuées par l’entremise de Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada (SPAC) et peut inclure, mais ne sont pas limités à :

* La vérification de l’identité, de la citoyenneté, de l’éducation, des titres professionnels, des références personnelles et professionnelles, du crédit et/ou des antécédents criminels.
* Les personnes peuvent également être tenues de fournir des renseignements supplémentaires au moyen d’un questionnaire de sécurité et/ou d’une entrevue de sécurité en personne ou par téléphone à la demande de SPAC ou menée par celui-ci.
* Pour obtenir l’attestation requise dans les délais prescrits, les demandeurs doivent avoir résidé au Canada de façon continue pendant cinq (5) ans et ne doivent pas avoir vécu ou travaillé à l’extérieur du Canada pendant plus de six (6) mois consécutifs au cours de cette période.

*******************************************************

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly and is looking for a Data Center Technician to join its expanding Infrastructure Operations team.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a dynamic technology company and a global leader in the data center space. The position will ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels for data center operations. This position includes computer hardware and network diagnostics, as well as physical repair. This position may also include participation in an on-call rotation. All candidates must be able to work independently and in a team. Establishing work priorities, organizational skills, effective communication and the ability to respond quickly are essential to success. In addition to repairing computer equipment and networks, the candidate will install equipment, produce documentation, provide innovative solutions and resolve problems inside the data center. This team works in a 24/7 environment.


The successful candidate must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Canadian Personnel Security Clearance to the required level, as a condition of employment.

As set out in the Standard on security screening, the personnel security screening assesses an individual's reliability and loyalty to Canada. It involves:

* the collection of personal information from individuals, with their consent
* information from law enforcement, intelligence agencies and other sources

This process includes a variation of verifications based on the level required. These verifications are conducted through Public Service and Procurement Canada (PSPC) and
can include, but are not limited to:

* Verification of identity, citizenship, education, professional credentials, personal and professional references, credit check and/or criminal background check.
* Individuals may also be required to provide additional information through a security questionnaire and/or in-person/telephone security interview at the request of/conducted by PSPC.
* To obtain the requisite clearance within required timelines, applicants must have five (5) years of continuous Canadian residency and must not have lived or worked outside of Canada for more than six (6) consecutive months during that time.



Key job responsibilities
- Couverture sur site en équipe par quarts et/ou astreinte hebdomadaire
- Réponse aux événements de haute gravité dans le respect des SLA (accords de niveau de service)
- Participation aux événements liés à l'alimentation et au refroidissement des centres de données
- Dépannage et réparation des serveurs et des équipements réseau
- Résolution des problèmes de connexions réseau
- Coordination et développement de relations avec les différentes équipes du centre de données
- Interaction avec les fournisseurs et les entrepreneurs tiers
- Recherche de moyens pour vous améliorer et améliorer les processus et les systèmes avec lesquels vous travaillez
- Contribution au développement des autres membres de l'équipe



****************************************************

- Onsite coverage as a Team in shifts and/or weekly oncall
- Responding to high-severity events within SLAs
- Participate in Data Center power & cooling events
- Break-fix of servers and network devices
- Troubleshooting of network connections
- Coordinating and building relationships with various Data Center teams
- Interact with third party vendors & contractors
- Seeking out ways to improve yourself and the processes and systems with which you work
- Contribute to the development of other team members

A day in the life
À partir de votre « Jour 1 », nous proposons un processus d'intégration, une formation continue et des occasions d’avancement. Vous travaillerez de manière indépendante et en équipe avec vos collègues tout en acquérant une compréhension des centres de données et en étant à la fine pointe de cette technologie transformationnelle. Il y aura des occasions d'avancement au sein de l'équipe et de l'organisation, car AWS encourage tous les Amazoniens à dépasser les attentes de nos clients.

***********************************************

Starting from your ‘Day One’, we provide an on boarding process and continuous training and growth opportunities. You will work independently and with your colleagues as you gain an understanding of data centers and be at the forefront of this transformational technology. There will be opportunities to expand within the team and the organization as AWS encourages all Amazonians to exceed the expectations of our customers.

About the team
Services d'infrastructure AWS (AIS)
Les services d'infrastructure AWS sont responsables de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de toute l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. En d'autres termes, nous sommes ceux qui maintiennent le cloud en fonctionnement. Nous soutenons tous les centres de données AWS ainsi que tous les serveurs, systèmes de stockage, réseaux, équipements électriques et de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu à l'innovation sur laquelle ils comptent. Nous travaillons sur les problèmes les plus complexes, avec des milliers de variables impactant la chaîne d'approvisionnement — et nous recherchons des personnes talentueuses prêtes à nous aider.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseaux, de spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'experts en sécurité, de responsables des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous collaborerez avec des personnes à travers AWS pour nous aider à offrir les normes les plus élevées en matière de sécurité tout en fournissant une capacité apparemment infinie au coût le plus bas possible pour nos clients. Et vous découvrirez une culture inclusive qui accueille des idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à bien.

Expériences Diversifiées
AWS valorise les expériences diversifiées. Même si vous ne remplissez pas toutes les qualifications et compétences préférées énumérées dans la description du poste, nous encourageons les candidats à postuler. Si votre carrière débute, n'a pas suivi un chemin traditionnel ou inclut des expériences alternatives, ne laissez pas cela vous empêcher de postuler.

Pourquoi AWS ?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) est la plateforme cloud la plus complète et largement adoptée au monde. Nous avons été pionniers dans l'informatique en nuage et n'avons jamais cessé d'innover — c'est pourquoi des clients allant des startups les plus prospères aux entreprises du Global 500 font confiance à notre suite robuste de produits et services pour alimenter leurs activités.

Culture d'équipe inclusive
AWS valorise la curiosité et la connexion. Nos groupes d'affinité dirigés par des employés et sponsorisés par l'entreprise favorisent l'inclusion et permettent à nos collaborateurs de tirer fierté de ce qui fait notre singularité. Nos événements inclusifs renforcent des équipes plus fortes et plus collaboratives. Notre innovation continue est alimentée par les idées audacieuses, les perspectives nouvelles et les voix passionnées que nos équipes apportent à tout ce que nous faisons.

Mentorat & Développement Professionnel
Nous élevons continuellement notre niveau de performance dans notre quête pour devenir le meilleur employeur au monde. C'est pourquoi vous trouverez ici une infinité de ressources pour le partage des connaissances, le mentorat et le développement professionnel afin de vous aider à devenir un professionnel plus complet.

Équilibre Travail/Vie Personnelle
Nous valorisons l'harmonie entre vie professionnelle et personnelle. Réussir au travail ne devrait jamais se faire au détriment de sacrifices à la maison, c'est pourquoi nous visons une flexibilité dans notre culture de travail. Lorsque nous nous sentons soutenus au travail comme à la maison, rien ne peut nous arrêter.

***********************************************************

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Plus d’un an d’expérience en matériel informatique, incluant le dépannage et la réparation.
- Plus d’un an d’expérience en soutien réseau et systèmes d’exploitation,
- ou un baccalauréat ou plus en informatique, génie informatique ou domaine connexe.
- Puisque ce rôle nécessite que l’employé interagisse avec d’autres entités d’Amazon à l’échelle mondiale ainsi qu’avec des employés et intervenants dans d’autres provinces canadiennes, la connaissance du français et de l’anglais est exigée pour ce poste.
- **********************
- 1+ years of computer hardware experience, including troubleshooting and repairing experience
- 1+ years of network and operating system support experience, or Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field
- Due to the nature of the role that requires interaction with other Amazon entities globally and with Amazon employees and stakeholders in other provinces in Canada, bilingualism French and English is required for this position

Preferred qualifications

- Plus de 2 ans d’expérience en matériel informatique, incluant le dépannage et la réparation.
- Connaissance des systèmes d’exploitation, du matériel, du stockage, des réseaux, de la sécurité, de l’administration de bases de données et de l’infrastructure infonuagique.
- Baccalauréat obtenu dans les 12 derniers mois en gestion de l’information, informatique, technologies de l’information, science informatique, génie informatique ou discipline connexe.
- Expérience en déploiement, gestion et optimisation de Microsoft Windows Server, ou expérience en Linux, en protocoles réseau, ainsi qu’une expérience démontrant de fortes capacités d’analyse, une grande attention aux détails et de bonnes aptitudes en communication.
- Plus de 2 ans d’expérience en réparation d’équipement de manutention.
- Connaissance des systèmes d’exploitation UNIX/Linux.
- Expérience démontrant de solides compétences analytiques, une attention rigoureuse aux détails et une communication efficace, ou expérience avec des protocoles réseau tels que DNS/DHCP/TCP, ainsi qu’en Linux et en dépannage réseau.
- Expérience en coordination interfonctionnelle, respect des échéances et gestion efficace de priorités concurrentes.
- ******************************
- 2+ years of computer hardware experience, including troubleshooting and repairing experience
- Knowledge of operating systems, hardware, storage, network, security, database administration and cloud infrastructure
- Bachelor's degree within last 12 months in Information Management, Informatics, Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or other related discipline
- Experience deploying, managing, and optimizing Microsoft Windows Server, or experience in Linux and Networking protocols and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP and experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting
- Experience coordinating cross-functional inputs, meeting deadlines, and effectively managing competing priorities

title: Software Development Engineer II, International Emerging Stores Sub-same Day
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to shape how fast Amazon can deliver to hundreds of millions of customers? The Sub-Same-Day (SSD) team builds the technology behind Amazon's fastest delivery promises across India and Emerging Marketplaces — getting orders to customers in hours, not days.

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer II who wants to own high-scale, low-latency systems that directly move the speed and reliability customers see at checkout. You'll design and build services that compute and optimize the fastest reliable delivery promise for every order.

-Build customer-facing systems at massive scale and single-digit-millisecond latency
-Own features end-to-end, from design through production and operations
-Directly impact conversion, delivery speed, and customer trust across 10+ marketplaces

Key job responsibilities
-Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency, highly available services that power SSD delivery promises.
-Own features end-to-end — requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.
-Lead design discussions and independently drive alignment with partner teams (Promise, transportation, search etc. ).
-Uphold operational excellence: monitoring, alarming, on-call, and driving down defects and tickets.
-Dive deep on edge cases, testing, and safe production rollouts (canary deployments, metrics, dashboards).
-Proactively identify and mitigate risks; communicate progress, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly.
-Mentor SDE-1s and junior engineers — review code and designs, unblock them, and raise the technical bar.
-Contribute to the team's technical roadmap and continuous improvement of our systems.

A day in the life
You'll partner with product managers, applied scientists, and engineering teams across Promise, ATROPS, transportation, and DEX to ship features that make delivery faster and more reliable. A typical day includes a team standup, design and code reviews, hands-on development, and digging into production metrics. You'll take part in operational excellence and on-call to keep our services healthy. Beyond delivery, we invest in learning and fun — quarterly hackathons and fortnightly GenAI brown-bag sessions where the team explores new technology together.



About the team
The Sub-Same-Day (SSD) team owns the technology behind Amazon's fastest delivery experiences across India and Emerging Marketplaces (AU, BR, MX, AE, SA, SG, EG, TR, ZA). Our mission is to give every customer the fastest reliable promise we can keep — and to extend same-day and sub-same-day speed to new marketplaces and customers. We're a high-ownership, customer-obsessed team that values deep technical work, operational excellence, and continuous learning. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Ausbildung - Mechatronik
descriptionHtml:
Deine Chance: Technik, die bewegt
Bei uns hältst du die Systeme am Laufen, die Produkte vom Klick bis zur Haustür bringen. Du analysierst Störungen, wartest komplexe Anlagen und arbeitest mit Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Pneumatik und Steuerungssoftware, mit echtem Einfluss vom ersten Tag an.
Hier ist deine Arbeit nicht abstrakt. Sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam. Und dein Weg? Den gestaltest du selbst, mit endlosen Möglichkeiten, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.


Key job responsibilities
• Installation, Überwachung, Wartung und Instandhaltung mechanischer und elektrischer Anlagen.
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an automatisierten Systemen.
• Arbeiten in den Bereichen Metallbearbeitung, Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und Steuerungstechnik.
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren von Komponenten nach Vorgaben und Sicherheitsstandards.
• Unterstützung bei der vorbeugenden Instandhaltung und Inbetriebnahme neuer Anlagen.



A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst Du in unserer modernen Partnerlehrwerkstatt sowie der Berufsschule, während Du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon am Standort erwirbst.
Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst eine Störung an einer Förderanlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. Am nächsten Tag programmierst du eine Steuerung, führst eine vorbeugende Wartung durch oder unterstützt bei der Inbetriebnahme neuer Technik.
Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Basic qualifications

- Du hast mindestens einen Hauptschulabschluss zum Beginn der Ausbildung
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Gute Schulnoten in Mathematik und Physik (abhängig von der Schulform)

Preferred qualifications

- Du besitzt handwerkliches Geschick und verfügst über ein technisches Grundverständnis
- Grundkenntnisse in Englisch (A2-Niveau)
- Du bringst bereits erste Vorerfahrungen im handwerklichen Bereich mit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität“
- Proaktives Vorantreiben von Veränderungsprozessen und eigenverantwortliche Entscheidungsfindung
- Bist du interessiert? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Bitte bewirb Dich mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen auf Deutsch (Lebenslauf, Zeugniskopie – ein PDF mit 5 MB max.). Sollten die Bewerbungsunterlagen nicht vollständig sein, können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen! Bitte beachte, dass du im Rahmen des Einstellungsprozesses ein Videointerview über ein externes Tool durchführen musst. Mit der Übersendung Deines Lebenslaufs erklärst Du Dich mit der Speicherung Deiner Daten zum Zwecke der Feststellung der Eignung für dieses und zukünftige Stellenangebot/e in der weltweiten Amazon Konzernpersonaldatenbank, die derzeit in den USA geführt wird, einverstanden.

title: Stagiaire Partenaire Ressources Humaines Opérations (6 Mois) - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Résumé du poste

L’énergie qui fait tourner le monde | Découvrez les carrières dans les Opérations

Les postes dans les Opérations chez Amazon vous placent au cœur de la façon dont les choses circulent, d’un simple clic jusqu’à la porte du client.
Vous contribuerez à concevoir, améliorer et faire fonctionner des systèmes qui relient les personnes, les produits et les lieux, à grande échelle. Vous prendrez des responsabilités dès le début, travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes pour résoudre des défis concrets, et verrez les résultats directs de vos décisions lorsqu’elles atteignent les clients chaque jour.
Ici, l’impact de ce que vous construisez n’est pas abstrait : il est visible, immédiat et significatif — il maintient en mouvement l’une des opérations les plus complexes au monde.
C’est ici que votre parcours prend forme, à travers l’action, la responsabilité et la possibilité d’évoluer dans de multiples directions.


Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste

- Développer une connaissance approfondie des fonctions RH au sein des opérations dynamiques d’Amazon
- Participer aux efforts de communication interne afin d’aligner les équipes de plusieurs pays, en favorisant la collaboration et le partage d’informations
- Aider à élaborer des plans et des supports de formation répondant aux besoins de développement évolutifs des différentes équipes, afin de soutenir la croissance des collaborateurs et collaboratrices
- Découvrir les fonctions RH au sein de l’organisation Amazon au sens large et se tenir informé(e) des meilleures pratiques
- Apporter un soutien aux employé(e)s d’Amazon sur diverses questions quotidiennes liées à la présence, à l’engagement, à la rémunération et à d’autres sujets RH
- Assister les équipes RH dans les routines opérationnelles quotidiennes et les tâches administratives
- Participer à des revues de processus afin d’identifier des opportunités de simplification et d’automatisation, en améliorant l’efficacité
- Compiler des statistiques du personnel, des rapports et des évaluations de performance complets afin d’éclairer la prise de décision
- Collaborer étroitement avec les responsables opérationnel(le)s afin d’aligner les stratégies et initiatives RH sur les objectifs et priorités de l’organisation


A day in the life
Une journée type

Chaque journée est un peu différente en tant que Stagiaire Partenaire Ressources Humaines Opérations. Ce stage vous plongera dans les RH au sein d’une organisation mondiale, avec la possibilité de travailler sur des projets couvrant différents domaines RH — des relations sociales et de la formation à la rémunération et à l’analyse des effectifs. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à analyser des données sur les effectifs afin d’identifier des tendances et de formuler des recommandations pour votre équipe, puis votre après-midi à accompagner un dossier de relations sociales ou à collaborer avec des responsables opérationnel(le)s sur une initiative de formation.
La fonction RH d’Amazon est profondément intégrée à l’activité ; ainsi, quel que soit le projet sur lequel vous travaillez, une partie de votre rôle consistera à utiliser les données et la réflexion analytique pour orienter les décisions. Vous appliquerez vos compétences en résolution de problèmes et vos compétences techniques à des défis concrets, tout en développant d’importantes compétences en communication et des compétences comportementales professionnelles grâce à une expérience pratique. Avec un(e) mentor(e) dédié(e) qui accompagnera votre développement tout au long du programme, vous découvrirez comment les RH s’associent à l’activité pour stimuler la croissance et l’excellence organisationnelle — offrant une base solide pour une carrière dans les ressources humaines.
Remarque : vous devez avoir le droit de travailler dans le pays d’emploi à la date de début.


About the team
À propos de l’équipe

Communauté des stagiaires :
En tant que stagiaire Amazon, vous ferez partie d’une communauté dynamique et bienveillante qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des stagiaires du monde entier, développerez votre réseau et participerez à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des thèmes tels que la durabilité, afin d’explorer vos centres d’intérêt variés.

Accompagnement :
Le programme de stage offre un solide dispositif d’accompagnement, comprenant des permanences hebdomadaires pour les stagiaires, un support informatique et RH dédié, ainsi qu’une équipe programme engagée dans votre réussite. Cela vous garantit l’encadrement et l’aide nécessaires pour vous épanouir.

Sessions d’apprentissage :
Des sessions d’apprentissage exclusives développeront encore vos compétences, en vous donnant accès aux plateformes d’apprentissage de pointe d’Amazon et à l’expertise de leaders du secteur. Ces opportunités de développement structurées vous prépareront à l’étape suivante de votre carrière.

Opportunités :
À l’issue réussie du stage, vous pourrez être considéré(e) pour un poste de jeune diplômé(e) ou un second stage, vous permettant de poursuivre votre parcours avec Amazon. De plus, vous bénéficierez d’un salaire mensuel compétitif, d’un soutien à la relocalisation et d’un accès à une gamme d’avantages réservés aux employés.

Dates de début des stages tout au long de l’année :
Nous recrutons des stagiaires pour un début à tout moment entre janvier et septembre 2027. Chaque mois, nous organiserons 1 à 2 journées d’intégration pour les nouveaux et nouvelles arrivant(e)s.

Basic qualifications

- Actuellement en dernière année et préparant une licence ou un master universitaire en RH, administration des affaires, psychologie, marketing, sciences sociales, droit ou dans un domaine connexe (à orientation sciences humaines), ou dans une discipline similaire
- Disponible pour un stage à temps plein (35 heures/semaine) et s’engager sur un stage de 6 mois

title: Sr. Technical Account Manager (PubSec), ES - WWPS
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

As a TAM you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, Gen/AI, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support, and risk management.

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!

This position requires U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.

Key job responsibilities
• The TAM role is not directly hands-on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues; rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.

You will be the principal technical advisor for your customers, guiding them through planning, building, and optimizing solutions on AWS.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
