Kumo (pronounced ‘Koo-mo’, the Japanese word for "cloud") is the global product and engineering organization for AWS Support, a multi-billion $ business. Kumo’s products, used by AWS customers and the internal Amazonian teams that help them, are vital to ensuring exceptional customer experiences on AWS. Kumo has a broad portfolio of customer-facing and internal services. Our public-facing properties include AWS Trusted Advisor, AWS Health, Automation, Recommendations & Insights, AWS Support Center, AWS Knowledge center, and many more. Our internal AWS Support teams rely on Kumo services to interact with AWS customers, diagnose and resolve customer issues, and safely share information across AWS teams. These services must work seamlessly, and be available when AWS services are not. Any changes to these tools has a force multiplicative effect on how customers experience AWS and the efficiencies of the internal workforce.

The Kumo organization is globally distributed, with larger teams located in Seattle - Washington, Cape Town - South Africa, and Vancouver - Canada.

We are looking for engineers to join our team in building the services that allow AWS customers to communicate with AWS Support Engineers. Your work will be the face of AWS Support to our customers; you will work to expand the communication channels we support so that our customers can reach out with convenience, within the context of their work. You will utilize cloud-native technologies developed right alongside you: AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, etc. You will innovate on the user experience by working closely with our customers and partners.

Our team applies modern development practices and utilizes native AWS tools to do them. We operate in a multi-region redundant environment to ensure reliability; we continuously deploy to all regions through an automated pipeline; we use CloudWatch and other tools to help us monitor and diagnose. We loosely follow an agile methodology, and most of all, we focus on getting things done and delivering value to customers.

We combine the culture of a startup, the innovation and creativity of a R&D Lab, the resources, support, and work-life balance of a mature organization, and technical challenges at the scale of AWS. Come join us!

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

Amazon knows that a diverse, inclusive culture empowers us all to deliver the best results for our customers. We celebrate diversity in our workforce and in the ways we work. As part of our inclusive culture, we offer accommodations during the interview and onboarding process. If you’d like to discuss your accommodation options, please contact your recruiter, who will partner you with the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT). You may also contact ACAT directly by emailing acat-africa@amazon.com. We want all Amazonians to have the best possible Day 1 experience. If you’ve already completed the interview process, you can contact ACAT for accommodation support before you start to ensure all your needs are met Day 1.

Key job responsibilities
In this role you will:
· Write high-quality, efficient, testable code in Kotlin, Java and other object-oriented languages.
· Build highly available, secure, distributed systems in micro-services, container, and distributed cluster-compute architectures.
· Collaborate with high calibre engineers in the industry to work on some of the most complex challenges in large-scale computing.
· Own and operate the systems that you build based on real-time customer data and demanding service-level agreements.
· Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement as a member of a Scrum team.
· Influence the system architecture, own and implement specific components, and help shape the overall user experience.
You must insist on the highest standards for quality, maintainability, security, and performance as you will ensure that engineering best practices are followed and that software is designed to be highly available, dynamically scalable, and resilient to continuity threats. You are a person with a commitment to team work and who enjoys working on ground breaking technology, is customer obsessed, and thrives on the challenge of building something new that will eventually operate at world-wide scale.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer, and we value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief. Amazon is strongly committed to diversity within its community and especially welcomes applications from South African citizens who are members of designated groups who may contribute to Employment Equity within the workplace and the further diversification of ideas. We are required by law to verify your ability to work lawfully in South Africa. title: Systems Development Manager, ADC2S
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 10, 2026

Seeking a Leader for the Cloud Computing Operations team!

Would you like to drive the systems operations of the world’s largest scale cloud compute platform?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds and operates some of the largest internet infrastructure on the planet; providing companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. With AWS, you can provision compute power, storage, database, and other cloud resources as your business demands them.

We are currently looking for a Systems Engineering and Operations Leader to help us grow our systems organization. You love to work with customers to execute projects and resolve issues. You are a believer in the dev-ops model of service engineering, and you are excited to run operations in an environment where developers don’t toss problems over the wall. And you are happiest when you are working with empowered, world-class engineers to meet world-class challenges. Finally, with your strong ownership bias, you have an infectious desire to continually improve how things are done.  

In this role you will have the opportunity to:
- Lead the deployment and operation of AWS Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) in regions with specialized security needs
- Report on the health of these services at an executive level
- Drive root cause analyses, and coach others on doing them, in collaboration with software development teams, as well as leading local development to improve operational performance
- Drive continual improvement in systems operations through tool building and automation
- Participate in the definition of the roadmap for our services - including brand new ones - in collaboration with our product managers, other development and engineering managers, and engineers
- Define and drive projects and report on their progress
- Meet with customers to develop relationships and clarify requirements and schedules
- Create and refine the staffing and support plan for these regions
- Collaborate with and learn from world leaders in distributed systems development and operations
- Work in an environment where operational excellence is truly the first priority, and where the degree of automation is astounding

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth

title: Security Incident Response Engineer, AWS Security Corporate Response
descriptionHtml:
AWS Corporate Security Response is looking for a Security Engineer who thrives at the intersection of hands-on incident response and intelligent automation. You must think like both an attacker and a defender — understanding adversary tradecraft to detect, investigate, and disrupt threats across Amazon's corporate infrastructure at massive scale.

You'll investigate active threats — malware campaigns, phishing attacks, credential compromise, and novel attack patterns — while simultaneously shaping an agentic investigation platform that scales our response capability beyond what any human team could achieve alone.

You will independently lead security investigations from detection through containment and remediation. You'll extract IOCs, perform host forensics, scope impact across multiple data sources, check for lateral movement, and drive security issues to resolution — documenting every step as the investigation unfolds. You'll also serve as a demanding customer and quality owner of our AI-powered investigation platform, authoring the investigation user stories that define how autonomous agents analyze threats, designing the guardrails that keep them safe, and validating that automated output meets the same standard a skilled human investigator would produce.

When you identify gaps in our capabilities, you won't wait — you'll quickly design and build tooling that enables programmatic automation at scale, then feed those patterns into the next generation of autonomous investigation.

Key job responsibilities
* Lead High Severity security investigations end-to-end: acknowledge, investigate with depth (not speed), document as you go, and own through resolution
* Triage High Severity candidates — promote decisively when indicators are clear, downgrade with documented rationale when they're not
* Analyze open source threat intelligence — these reports contain temporal IOCs that decay with age, making rapid validation and proactive blocking critical
* Author and validate agent investigation user stories, ensuring autonomous investigations match human-quality rigor
* Design and test guardrails and policies — think about how attackers would evade detection, how edge cases produce incorrect results, and how agents might fail in ways developers didn't anticipate
* Build tactical scripts, detection rules, and response automations that address immediate operational gaps — then drive their transition into scalable agentic capabilities
* Participate in a global on-call rotation: own the queue for your shift, monitor operational health, and maintain readiness
* Execute clean shift handoffs: document active investigations, flag anomalies observed during your shift, and explicitly transfer ticket ownership

About the team
CorpSec Response operates 24/7 as a global, follow-the-sun team protecting Amazon's corporate infrastructure. We combine deep human expertise with leading autonomous investigation capabilities. Our engineers are hands-on investigators who also shape the AI systems that augment their work — creating a unique feedback loop between human security expertise and machine-scale automation.

Inclusive Team Culture
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. Amazon's culture of inclusion is reinforced within our Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work-Life Balance
We value sustainable performance. Our follow-the-sun model means you're not carrying a pager 24/7 — your node owns its shift, and clean handoffs are a core operational discipline.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent, or experience in IT Security
- Experience in security operations, incident response, or security engineering
- Hands-on experience investigating security incidents (malware analysis, phishing response, credential compromise, or network intrusion)
- Proficiency in Python or similar scripting language for security automation and tooling
- Experience with log analysis platforms (Splunk, ELK, or equivalent) and EDR tools (CrowdStrike, Carbon Black, or equivalent)
- Knowledge of networking protocols (HTTP, DNS, TCP/IP) and operating system internals (Windows and Linux)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience performing detection engineering in a dedicated or hybrid capacity supporting incident response and threat intelligence operations
- Experience designing or validating AI/LLM-powered automation in a security context
- Proficiency in at least one specialization domain: Malware Analysis / Reverse Engineering; Digital Forensics; Security Tool Development & Automation; Network & OS Security; Identity Management
- Experience with threat intelligence platforms and IOC enrichment (VirusTotal, MITRE ATT&CK framework)
- Track record of building security automation that measurably reduced manual operational burden
- Security certifications (GCIH, GCFA, GREM, OSCP, or equivalent) are a plus but not required

title: Sales Account Manager, Amazon Ads, SEA
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Prime Video, Twitch, IMDb TV, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place!

As a Sales Account Manager on our Ads sales team, you will leverage your sales and programmatic advertising experience to support enterprise self-service clients on the DSP and successfully grow revenue across all solutions. You will own a book of business consisting of the top SEA-based brands who advertise to reach customers globally. In addition to working with clients, you will develop and deepen long term relationship with our enterprise agencies by owning the end to end engagement including: training, onboarding and implementation, campaign setup/optimization, technical support, troubleshooting, and end of campaign reporting.


Key job responsibilities
Client Management & Strategy:

* Own end-to-end client relationships with enterprise self-service advertisers and agencies using Amazon DSP
* Develop and execute annual brand and media strategies aligned with customer objectives
* Hit or exceed assigned revenue targets and business objectives for designated book of business
* Navigate multiple stakeholders while bridging organizational gaps to ensure customer success

Technical Leadership & Support:

* Lead client onboarding, training, and implementation of Amazon DSP
* Serve as primary point of contact for technical support, troubleshooting, and ticket resolution
* Drive strategic consultation on DSP best practices for campaign setup, optimization, and integrations
* Provide first-line escalation support and advocate for clients within Amazon

Performance & Analytics:

* Leverage first-party and third-party data to develop pre-flight, in-flight, and post-flight campaign recommendations
* Design and deliver performance updates and business reviews to key stakeholders
* Educate clients on performance metrics, category trends, and consumer insights
* Create tailored proposals utilizing Amazon Advertising's full-funnel ad products and measurement solutions

Product Development & Innovation:

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product Management, GTM, Sales, and Specialists) to drive platform improvements
* Maintain consistent client feedback loop to help evolve Amazon DSP into a more client-friendly tool
* Identify and communicate growth opportunities to clients and internal teams
* Utilize internal resources effectively to drive customer success and satisfaction

A day in the life
As a Sales Account Manager on the Amazon Ads SEA team, your day might start with reviewing campaign performance dashboards and preparing data-driven recommendations for an upcoming quarterly business review with a key enterprise client. Mid-morning, you could be leading a DSP training session for a newly onboarded agency, walking them through audience targeting strategies and creative best practices. After lunch, you might join a cross-functional sync with the product team to share client feedback on a new feature, then pivot to a strategy call with an advertiser exploring full-funnel campaign expansion. Later in the afternoon, you'll collaborate with your peers to troubleshoot a campaign delivery issue and brainstorm solutions. You'll wrap up the day by updating your account plans and following up on action items to keep your clients on track toward their revenue goals. Every day brings a mix of strategic thinking, hands-on problem solving, and relationship building.

About the team
Amazon Ads SEA team helps brands and agencies across Southeast Asia unlock the full potential of programmatic advertising through Amazon's Demand-Side Platform (DSP). We are a high-performing, collaborative team of account managers, technical specialists, and business development professionals who are passionate about helping enterprise self-service clients grow their businesses. Our team operates at the intersection of advertising technology, data-driven marketing, and customer obsession — partnering closely with product, engineering, and global ads teams to deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable results for our advertisers. We value curiosity, ownership, and a bias for action, and we thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of selling programmatic or data driven ad products or platforms experience
- 4+ years of marketing, brand advertising, media sales or online advertising work and close work with senior advertisers and agency stakeholders experience
- Experience in DSP/ad network sales
- Experience aggregating and analyzing internal and external campaign metrics to assess performance drivers and identify insights
- Experience working with South East Asia (SEA)-based brands, advertisers, or agencies, with a strong understanding of the SEA digital advertising landscape

Preferred qualifications

- Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)
- Experience working with cross-border or export advertisers, helping brands reach international audiences through programmatic or digital advertising channels
- Fluency or professional proficiency in at least one South East Asian language (e.g., Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, Vietnamese, Tagalog, Malay) in addition to English
- Consultative sales experience, with a demonstrated ability to understand client business objectives and translate them into tailored advertising solutions
- Experience designing and delivering scalable 1:many enablement programmes (e.g., advertiser education, partner training, or sales enablement initiatives) to drive adoption across a broad customer base

title: Learning & Development Coach, MX, Leader Coaching Team (LCT)
descriptionHtml:
The Learning & Development Coach role within the Leader Coaching Team (LCT) provides superior facilitation and coaching across Worldwide Operations (WWOPs) leaders. They are responsible for facilitating remote and in-person learning experiences to support leader development for all Global Operations Learning and Development (GOLD) Programs. They partner with stakeholders, Program Managers (PMs), Learning Business Partners (LBPs), and Operations stakeholders to execute holistic solutions considering both an optimal learning experience and business needs. In addition to assisting in the ongoing development and facilitation of skills of peers, the L&D Coach also helps prepare and provide feedback to business presenters. They apply high standards for coaching effectiveness, demonstrating ethical practice and a client-centered coaching mindset.

Consultation, Solution Implementation, & Delivery: With emphasis on Earn Trust, the L&D Coach cultivates partnerships with participants and stakeholders to gather information and data to make necessary changes to evolve and improve the Instructor-Led-Training (ILT) and Remote-Instructor-Led-Training (VILT) experience. They enable the delivery of learning, utilizing technology and providing the learner with specific examples that address real-life scenarios applicable to their daily responsibilities. The L&D Coach identifies what types of information respond well via the ILT/VILT modality. As a result, Invent and Simplify will be a strategic component to success within the role and in future growth within LCT.

They are trained and/or experienced with delivering and providing relatable examples when facilitating DEI or leading inclusive content. For example, during each module/course introduction they lay the foundation to establish DEI policies and expectations. This individual also ensures learners, and business presenters all have safe and inclusive learning environment within each program, through the diversity of course materials and accessibility of the content; i.e., inclusive terminology.

Measuring Learning Impact: The L&D Coach requires Learn & Be Curious and Dive Deep by working backwards through the needs of the learner with a scientific approach using adult learning theory in the delivery, develop, and evaluate phases of program life-cycles. This person works with PMs and Business Intelligence (BI) to improve the quality of learning solutions. In developing facilitation solutions, the L&D Coach plans for the unexpected and proactively manages risks (i.e., technological fallback, business presenter mishaps, and audience disengagement). The L&D Coach ensures success metrics are in place for measuring projects, evaluating Business Presenters and analyzing survey engagement feedback. This person uses data analytics to create and monitor dashboards and consults with PMs to identify stakeholder key performance indicators and drives to meet goals.

Key job responsibilities
- Deliver instructor-led trainings (in-person and remote) programs. Must be able to facilitate high quality learner-focused programs which have informative content and engaging learning techniques and environment.
- Upskill, train, coach, and provide feedback to business presenters to ensure that these colleagues can deliver the same high quality training so that customers receive the appropriate learning outcomes.
- Partner with key customers and stakeholders (Program Managers, Learning Business Partners, and Operations leaders) in order to assess, understand, and provide GOLD support towards a number of different leadership development training programs.
- Identify, scope, and deliver individual and team-based projects to better suit the changing needs of the business and our customers.
- Develop, analyze, and interpret data, feedback, and results of training to assess level of competency gained in order to provide and communicate updates to stakeholders in addition to developing training sessions and products through continuous improvement.
- Develop products and solutions through independent and collaborative projects in order to address the fast-paced and dynamic needs of the business.
- This is position is located in São Paulo - SP Brazil
- Candidate must be willing to travel up to 75% of the time.

A day in the life
Approximately, 75% of the time would be spent in facilitation of various programs. 25% of the time would be spent on Project Management and Stakeholder Management.About the team
The Leader Coaching Team (LCT) coaches and develops leaders to effectively grow their skills and capabilities through a continuous leadership journey. We are development experts dedicated to the engagement, growth, and retention of WW Ops leaders. Our global approach to coaching and facilitation provides the knowledge, tools and techniques to better lead their teams.

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

descriptionHtml:

アマゾンジャパンでは、専門施工業者（Service Provider）と連携して商品の設置・組み立てを提供する「non-UDS（Non-Unified Delivery Services）」プログラムのプログラムマネージャーを募集しています。エアコン工事、水栓設置、スマートロック、ドライブレコーダー取り付け、壁掛けテレビなど、Customerが自分では難しい施工を、購入と同時にシームレスに予約・完了できる体験を作ることが私たちのミッションです。

Would you like to build a service experience that goes beyond delivery — one that takes responsibility all the way through installation?
Amazon Japan is hiring a Program Manager for its non-UDS (Non-Unified Delivery Services) program, which partners with professional Service Providers (SPs) to offer installation and assembly services — air conditioners, faucets, smart locks, dashcams, wall-mount TVs, and more — seamlessly bundled with product purchase.
This role sits within the Amazon Logistics Extra Large Team (AMXL) and leads SP relationship management, service category expansion, and continuous Customer experience improvement.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities / 主な職務内容
プログラムマネージャーとして、専門施工業者（SP）との関係を軸に、以下の業務全般をリードします。

施工業者の管理・立ち上げ
・新規施工業者の発掘・コスト交渉・契約締結
・既存施工業者の週次パフォーマンスレビューと改善指示（最速予約可能日・日程変更率・初回完工率などを管理）

サービスカテゴリの管理

・取り付けサービスを提供する対象商品の管理（追加・削除）
・サービス選択フローの設計・最適化による現地での追加料金発生の削減
・新カテゴリのローンチロードマップ策定と実行

日常オペレーションの管理
・施工業者のサービス提供エリア・稼働枠の設定サポート
・試験稼働の実施・段階的ローンチ計画の立案
・カスタマーサービス・社内サポート向け作業マニュアルの作成・改訂

カスタマーエクスペリエンスの改善
・Customerレビュー・問い合わせデータの分析と改善策立案
・AIを活用したサービス選択フローの精度向上（2027年計画）
・サービス品質指標（初回完工率・日程変更率・Customerレビュー）のモニタリング

﻿-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
As a Program Manager, you will lead the following across partner management, service operations, and Customer experience.
・Build and manage relationships with professional installation partners across categories including air conditioning, plumbing, smart locks, dashcams, and TV mounting
・Lead weekly partner performance reviews, track key metrics (earliest appointment availability, rescheduling rate, first-visit completion rate), and drive improvement actions
・Own partner onboarding end-to-end: recruiting, cost negotiation, contract execution, and setup of service area and capacity management
・Manage service configuration, service page creation, and service option flow design to reduce unexpected on-site charges
・Handle partner and support team inquiry escalations; coordinate resolutions across Customer Service and product planning teams
・Create and revise operational manuals for Customer Service and support teams
・Drive service category expansion roadmap; manage phased launches with trial operations
・Analyze Customer review data and develop experience improvement plans (including 2027 AI-assisted service scoping initiative)

A day in the life
朝は前日のパフォーマンスデータの確認から始まります。日程変更率が上昇している施工業者があればすぐに原因を特定し、対応を調整します。

午前中は施工業者との週次定例で、稼働不足の解消策と新エリアの拡大計画を議論します。昼過ぎは商品企画チームと新カテゴリ（例：ガス周り施工）のローンチに向けたサービス選択フローの設計を検討。夕方は社内サポート窓口からエスカレーションされたサービス表示のトラブルを調査し、翌日の作業マニュアル更新につなげます。単なる「問題対応」ではなく、「次回は現場で自己解決できる仕組みを作る」という視点で動き続けます。

Each day starts with a review of previous-day performance data. If rescheduling rates are spiking for a particular partner, you quickly identify root causes and coordinate fixes. Morning brings a weekly sync with a partner to discuss staffing shortfalls and new area expansion.
In the afternoon, you work with the product planning team on service option flow design for a new category launch. In the evening, you investigate a service display issue escalated from the support team, then update the operational manual. The mindset is never just "fix the issue" — it's always "build the system so the field can solve it next time."

About the team
我々は施工業者・Amazon・Customerの三者全員にとって「良い仕組み」を作ることに情熱を持つチームです。オペレーションとビジネスの境界を越えて動くことを楽しめる人を求めています。経験よりも「なぜそうなっているのか」を問い続ける姿勢と、現場・データ・関係者の声を束ねて前進できる実行力を重視します。

We are a team passionate about building systems that work well for installation partners, Amazon, and Customers alike. We value people who enjoy moving across the boundaries of operations and business — those who keep asking "why does it work this way?" and who can synthesize the voices of the field, data, and stakeholders into forward momentum.

- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese

title: Controls Colo Regional Engineer, Colo Regional Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Controls Colo Engineer, you will work with internal business teams and with colocation vendors to identify, document, and resolve any operational/design deficiencies which could impact a site’s capability or availability. You will provide full life-cycle support to Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:
• Work in close relationship with the control team of DCE Colocation Design and Standards (CoDeS) to develop and implement new and existing standards.
• Perform design and equipment submittal review for Controls for new Colo Data Centers in the region in order to ensure consistent standards across Colocation Data Centers and AWS owned sites.
• Review and Identify risks within the scope of Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) for in-flight AWS Colo Data Centers.
• Review and identify risks within automation controls drawings and wiring diagrams, the controls logic programming and the graphical user interface.
• Review and accept proposed changes to the site-specific control infrastructure against AWS Data Center standards, and document accepted deviations when appropriate.
• Review Colo and Hybrid controls sequence of operation and provide feedback to design.
• Support the design for existing Colo Data Center control system upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.
• Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures related to control equipment.
• Conduct site audits of Colo Data Centers, including producing reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation.
• Support construction, commissioning, and turnover for Controls for any new construction projects (could be remote with local Colo Engineer presence).

Key job responsibilities
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As a Controls Colo Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out the data centers we support to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate, you:
• Possess Strong Engineering judgment and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty
• Detail- and data oriented
• Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.
• Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Business Development, Operations, Commissioning, Operations)
• Be inclined to get into the field to see things up close.

A day in the life
A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

About the team
We are a collaborative group of engineering professionals dedicated to maintaining and advancing the standards that keep our data centers operating at peak performance. Our team works closely with the Colocation Design and Standards group to develop and implement controls solutions that ensure consistency across our infrastructure. We serve both internal business teams and external colocation partners, with a shared commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement. As we expand our global data center footprint, we're looking for someone who can help us scale our controls expertise while maintaining the high standards our business depends on.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of industrial controls and automation experience, or Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent
- Bilingual communication — fluent Japanese and business-level English communication skills

Preferred qualifications

- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
- Experience with design, configuration, or servicing, one or more of the following products; Siemens: Apogee, Honeywell: Building Controls, Trend: Building Controls, Schneider Electric: PowerLogic/Struxureware, Rockwell Automation: FactoryTalk, Tridium: Niagra, Eaton: Foreseer, ABB: Decathalon, Johnson Controls: Metasys

title: Senior-Manager/in für Arbeitssicherheit, Workplace Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Bei Amazon brauchen wir talentierte und erfahrene Kolleg:innen, die uns helfen, unseren Betrieb sicher und effizient zu führen. Als Senior Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager:in bist Du maßgeblich daran beteiligt, strategische Verbesserungen an Deinen Standorten und auf regionaler Ebene voranzutreiben. Du leitest und entwickelst Dein Team, setzt die Sicherheitsagenda und arbeitest mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen, um eine Kultur der Sicherheit und Inklusion in Deinem Verantwortungsbereich zu verankern.

Key job responsibilities
Leitung der Teams vor Ort und bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zur Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Arbeitsschutzgesetzen, Richtlinien und Unternehmensrichtlinien.
Verwendung interner Reporting-Tools zur Datenanalyse und Bereitstellung von Informationen für die Unternehmensführung zur Unterstützung sicherheitsrelevanter Entscheidungen.
Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Pflege von Sicherheitsschulungsprogrammen, Ergonomie-Initiativen und Präventionsprogrammen zur Verbesserung der Sicherheitskultur.
Durchführung von Risikobewertungen für neue Prozesse und Maschinen, Überprüfung von Änderungen an standardisierten Prozessen und Aktualisierung bestehender Risikobewertungen.
Förderung des Engagements für Arbeitsschutzmaßnahmen bei Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden zur Stärkung einer soliden Sicherheitskultur.

A day in the life
Dies ist eine äußerst vielseitige Rolle an einem unserer Standorte, die Dir ermöglicht, direkt zu vielen Aspekten unserer Sicherheitskultur beizutragen. Du verwaltest die Arbeitsschutzstandards und verbesserst gleichzeitig Funktionalität und Effizienz. Außerdem leitest Du Dein Team und hilfst bei der Umsetzung von Änderungen basierend auf Mitarbeiterfeedback oder bei der Nutzung von Möglichkeiten zur kontinuierlichen Prozessverbesserung.

Deine Rolle ist entscheidend für die Sicherheit der Mitarbeitenden, die Verwaltung ihrer Zufriedenheit und die Überwachung ihres Wohlbefindens und ihrer Produktivität. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Arbeitssicherheit und förderst eine Kultur des sicheren Arbeitens.

About the team
Das Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Team spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewährleistung des mentalen und körperlichen Wohlbefindens unserer Mitarbeitenden am Arbeitsplatz. Unser Team arbeitet mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitenden und lokalen Behörden an allen unseren Standorten zusammen, um die Einhaltung der Amazon-Richtlinien und gesetzlichen Vorschriften sicherzustellen und die Sicherheit unserer Arbeitsumgebungen zu gewährleisten. Das Team bietet vielfältige Möglichkeiten — von Safety Technicians bis hin zu Programm Manager:innen. Unabhängig von Deiner Position trägst Du zur Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Sicherheitsstrategie im gesamten Netzwerk bei.

Basic qualifications

- Ein Bachelorabschluss oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation entsprechend dem Europäischen Qualifikationsrahmen (EQF)
- Zertifizierung als Sicherheitsfachkraft (gemäß ASchG §§73–77).
- Kenntnis der österreichischen Arbeitsschutzgesetzgebung.
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Leitung eines Teams.
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (B2), in Wort und Schrift.

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung mit Lean-, 5S- oder Kaizen-Methoden.
- Erfahrung in der Planung oder Durchführung umweltbewusster Initiativen.
- Mitgliedschaft in einem Berufsverband im Bereich Arbeitsschutz.
- Erfahrung in der Führung und Kommunikation mit einer Vielzahl von Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kolleg:innen, Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften.

title: AI Program Lead, OTR Planning
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is seeking an experienced candidate to identify, create, develop and integrate innovative solutions and programs that lead to improvements in our last mile delivery network and drive AI adoption across corporate and frontline teams. This role will focus on building the culture, tools, and measurement systems that make AI part of daily work, prioritizing based on real team needs rather than a fixed technology mandate. A successful candidate will be able to deliver measurable gains in adoption, efficiency, and cost avoidance across Amazon Logistics, OTR Planning. This individual will be expected to activate and coach a Champion network, manage a use-case pipeline from idea to launch, and report progress to senior leadership on a recurring cadence. Judgment on which tools actually solve a team's problem is paramount, along with strong program management and stakeholder influence skills. In this role you will be responsible for adoption strategy and culture change, use-case prioritization and delivery in partnership with Orbit, and impact measurement and reporting.

title: Audit Manager - Advertising, Risk & Internal Audit
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited by the opportunity to partner with Amazon’s business and engineering teams to identify risks, solve complex problems, and drive meaningful improvements? This role offers the chance to apply technical expertise, risk assessment, and data analytics skills while gaining exposure to a broad range of innovative businesses and technologies.

We are seeking an experienced IT Audit Manager to join our Devices, Advertising, and Media & Entertainment Internal Audit team. In this high-visibility role, you will lead operational and technical audits across diverse businesses, providing independent insights that help strengthen controls, improve processes, and support sound decision-making.

You will be responsible for planning, executing, and reporting risk-based audits, developing a deep understanding of complex business processes, technologies, and regulatory requirements. Working closely with engineers, product leaders, and business stakeholders, you will evaluate risks across operations, compliance, policy, and technology, and translate those risks into practical, business-focused recommendations.

Success in this role requires strong analytical, project management, and communication skills. You must be able to navigate ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and communicate complex issues clearly to senior leadership while driving alignment on effective risk mitigation strategies. You need to be a good coach and mentor and deliver through people, as for every audit/project, you will be managing a small team of auditors.

We value intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, creativity, and a bias for action.

Travel of up to 10–20%, including international travel, may be required.

Key job responsibilities
- Is an excellent project manager who can work independently to conduct audits from beginning to end, manage stakeholders, and often managing multiple projects at the same time.
- Results-oriented leader ability to motivate, manage, and drive consensus across diverse teams
- Has exceptional analytical skills to identify problems and work on process to address the root cause of the problems.
- Is able to prioritize effectively and drive cross-functional remediation efforts focusing on the highest risks and ensure problems stay fixed.
- Is able to dive deep to identify root cause of control gaps, inefficiencies and exceptions.
- Delivers on the highest standards by challenging assumptions and supporting with data.
- Can identify opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify Internal Audit tools and processes.
- Is able to support and advocate for a culture of risk management, strong controls, and effective operations.
- Is an excellent writer who can succinctly communicate complicated technical issues.
- Can quickly become familiar with stakeholders business challenges and risks and act as a trusted advisor to them while leading change, dealing with ambiguity among cross functional teams.

A day in the life
• Lead a portfolio of audits: Plan, scope, and deliver multiple concurrent audits and advisory engagements across different business areas, balancing depth with efficiency and adapting to shifting business priorities.
• Own the audit roadmap for your sub-portfolio: Conduct continuous risk assessments across your business areas, identify the highest-impact audit topics, and influence the team's annual audit plan.
• Manage and develop auditors: Direct the work of audit teams, including Senior IT Auditors and IT Auditors. Coach team members, set the bar for quality, and grow the next generation of audit leaders.
• Understand the business behind the systems: Develop and maintain a clear view of how products and platforms operate, generate value, and scale — and where failures would have the greatest impact on customers, revenue, regulatory standing, or operations.
• Assess risk in context: Evaluate areas such as access management, data security, system reliability, software development practices, and emerging-technology controls — focusing on what truly matters to the business rather than applying controls mechanically.
• Use data to inform conclusions: Apply analytical thinking and direct (or oversee) data analysis to identify trends, validate controls, and support risk assessments at scale.
• Translate technical and business issues into business impact: Clearly articulate how risks affect customers, revenue, regulatory exposure, or operational performance — for audiences ranging from engineers to the Audit Committee.
• Influence and partner with senior stakeholders: Build standing relationships with VPs, Directors, and senior engineering leaders. Drive alignment on risks and on practical, scalable solutions, including where stakeholders push back.
• Drive meaningful outcomes: Ensure audit findings lead to real improvements, not just reports. Hold a high bar for closure and validate that risks have been mitigated.
• Raise the bar for the team: Contribute to audit methodology, team operating mechanisms, and the development of audit standards across DMAAC and broader Internal Audit.


About the team
Our teams leads Internal Audit for the new and fast growing businesses of Amazon - Devices, Advertising, Media & Entertainment, AGI/Annapurna and all the Corporate Functions. We audit across a wide gamut of business risks spanning Financial, Regulatory, Reputational, Operational & Technical Efficiency.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Economics, Information Management, Information Systems, or other related discipline
- 8+ years of experience in roles involving technology and commercial/financial acumen, finance/tech business partnering, IT audit, risk management, information security, business or tech consulting or related fields.
- Advanced Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (esp. MS Excel, Word) at an advanced level, and data analytics and AI tools

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent
- 10+ years of experience in IT audit, risk management, information security, technology consulting, or related fields.
- Familiarity with modern technology environments (Cloud, distributed systems, data platforms) and Experience with  AI/ML systems, including generative AI tools and platforms.
- Experience using data and analytics to drive business decisions and business outcomes
- Experience in consulting, Big 4, or large technology companies.
- Strong comfort with understanding Tech architecture, Coding, and ability to use AI Tools
- Strong communication and articulation skills

title: Software Development Manager, Ring
descriptionHtml:
As a Software Development Manager at Ring, you will be responsible for leading a team of engineers working on embedded software and firmware used in Ring and Blink devices. A successful candidate will have strong technical skills, excellent project management skills, great communication skills, and a motivation to achieve results in a fast-paced environment.

You will work closely with other platform, hardware, operations, user-space, and quality assurance teams.

Ring and Blink devices sit on millions of front doors and in millions of homes. Your team builds and sustains the firmware behind those cameras and doorbells: the code that wakes a battery-powered device, streams video over wireless links, and updates itself in the field without a visit from a technician. Your decisions reach customers directly, from what ships in the next over-the-air release to when a rollout is stopped.

Key responsibilities:
- Ownership of the overall systems development life cycle.
- Execution against project plans and timely delivery of committed results.
- Management of day-to-day activities of the engineering team within an Agile/Scrum environment.
- Management of departmental resources, staffing, and mentoring.
- Building, enhancing and maintaining an engineering team.
- Working closely with engineers to architect and develop the best technical designs.
- Report on status of development, quality, operations, and system performance to management.
- Maintenance and enhancement of software frameworks for development.


Key job responsibilities
- Lead a team of ~12 firmware engineers in Gdańsk delivering embedded software for Ring and Blink cameras and doorbells, from feature development to sustaining releases of products already in customers' homes.
- Own the release train for your products: scope, schedule, OTA rollout decisions, rollback calls, and the quality metrics behind them (device offline rate, live view success, reboots, battery).
- Drive the convergence of our device firmware onto a common platform and codebase, and the handover of launched products into sustaining.
- Drive AI-native engineering in the team: own the adoption of coding agents and AI review tooling, set the targets (share of changes produced and reviewed with AI, cycle time, defect escape rate) and report progress to leadership.
- Hire, develop and retain engineers; set clear expectations, run regular 1:1s and growth conversations, build a bench of senior engineers.
- Partner with product, TPM, QA, cloud and hardware teams in Poland and the US; represent the team to senior leadership with clear written status.

About the team
Ring & Blink Firmware in Gdańsk is a 150+ engineer organisation building the firmware for Ring and Blink cameras, doorbells and sync modules sold worldwide. This team owns the firmware platform and the releases for launched products. We value ownership, decisions backed by data, and engineers who operate with AI agents as part of how they build, review and test. The manager is part of that team, works with the same tools, and sets the direction for how far AI takes the team next.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience leading embedded software or firmware development for connected consumer devices

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in hiring, developing and promoting engineering talent

- Experience with battery-powered, Wi-Fi/BLE camera or video devices and their quality metrics
- Experience adopting generative AI developer tooling in a team's workflow and measuring its impact

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Deal Lead for the Strategic Customer Engagements (SCE) team.

SCE is a specialized global deal team that engages with commercial and public sector customers on deal strategy, structuring, and negotiations through contractual closure for transformational, strategic, large, complex, and/or highly competitive opportunities such as GenAI. This is a unique opportunity to engage with AWS customers on strategic opportunities, increase the growth of AWS, and to establish AWS as their key cloud technology provider. These opportunities range across industry verticals, such as Financial Services, Telecommunications, Media & Entertainment, Energy, Healthcare Life Sciences, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Public Sector, and customer size (from start-ups to enterprise customers). These engagements may also involve Pan-Amazon and AWS go-to-market opportunities involving close partnership between the SCE team and other Amazon and AWS stakeholders.

As a Deal Lead, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end deal cycle for strategic, large, complex, or highly competitive deals. You will focus on building trust with customers by creating actionable strategies, developing and shaping opportunities, and leading deal engagements through negotiations and closure. This highly visible role will own engagement with customer C-level executives, IT teams, and multiple lines of business to achieve business outcomes, increase the adoption of AWS services, and to enable private pricing, go-to-market, and other strategic relationships. You will work collaboratively to drive results by partnering with AWS customers, AWS field sales executives, and other internal stakeholders to empower our customers to evolve, address challenges, and create innovative solutions.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead negotiations and drive customer closure for strategic, large, complex, or highly competitive deals, including GenAI opportunities, managing the end-to-end deal cycle from strategy through contractual completion
- Develop and shape overall deal strategy, structure, and pricing approaches to meet customer business outcomes and goals, while identifying and resolving deal blockers
- Collaborate closely with Americas regional sales teams and global stakeholders — including Service Teams, Finance, and Legal — to align resources, remove obstacles, and achieve desired business outcomes
- Act as a trusted advisor to AWS Field Sales Executives on commercial strategy, partnering in the execution of the sales cycle for strategic and highly competitive opportunities
- Present deal proposals to customers and communicate the AWS value proposition, influencing alignment with internal stakeholders and experts to drive revenue growth and cloud adoption

A day in the life
Your primary focus is guiding complex, high-value deals from initial strategy through signed agreement. You might start the morning reviewing a deal proposal with a solutions architect, then join a call with a customer's procurement team to work through commercial terms. After lunch you could be collaborating with Finance and Legal to finalize pricing structures, followed by preparing a narrative for senior leadership on a competitive opportunity. Throughout, you balance independent analysis with real-time collaboration across sales, service, and business teams to keep deals moving forward.

About the team
The Strategic Customer Engagements team at AWS partners with customers across industries to structure and close some of the most impactful cloud deals in the market. We operate at the intersection of sales strategy, deal structuring, and customer relationships, working alongside field sales, service teams, and cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes that matter. Our team values creative problem-solving, clear communication, and a collaborative approach. We are focused on expanding our reach across the Americas and continuing to help customers accelerate their cloud adoption journey.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Identity and Registry, AWS IoT Core
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

AWS IoT Core enables billions of devices to connect securely to the cloud — and the Identity and Registry team is at the heart of it. We own the foundational primitives that give every IoT device its identity, manage its metadata, and govern how it interacts with the cloud at massive scale.

As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that customers rely on to provision, authenticate, and manage their IoT fleets — from a single prototype to billions of devices in production. You'll work on challenges spanning distributed systems, security, identity management, and scalable metadata storage and retrieval, directly shaping the experience for some of the world's largest IoT deployments.

This is a high-impact role where your work will be felt across the entire AWS IoT platform and by customers spanning multiple industries — from smart home and automotive to broadcasting and industrial automation. If you're excited about building foundational infrastructure that operates at Internet of Things scale and solving hard problems in device identity and registry, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain core services that power device identity and state management for AWS IoT Core, serving billions of devices worldwide
- Build and operate highly available, low-latency distributed systems that handle device provisioning, authentication, metadata and state management
- Own the full software development lifecycle — from requirements gathering and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate in code reviews to maintain a high engineering bar across the team
- Contribute to system architecture by authoring and reviewing design documents, identifying trade-offs, and proposing solutions to complex technical problems
- Improve operational excellence by building monitoring, alarming, and automation tooling; participate in on-call rotations and drive root cause analysis for operational events
- Collaborate cross-functionally with other AWS IoT teams to deliver integrated customer experiences
- Mentor and support fellow engineers through knowledge sharing, design discussions, and constructive code reviews
- Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, developer productivity, and system efficiency, including leveraging AI to automate workflows, enhance testing, and accelerate delivery

A day in the life
You'll spend focused time writing code — building new APIs, tuning system performance to reduce latency at billion-device scale, or improving provisioning workflows. You'll collaborate with teammates through design reviews and code reviews, and partner with other IoT Core teams on cross-cutting features. Some days you'll dig into customer escalations, tracing issues through logs and metrics. Other days you'll experiment with AI tools to improve engineering processes. No two days are the same, but every day you're building the foundation that enables billions of devices to connect to AWS IoT.

The Identity and Registry team owns the foundational services at the core of AWS IoT — device identity, registry, shadow, and provisioning. We build and operate systems that enable billions of devices to securely connect, be managed, and interact with the cloud. Our team values operational excellence, customer obsession, and a strong ownership culture where every engineer has a direct impact. We're a collaborative group that enjoys tackling hard distributed systems problems together, and we're committed to growing each other through mentorship and open technical debate. We're looking for builders who are excited to work at IoT scale.

title: Electrical Engineer, Sustainability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Sustainability Engineering team is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to drive the definition, development, and continuous improvement of electrical infrastructure standards across Amazon facilities in Europe.

You will join a team which:
• Enables EV charging infrastructure implementation through electrical design definition and review
• Develops grid infrastructure standards spanning high-voltage up to 24 kV (HV) and low-voltage (LV) systems, ensuring a coordinated and resilient approach to grid design
• Explores emerging technologies to address evolving sustainability needs, with emphasis on smart grid integration, efficiency, and resilience
• Drives end-to-end deployment of EV chargers and other sustainability technologies across European sites
• Defines processes for procurement and maintenance of electrical and sustainability infrastructure
• Owns cost budgeting, forecasting, and tracking across sustainability programmes

Possible locations for this role: Luxembourg, London, Munich, Milan, Madrid, and Barcelona

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge, we committed to achieving net-zero carbon across our business by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement. To get there, we need driven people who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact through sustainable energy technologies and scalable infrastructure design.

Key job responsibilities
• Own and develop electrical equipment standards, including standard designs for core electrical infrastructure in partnership with manufacturers and internal stakeholders
• Perform design validation and review to ensure compliance with established electrical standards during installation and commissioning of infrastructure
• Act as subject matter expert (SME) for LV and HV (up to 24kV) electrical systems
• Align stakeholder expectations and define technical requirements for EV charging network infrastructure and smart grid deployments
• Drive the technology roadmap for electrical infrastructure, including EV chargers, substations, energy efficiency solutions, and IoT technologies (e.g. smart metres)
• Develop business cases and present recommendations to leadership to secure approval for programme scoping and investment decisions
• Coordinate with programme managers to ensure quality and standards compliance across large-scale installations
• Drive process improvement across commissioning, audit, value engineering, and cost control activities


A day in the life
Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organisation and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short-, mid-, and long-term technical decisions with large-scale impact across the Amazon network. You will also work with partners from Operations, Reliability & Maintenance, Health and Safety, Global Fleet Product, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to design and deploy electrical infrastructure across Amazon’s operational sites in Europe.

About the team
The Sustainability Engineering team drives the execution and deployment of EV charging infrastructure, grid connections, and smart grid solutions across Amazon’s European sites. We manage supply chain, procurement, and maintenance activities, and define the processes that ensure consistent, scalable delivery. To enable this, the team develops and continuously improves electrical standards and technologies that underpin reliable, compliant deployment at pace. We power Amazon’s sustainable growth through operational excellence and continuous innovation.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business
- Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent
- Experience in Design/Innovation, research & development, manufacturing, process, industrial engineering, or related work
- Experience in management of engineering design projects
- Experience using business or technical software like MS Excel, MS Project, and CAD software

- Master's degree in Engineering (any domain), Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
- Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, electronic system design, and decision making
- Experience working with the designs of complex automated material, handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems including robotics and high-speed manufacturing

title: Site HR Partner Manager, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever wanted to be part of a team building industry-changing technology? At Leo, we are building a low Earth orbit satellite network that will deliver broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities. Come join one of Amazon's most ambitious bets, with customers like Delta Airlines, JetBlue, AT&T, and others already committed ahead of commercial launch.
We are seeking an HRP Manager to lead the Site HR Partners who serve Leo's Production Operations (ProdOps) organization. You will own the standards the team operates against and the forward-looking model for how site HRP partnership evolves as the business grows. Every satellite is a one-way-door decision, and the pace demands manager excellence as a precondition to mission success.
This is not a standard corporate HR role. ProdOps is 24/7 aerospace manufacturing, where technicians build every satellite the business pushes to Launch Services, and where the managers your team serves are navigating the intersection of Amazon's people culture with the operational discipline of building satellites. Many are external hires with deep technical expertise who are still building fluency in how Amazon develops people, or Amazon veterans encountering manufacturing realities for the first time. Site HRPs deliver capabilities not found in traditional corporate HRP roles: proactive sentiment reading through weekly floor walks and Gembas, time-sensitive labor relations work in a high ER/LR environment, round-the-clock shift coverage, and direct coaching on how to lead where the stakes are measured in millions of dollars per week.
In this role, you will directly manage a team of Site HRPs across the production sites and shifts, and you will own their development end to end: coaching their strategic judgment, functional skill, and advisory craft so they operate as independent partners rather than conduits. You will think ahead of the business, anticipating what the workforce and the Site HRP model need to look like at scale and building toward that before the demand arrives. As the network grows to establish dedicated presence across sites, extends into evening and overnight coverage, and absorbs net-new facility stand-ups, your central charge is to make sure the team on the floor is developed, consistent, operating to one standard, and ready for what comes next.
This role reports to the Sr. HRP Manager (Leo), who owns the integrated Corp, Site, and Launch Services HRP delivery model and the multi-year ProdOps HRP strategy. You own the site HRP strategy, how the team is developed, and how the model scales within that framework. The role requires regular travel to production sites to work alongside your team, understand evolving business challenges, and maintain strong relationships with operational leadership.


Key job responsibilities
• Lead and Develop the Site HRP Team. Directly manage a team of Site HRPs supporting the hourly manufacturing workforce across production sites and shifts. Demonstrate a clear understanding of the performance and leadership bar and apply it to hiring and talent decisions. Provide regular coaching and feedback that grows each HRP’s strategic judgment, functional skill, and leadership capability, and build a team that delivers with increasing independence as the network scales.
• Own Site HRP Ways of Working and the Standard of Excellence. Define and run the frameworks, mechanisms, and quality standards the Site HRP team operates against, including how floor walks, Gembas, structured listening, and case work are delivered consistently across every site and shift. Build the inspection mechanisms that ensure advisory quality, sound judgment, and timely closure across the team’s portfolio.
• Deliver Consistent, High-Quality Manager Guidance Across Sites and Shifts. Own the Site HRP team’s metrics and the manager customer experience. Review the guidance and case work the team handles to ensure quality, sound judgment, and timely closure, and coach the team to synthesize inputs into action and communicate risk proactively. The scope of guidance spans performance management, employee relations, talent decisions, compensation guidance, policy consultation, and crisis support.
• Build Manager Capability Through Scalable Mechanisms. Design and run scalable mechanisms that build manager capability over time (manager enablement, structured coaching such as Seek to Understand, and proactive insight tools) so ProdOps managers lead effective teams with growing confidence and self-sufficiency, strengthening the manager population rather than resolving one case at a time.
• Partner on Employee Relations Strategy and Prevention. Partner with GCER and Legal and provide guidance and oversight to the team on ER cases, ensuring sound judgment, timely closure, and adherence to a high bar on ER metrics. Set the standard for how the team navigates complex workplace investigations and uses embedded floor presence to resolve concerns before they escalate into formal cases.
• Scale the Site HRP Model Without Ground-Up Rebuilds. As the Site network grows (dedicated presence across sites, extended evening and overnight coverage, and net-new facility stand-ups), build the onboarding, coverage, and ways-of-working standards that absorb growth without rebuilding from scratch, ensuring coverage and development are operational ahead of each new site’s first technicians.
• Measure, Inspect, and Advance AI-First Delivery. Translate operational data into systemic insight through dashboards and trend analysis that surface employee-experience signal before it becomes escalation, and champion AI-first ways of working (for example Amazon Quick and self-service through Aza) that shift team capacity from reactive case handling toward proactive, capability-building advisory work.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
- 7+ years of relevant Human Resources Generalist experience
- 2+ years of management experience implementing processes and delivering core HR solutions in large-scale and complex environments
- Experience coaching and developing HR professionals and building team capability
- Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
- Experience leading or developing HR teams across multiple sites and shifts, including 24/7 or non-standard coverage environments
- Experience supporting manufacturing, aerospace, or hardware engineering organizations with both exempt and non-exempt populations
- Experience driving consistency and ways of working across a distributed team through influence as well as direct management
