title: Sr. Tax Manager - WHT Controllership, Foreign Reporting and Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Senior Tax Manager to lead the Controllership team within our Global Withholding Tax (WHT) organization. In this role you will bridge tax expertise, process innovation, and technology to solve complex challenges at scale, directly influencing how Amazon manages withholding tax compliance across markets worldwide.

You will set the strategy for how Amazon identifies, assesses, and strengthens withholding tax controls — evaluating and re-engineering existing processes, designing control and testing frameworks, and leading the global FAS-5 (ASC 450) process for withholding taxes on external-party payments. This is a people-leadership role: you will manage and develop a team of subject matter experts across global regions, operate independently in ambiguous, multi-jurisdictional environments, and influence partners across tax, finance, and technology.




Key job responsibilities
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of withholding tax controllership experts across global regions.
- Own the design and execution of control and assurance testing frameworks, including differentiated approaches for intercompany and third-party payee withholding tax streams.
- Lead the global FAS-5 (ASC 450) process for withholding taxes on external-party payments, partnering with Accounting to document and assess accruals.
- Interpret testing outcomes, collaborate with Tax Planning and Compliance to agree findings, and oversee remediation actions through to closure.
- Develop executive-level reporting and dashboards providing visibility into control health, testing coverage, and remediation status.
- Drive the evolution toward scalable, technology-enabled controllership, including automated testing and AI-assisted assurance workflows.
- Monitor the controllership impact of regulatory and treaty changes, proactively updating control frameworks.


A day in the life
No two days look the same. You will split your time between leading assurance activities with your team, advising on controls for new market launches and system changes, presenting findings and improvement proposals to senior leadership, and collaborating with technology partners on automation initiatives. Throughout, you coach a globally distributed team and work across the boundaries of tax compliance, controls design, and technology delivery.

About the team
The Global Withholding Tax team is responsible for income tax withholding compliance and reporting for global intercompany and third-party payee transactions. The Controllership team provides independent oversight, assurance testing, and control governance that strengthen withholding tax compliance.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of strong understanding of tax compliance principles, regulations, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions
- Experience analyzing and reviewing statutes, regulations, and case law and then extracting data to make appropriate recommendations
- Experience in taxation in a corporate environment, public accounting firm or major law firm
- Experience a direct tax role in a multinational and/or professional organization
- Experience a compliance focused tax role in a multinational and/or professional organization
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field, or a Bachelor's degree or above and experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
- Experience managing training programs or teams across multiple sites or regions
- Extensive experience in progressive withholding tax experience, ideally from a large multinational or top-tier consulting/advisory firm (Big 4 or equivalent).
- Experience with treaty networks, cross-border withholding tax regimes, and income characterization and sourcing rules.
- Familiarity with SOX/internal controls testing, COSO framework, or similar control methodologies.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience within a multinational business and either legal or accountancy firm experience

title: Technical Program Manager III, Corporate Development Finance
descriptionHtml:
The Investment Management System (IMS) is the system of record for Amazon's corporate investment and warrant portfolios — billions of dollars in value across 700+ positions, spanning minority investments, the four corporate funds, and commercial-activity warrants. IMS serves teams across the Mergers & Acquisitions ecosystem, including Corporate Development, Business Development, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and Treasury.

When someone needs to know what a holding is worth today, how much of a warrant Amazon has earned through its commercial deals, or simply what Amazon owns and what it's worth, IMS is where they get the answer. IMS data feeds directly into Amazon's financial statements and supports real-time investment decisions, so accuracy and timeliness are non-negotiable. A core part of this role is keeping IMS accurate, trustworthy, and current — continuously ingesting new deals and milestones, and integrating and regularly reconciling with other internal and external systems (Amazon Lantern, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Factset).

We are a small, high-ownership technical team with a unique organizational structure: we sit within a larger finance team. This is a deliberate decision to embed technical expertise directly alongside finance partners, enabling rapid collaboration, troubleshooting, and delivery. As a result, this role requires close, effective collaboration and communication with both technical colleagues and non-technical stakeholders and team members. The role indexes high on visibility, ownership, and business acumen.

You will lead the IMS technical program end to end. You will lead a team of 2-3 software engineers, set technical direction with them, drive design decisions, and raise the bar on engineering quality through design and code reviews. You will design and build the services, data pipelines, and web application that power IMS, and you will own the programs that deliver them. That means working directly with stakeholders and leaders across the M&A ecosystem, translating their needs into clear requirements, and driving the work through to reliable, compliant outcomes. You will drive the IMS roadmap end-to-end, prioritizing work, managing stakeholder expectations, and balancing near-term operational needs with longer-term platform investments.

Tech stack: a serverless, event-driven backend on AWS (Python), a PostgreSQL database, a React web application, and an AI assistant built on Amazon Bedrock — all deployed through infrastructure-as-code and Amazon's internal CI/CD, with AI-assisted development tools used daily.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the technical program for IMS: the services and APIs that serve investment and warrant data, the quarterly data pipelines that carry positions from one quarter to the next, and the checks that catch when IMS and upstream finance systems disagree. Drive the architecture decisions with the engineering team.
• Define requirements and acceptance criteria for the data model and the financial calculations (such as IRR, unrealized value, and warrant vesting progress). Go deep enough to validate the results and challenge design trade-offs.
• Own the roadmap and delivery for the React web application and the Amazon Bedrock-based AI assistant, from requirements through launch.
• Work directly with stakeholders and leaders across the M&A ecosystem to turn open-ended requests into clear requirements, prioritize the roadmap, manage dependencies and expectations, and balance near-term operational needs with longer-term platform investments.
• Run the deadline-bound work the team cannot miss, including the quarterly close.
• Lead integrations with partner data teams across multiple systems.
• When it speeds up a decision, prototype, script, or query data yourself. You can read and review production code, but the engineering team owns it.

About the team
Corporate Development Finance (CDF) is a cross-functional team that serves as the finance partner to Amazon’s corporate venture capital funds (the Industrial Innovation Fund, the Alexa Fund, and the Climate Pledge Fund), to Amazon’s warrant program, and to portfolio management across Amazon’s global investment and warrant portfolio. The team comprises finance professionals, program managers, and technical roles building the infrastructure to support a growing and increasingly complex portfolio.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Prior experience as a software engineer, or equivalent hands-on build depth.

descriptionHtml:
Content Specialists support the development and execution of content strategies that align messaging, audience needs, and campaign objectives. Working under the guidance of senior content strategists, they help maintain narrative consistency across the customer journey by producing and coordinating defined content deliverables, applying established content types and placements by funnel stage, and contributing to Content Lifecycle Map development.
The Content Specialist helps execute content strategies that guide customers through a cohesive AWS narrative across touchpoints of their journey. Using our standardized messaging hierarchy and the direction set by senior strategists, this role helps keep messaging, audience needs, and business objectives aligned while maintaining consistency in brand voice and customer experience. The Content Specialist does not own the content strategy or the messaging within the content; they apply the strategic direction provided to them to help content creators deliver consistent, personalized content experiences that educate, engage, and empower customers.


Key job responsibilities
With a focus on audience engagement and consistent storytelling, the Content Specialist’s key responsibilities include assisting with audience and content audits, maintaining content calendars, helping coordinate content creation (though not producing it), and gathering content performance metrics to support continuous improvement. The role involves collaborating with Content Studio, Digital Strategy, Campaign teams, and subject matter experts to help deliver high-quality content across various platforms and formats, ensuring the strategic direction and messaging provided is executed consistently in each content piece—whether blogs, infographics, or videos, etc. The Content Specialist works with the Channels team, Digital Strategists, and Content Studio to apply recommended content formats based on persona, customer journey stage, and content placement.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the execution of content strategies aligned with AWS goals and target audiences
- Assist with audience and content audits to inform strategy
- Help maintain content calendars and information architecture
- Coordinate content creation across various formats (blogs, infographics, videos, etc.) under guidance
- Apply SEO best practices and support multi-platform distribution
- Compile performance metrics and surface observations for review
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (design, peer marketing teams, subject matter experts, etc.) to support alignment across execution touchpoints

- Apply recommended content formats based on persona to support engagement, lead generation, and brand loyalty


A day in the life
Your Day-to-Day

- Help identify trends, content gaps, and audience preferences
- Work with data and analytics teams to gather and track KPIs
- Work with peer teams to support SEO optimization and user-friendly formats
- Stay informed on industry trends and algorithm changes affecting content marketing
- Help maintain relationships with internal and external subject matter experts


About the team
The Integrated Demand Center (IDC) Content Strategy team shapes how AWS tells its story across the customer journey. We're the connective tissue between messaging, audience insight, and campaign execution — making sure the right content reaches the right customer, in the right format, at the right moment. Our work spans the full content lifecycle, from strategy and planning through creation and performance, in close partnership with Content Studio, Digital Strategy, Campaign teams, and subject matter experts across AWS Marketing.

We're a collaborative, curious group that cares as much about craft as about outcomes. We dive deep on our audiences, challenge each other's thinking, and keep a cohesive AWS narrative at the center of everything we build. For someone early in their content career, this is a place to learn from experienced strategists, develop your craft on high-visibility work, and see the direct impact of great content on how customers discover, evaluate, and adopt AWS.

title: Risk Specialist I, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

The Risk Specialist I drives regulated waste compliance across the 2-4 sites they support. This specialist executes the organization's environmental compliance plans at the site level, tracks waste compliance obligations to closure, and partners with site and operations teams to meet compliance milestones. They conduct site inspections, maintain hazardous waste accumulation and manifesting records, and surface gaps through regular program controls.

The ideal candidate brings working knowledge of regulated waste requirements, including RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their sites.

This role requires sound independent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to run the right mechanisms and manage competing priorities to meet compliance objectives in a dynamic, high-pace operations environment. If you are motivated by solving regulatory compliance problems in the field, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the execution and delivery of regulated waste compliance projects and activities, including developing standard operating procedures, workflows, and inspection routines, to mitigate identified risks across the sites you support.
- Apply risk management methods such as waste compliance audits and site inspections to monitor compliance thresholds, test controls, and take corrective action when findings arise.
- Collaborate with site teams, compliance operations, and operations partners to understand business needs, clarify waste compliance requirements, and drive productive discussions that build consensus.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and work with process owners to improve conformance, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency.
- Prepare clear and concise documentation, including status reports, audit results, metrics, and project communications, so the right information reaches the right audience at the right time.
- Travel expected up to 50% of the time.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin by reviewing incoming risk-related requests and prioritizing your project tasks. You will spend time conducting audits or risk assessments, updating documentation, and coordinating with compliance operations and partner teams. Throughout the day, you will track project milestones, resolve roadblocks, and communicate progress to stakeholders. You will also look for ways to streamline existing processes and ensure your risk area stays aligned with current regulations and team objectives.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to protecting Amazon's customers and business by proactively managing risk across a broad range of areas, from regulatory compliance to operational resilience. We work closely with legal, operations, and business partners to deliver practical risk solutions and build a strong culture of compliance. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can grow and make an impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field
- 2+ years of experience in environmental compliance, regulated waste management, or workplace risk investigations
- Experience interpreting and applying environmental regulations (RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules)
- Experience collecting and analyzing data to identify compliance gaps and drive corrective actions

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Experience managing a regulated waste program across multiple sites, including hazardous waste accumulation, manifesting, and disposal
- Hazardous waste certification such as RCRA or DOT (49 CFR) training, or 40-hour HAZWOPER
- Experience conducting site audits or inspections and tracking findings to closure
- Master's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field

descriptionHtml:
AWS is the backbone for the world's software. In order to successfully support this mission we build large scale services that support trillions of transactions. In order to ensure that these services stay up and continue to work for everyone that depend on them we need to protect them from overload. This is where AWS Throttling comes in.

The AWS Throttling Service is a managed service for distributed rate limiting that protects AWS services from unexpected traffic spikes. It gives service owners near infinite throttle scaling, a more efficient throttling client, and better safety for throttle rule configuration and updates. Customers of AWS Throttling have better price-performance, more accuracy, and increased flexibility in tuning more complex throttling decisions. The AWS Throttling platform supports throttle rule analysis and traffic insights visible in the console, along with partner integrations such as Service Quotas in visibility mode.

title: Sr. Associate - Quality Analyst, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- 2+ year work experience in Business Process Outsourcing in any of the following domains: accounting, regulatory compliance, IT services, quality assurance
- Business Process Outsourcing, Operations processes; Database management is an added advantage

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in trade compliance, import/export operations, customs regulations, cross-border logistics, or regulatory compliance processes related to global trade operations is preferred
- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Experience as a quality auditor in retail chain management / FMCG company / Corporate role
- Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
- Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
- Knowledge of database query technologies (SQL)

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager, Global Corporate Procurement
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Manager to join the Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) Team. This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of a team that has a meaningful and measurable impact on Amazon’s success. At Amazon, our vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to pioneer and globalize new businesses and customer offerings daily. As we rapidly become the world’s largest consumer of services in many categories, the Corporate Procurement team is fueling our explosive growth by identifying innovative sourcing strategies and negotiating sustainable, long-term partnerships. We are seeking a skilled Strategic Sourcing Manager with experience leading complex sourcing initiatives across Employee Services.

Key leadership traits required include the ability to influence and form partnerships with business leaders, and operational excellence in managing multiple complex and competing priorities simultaneously. Strategic Sourcing Managers are expert practitioners in the tools for creating competitive environments and have a bias for decision-making rooted in data and analytics. They routinely influence vendor relationships by advising Amazon leaders across multiple stakeholder groups on the direction of sourcing projects in support of business goals. If you are looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company, come make history with Amazon’s Global Corporate Procurement department.

At Amazon, we believe that in-person collaboration is essential to our culture and innovation. While we allow flexibility for personal circumstances, we generally expect employees to work from our offices five days a week. This approach has consistently shown that spontaneous interactions, rapid problem-solving, and the energy of in-person teamwork led to better results for our customers. Our data shows that teams working together in person are more effective at making complex decisions, onboarding new team members, and fostering the kind of creative collaboration that has driven Amazon's success. The serendipitous hallway conversations and impromptu whiteboarding sessions that happen naturally in an office environment have proven invaluable to our invention process and maintaining our high bar for excellence.


Key job responsibilities
- Establishing strong relationships with internal business stakeholders; building a strong understanding of strategic business direction, requirements and priorities across assigned suppliers and/or spend categories
- Dive deep across multiple business units to leverage our supplier base with the goal of optimizing performance, quality, and cost
- Evaluate supplier core competencies and competitive positioning using industry cost models and benchmarking; leveraging key-insights to inform and support the strategic sourcing strategy development process
- Managing the fundamentals of sourcing and supplier engagement activities including RFx, spend pattern analysis, contract analysis, bid evaluation, negotiations, and supplier consolidation
- Identifying sourcing opportunities by leveraging spend analysis tools and engage with stakeholders to consolidate requirements over categories, suppliers and geographies
- Work with business and finance leaders to identify and drive savings and controllership improvements, optimizing the return on investment and total cost of ownership
- Providing guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement processes and best-practice tools, such as category management, supplier evaluation and supplier diversity


A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cross-functional alignment call for an upcoming RFP involving three business units, followed by analyzing bid responses and building a recommendation deck for senior leadership. After lunch, you're on a negotiation call with a strategic supplier's C-suite to finalize contract terms, then pivoting to a spend review with Finance to validate savings actuals against targets. You'll close the day by coaching a business partner through the supplier evaluation framework for an upcoming engagement. No two days look the same — you'll balance long-range strategic planning with hands-on execution, often managing five or more active sourcing engagements simultaneously across different stages of the lifecycle.


About the team
Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) manages Amazon's indirect spend across Employee Services, Marketing, Professional Services, Technology, Logistics, and Real Estate & Facilities. We're a global team of sourcing professionals who combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to deliver sustainable value at scale. Our culture values deep ownership, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action — we move fast, but we move smart. You'll be joining a team where your work is visible to senior leadership and directly tied to Amazon's bottom line.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, etc.)
- Experience managing spend categories that include three or more of the following: IT Software, IT Services, Corporate Services, Marketing, Contingent labor, Facilities and Real estate, Capital Expenditure and Tail Spend (Indirect Categories)
- 5+ years of relevant strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, global contract management, process improvement, operational and financial analysis experience
- 5+ years of creating, defining, and implementing procurement strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Development Engineer II, Selling Partner Trust & Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about creating both the best buying AND selling experience on the internet? Would you enjoy telling your friends that, in your first few weeks, you shipped code that made selling on Amazon clearer, fairer, and more trustworthy for millions of sellers around the world? As a Software Development Engineer on the Selling Partner Trust team, you'll build the systems and AI powered experiences that do exactly that, every single day.

This is a builder's role at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and applied Generative AI and harness. We're leveraging models, building harness and pipelines to help sellers understand and resolve issues quickly, so they can get back to growing their business. If you want your code to reach tens of millions of customers and your design decisions to genuinely change how people experience Amazon, keep reading.

The team and our mission: The Selling Partner Trust team protects Amazon's brand owners, and sellers from bad actors, abuse, and fraud, while making sure good sellers are never unnecessarily disrupted. We believe the future of the Marketplace, and of Amazon, depends on deepening trust across every part of the buying and selling experience. Our vision: give buyers and sellers the most trusted experience on the internet, free of performance gaps, abuse, and negative post purchase surprises.

A growing part of that mission is transparency. When something affects a seller's ability to sell, they deserve a clear explanation, a path forward, and the tools to fix it, proactively, before any disruption. That's where you come in.

Who you are: You're a technical builder with the prowess to deliver world-class software and the judgment to know what to build next. You have great intuition. At Amazon, teams run like businesses, and that ownership means you, as an engineer, are responsible for the technical solutions that deliver an exceptional customer experience. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and you're at your best when the design space is wide open, as comfortable reasoning about a GenAI evaluation pipeline as you are about tail latency on a service handling millions of requests a day.

What you'll build:
GenAI-powered seller experiences at scale, production systems built on harness & services that leverage foundation models powers, that turn complex signals into clear, accurate, seller-facing guidance. You'll work across AI hardness design, retrieval, output evaluation, and safety guardrails, and the platform that makes generative experiences reliable enough to serve millions of sellers.
High-performance platforms, services that handle millions of requests per day at millisecond latency under strict SLAs, built on big data sets and distributed frameworks, serving the world's largest product selection.
Trust and remediation systems, automation and experiences that help sellers understand issues, resolve them quickly, and avoid problems before they ever happen.

You'll have the opportunity to conceptualize, design, build, test, and own software systems end to end. You'll drive the technical direction of the team across a wide range of technologies, designing and coding, troubleshooting and supporting, and continuously raising the bar on what we ship. You'll have real ownership of what we build, not just a slice of it, as part of an exceptionally talented team where your ideas shape the roadmap.

Why this role: We're scaling our seller-trust experiences across Amazon's full policy surface and expanding the role of Generative AI in how we communicate with sellers. The systems you build will be visible to leadership and used by sellers worldwide on day one. The impact is real, measurable, and yours to own.

Want to build large scale, AI powered systems that earn sellers' trust and help them succeed? We're looking for you.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

title: Sr Product Manager - Tech Integration Lead for Transit Time Authority, Flow Excellence
descriptionHtml:
Every package Amazon delivery depends on an accurate transit time estimate. The Transit Time Authority (TTA) program is the single source of truth that vends those estimates to internal customers across design, scheduling, routing, Amazon Fulfilled Network, and Amazon Freight. As Amazon invests heavily in accelerating same-day and next-day delivery, TTA plays a critical role in making that speed possible. As a Sr Product Manager on this team, you will own the downstream integration of transit-time models into scheduling and routing systems. You will partner with tech and science teams to translate increasingly accurate transit-time data into real operational improvements, driving trade-off decisions between speed, cost, and delivery accuracy that shape how the network performs. This role sits alongside a second Product Manager who owns the upstream model development, giving you a clear scope focused on adoption, system integration, and measurable business outcomes for internal customers across network design, planning, and operations.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product strategy for integrating transit-time model outputs into downstream scheduling and routing systems, defining requirements and priorities based on business impact and operational data.
- Evaluate technical proposals across ML model design, system integrations, and data pipelines, ensuring trade-off decisions between speed, cost, and delivery accuracy are well-informed and clearly communicated.
- Lead cross-functional delivery with tech, science, and business partners, driving alignment across teams with different priorities and influencing strategic direction.
- Maintain TTA infrastructure for EU. Identify opportunities to apply generative AI tools to accelerate insight generation, automate analytics workflows, and improve team productivity while applying responsible AI practices.
- Define success criteria and performance metrics for transit-time adoption, monitor operational health post-launch and benefits, and drive continuous improvement through data analysis and stakeholder feedback.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing transit-time performance dashboards and flagging anomalies that need investigation. From there, you could join a working session with scheduling and routing engineers to define integration requirements for a new model granularity. After lunch, you prepare a trade-off proposal for business stakeholders, quantifying how a change in transit-time strategy would affect cost and delivery speed. Later, you sync with the science team on an upcoming model update and draft acceptance criteria for the next release.

About the team
The Transit Time Authority team provides the transit-time inputs that power scheduling, routing, and network design across Amazon's middle-mile network. We work directly with North American tech and science teams to improve model accuracy and expand coverage to new business flows. The organization is investing in speed, and our team is a key driver of that effort. Previous team members have grown into Technical Product Management roles based on the depth of technical work here. If you want to solve complex optimization problems with real operational impact, we would welcome you on the team.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning technology products
- Experience with product cycles of 6+ months
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Experience in using statistical analysis to identify issues or opportunities for improvement

title: Sr. Financial Analyst, Ring and Blink PL Finance
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Financial Analyst (SFA)— is the consolidation partner for the Ring and Blink Finance team's Hardware Gross Profit reporting. This role works directly with multiple finance managers to bring their inputs together into a single integrated GP view across devices and accessories, online and offline, NA and International. Within that shared model, the SFA owns the inventory reserve calculations outright, serves as the point of contact for system data integrity, and owns the forecasting and MEC calendars that keep both brands' cycles on track.

Working with limited guidance, the role applies business and financial principles to decision-making, understands the trade-offs behind the numbers, and proactively audits its own work to ensure reporting accuracy during OP1, OP2, 3YF, Quarterly Guidance, the monthly Latest Estimate, and actuals/MEC reviews.

Key job responsibilities
*Create and own the forecasting and MEC calendars for the business partners: build the cycle timelines (OP1, OP2, 3YF, Quarterly Guidance, monthly Latest Estimate, and month-end close), publish key dates and input deadlines to the two brand leads and cross-functional partners, and drive the cadence so submissions, reviews, and sign-offs land on time.
*Consolidate Hardware GP across both brands: partner with multiple Finance managers across both brands to aggregate their cycle inputs — net units, net revenue, COGS/BOM, and hardware gross profit — and reconcile them into one integrated view across devices and accessories, NA and International.
*Compile the monthly Latest Estimate (LE): gather and validate the brand leads' submissions against the LE templates and timeline, bridge LE-over-LE and LE-vs-guidance variances, and prepare the review-ready consolidated GP financials each cycle, seeking guidance from team leaders where needed.
*Own the inventory valuation and reserve calculations feeding the consolidated GP position:
Inventory impairment — quantify impairment on at-risk hardware inventory.
Lower of Cost or Market (LCM) — calculate LCM reserves where carrying cost exceeds net realizable value, applying the methodology agreed with Accounting.
Excess & Obsolete (E&O) — compute E&O reserves across devices and accessories using EOL timing, demand/forecast coverage, and sell-through assumptions.
Partner with Accounting on sign-off and carry the reserve positions into the consolidated GP and MEC.
*Serve as the POC for system data integrity: act as the primary contact for the accuracy and consistency of the Finance data sources that feed consolidation and reserves (e.g., TM1/Vista/Prophecy, TCPU/BOM, DIDM, inventory and demand data) — identifying and correcting data discrepancies, validating flows across systems, and escalating more complex issues to the right owners.
*Support month-end close (MEC) consolidation for Hardware GP across both brands — units, revenue, COGS, promotions/MDF, and the impairment/LCM/E&O reserves — delivering accurate, on-time reporting and auditing for discrepancies.
*Partner with cross-functional teams — Category, Supply Chain, Operations, Accounting, and FinTech — to validate COGS/BOM assumptions, reserve inputs, inventory positions, and system data, and to explain variance drivers.
*Optimize and document the consolidation and reserve processes: improve and automate recurring compilation steps, maintain SOPs and reconciliation logic, and contribute to continuous-improvement efforts that reduce defects.
*Communicate clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, adjusting style to the audience with support, and summarizing GP and reserve movements for the brand leads, the Finance team, and business partners.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 3+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 3+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Finance Manager - SCOT Automated Inventory Management , SCOT AIM Finance

Operating at massive scale across hundreds of product lines and billions of dollars of worldwide inventory, SCOT's fully in-house, automated planning and optimization systems are among the most sophisticated in the world. Finance within SCOT is a high-impact function, partnering directly with AI and machine learning engineers, scientists, product managers, and operations leaders to shape strategy, drive investment decisions, and deliver measurable improvements to Amazon's supply chain economics.

--The Role--

We're looking for a Finance Manager who thrives in deep business partnership with senior executives, including Directors and VPs — serving as the financial owner for our Rest of World Automated Inventory Management portfolio, covering India, Japan, AMET (Africa, Middle East, and Turkey), and emerging markets across Latin America and Asia Pacific.

This role sits at the intersection of finance and AI in supply chain — with high agency, a direct line to the regional leaders defining Amazon's inventory strategy across some of its fastest-growing markets, and the autonomy to drive investment decisions as the financial voice shaping how these systems are built, extended, and scaled into new geographies.

We seek a candidate who is curious about how AI-driven autonomous systems shape business outcomes — comfortable interrogating model inputs, challenging assumptions, and asking "is this optimizing for the right thing?" You build trust quickly, partner closely with technical and business leaders, and know how to show up as a strategic equal at the table. You're comfortable operating at multiple altitudes — equally at ease with a data model as you are presenting to a VP.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with Science and Product teams to develop financial strategies and drive controllership across RoW Automated Inventory Management systems, ensuring technology investments deliver maximum long-term free cash flow and measurable improvements to supply chain efficiency across markets ranging from early-stage builds in AMET to accelerating system maturity in Japan and India
- Navigate high degrees of ambiguity to build financial models that evaluate technology investments in markets at varying stages of maturity — from India, which is undergoing significant network transformation, to Japan, which is scaling rapidly, to AMET, a regional team in its second year of operation with significant growth ahead
- Conduct rigorous financial assessments of identified inventory defects — including entitlement analysis, estimation accuracy, and opportunity costs — translating findings into measurable P&L impact across the network
- Build and maintain metrics and audit mechanisms to evaluate algorithmic decision outcomes in RoW markets, flagging when models underperform and surfacing data-driven recommendations to course-correct
- Develop compelling narratives and financial analyses for regional and global executive reviews
- Leverage AI agents, GenAI assistants, and AI-powered data platforms to accelerate analysis, improve productivity, and continuously explore new ways to deliver higher-quality insights faster

A day in the life
This role sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and supply chain strategy. You'll spend your time working shoulder-to-shoulder with operations research scientists, product managers, and engineers — engaging in model design discussions, stress-testing algorithmic assumptions, and translating system behavior into financial narratives that drive strategic decisions. No two days look the same: one day you're building a financial framework to evaluate a new algorithm with an engineer; the next you're presenting findings in a VP-level review where the outcome shapes how Amazon invests in its inventory infrastructure.

About the team
This role sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and supply chain strategy across some of Amazon's most dynamic and fast-growing markets. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with regional operations research scientists, product managers, and engineers — engaging in model design discussions, stress-testing algorithmic assumptions, and translating system behavior into financial narratives that drive strategic decisions. The problems here are less defined than in mature markets — systems are being extended, launched, and adapted for the first time — which means you'll have real influence over how Amazon builds its inventory infrastructure in these regions. One day you're evaluating the financial case for a new system launch in India; the next you're shaping the financial framework for how Amazon expands its supply chain operations in AMET, or stress-testing assumptions behind Japan's next wave of automation. No two days look the same.
The culture is direct, curious, and intellectually honest. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with scientists, engineers, and product managers, ask hard questions, and show up as strategic equals.

- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 4+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)

Preferred qualifications

title: Manager, Technical Program Management
descriptionHtml:
Are you energized by leading teams that tackle complex, ambiguous technical challenges? Do you thrive when coordinating across multiple engineering and product teams to deliver programs that matter? We're looking for a Technical Program Management leader to manage a team of technical program managers and drive the execution of large-scale, cross-functional programs at Amazon. In this role, you'll define strategy, set goals, and guide your team through the full software development lifecycle — from planning through release. You'll shape how your team operates, establish workflows and service-level agreements, and build mechanisms that ensure consistent, measurable results. Your ability to navigate ambiguity, negotiate priorities, and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels will be key to your success.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and manage a team of technical program managers, providing tactical and strategic direction while building a high-performing, inclusive team culture that empowers members to deliver independently.
- Drive execution of cross-functional technical programs from planning through release, defining scope, timelines, milestones, and success criteria across engineering, product, and operations teams.
- Identify and mitigate program risks, manage complex escalations, and make informed trade-offs between short-term delivery needs and long-term strategic goals.
- Build and scale audit mechanisms, metrics, and reporting to track team progress, operational performance, and customer outcomes — communicating results clearly to leadership and key stakeholders.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools and processes where appropriate to improve program efficiency, while establishing process improvements that reduce repeated work and simplify delivery.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing program status updates and preparing a narrative for an upcoming leadership review. By mid-morning, you're in a working session with engineers and product managers, unblocking a cross-team dependency and aligning on revised milestones. After lunch, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report, coaching them through a stakeholder challenge and discussing their career development goals. Later, you collaborate with partner teams to negotiate resource priorities for the quarter ahead, then close out the day refining your team's operational metrics dashboard.

About the team
Our team is focused on delivering technical programs that have a meaningful impact on customers and the broader Amazon ecosystem. We operate in a collaborative environment where program managers partner closely with engineering, product, and science teams to solve complex problems at scale. We are building toward a future where our programs run with greater efficiency and clarity, and we are looking for a leader who is excited to shape that vision. If you want to grow an inclusive team, drive operational improvements, and influence how Amazon delivers for customers, this is the role for you.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of people management experience
- 7+ years of direct work with engineering teams experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- Experience in technical program management
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience with Agile or other program management methodologies

title: Recruitment Consultant Apprentice (36-month fixed term contract)
descriptionHtml:
The Recruitment Consultant apprenticeship will appeal to individuals who possess an entrepreneurial outlook and a genuine passion for candidate talent search and engagement. In this role, every day brings new challenges and discoveries, and you'll collaborate with teams focused on talent acquisition, process improvement, and strategy development. It's a fast-paced, dynamic environment where you'll help deliver an efficient, high-quality service to both internal and external customers.

As a Recruitment Consultant apprentice, you'll learn the full craft of recruitment - how to source, screen, and interview candidates effectively, build strong relationships with both job seekers and hiring managers, and read the job market to make successful placements. You'll also develop skills that many don't associate with recruitment: sales and negotiation to match candidates to the right opportunities, the legal and ethical foundations that keep hiring fair and compliant, and the data and recruitment-software skills that keep the whole process running smoothly.

A day in the life can involve:
- Identifying and contacting potential job candidates
- Scheduling and conducting candidate interviews and assessments
- Liaising with hiring managers to understand their hiring needs
- Matching candidates to suitable job openings
- Guiding and advising candidates throughout the recruitment process
- Maintaining accurate candidate records and managing databases
- Keeping up to date with industry trends and job-market developments
- Maintaining and analysing hiring data points to spot trends

We're looking for someone with a natural curiosity about recruitment who's eager to understand the industry and play a pivotal role in talent acquisition. You'll bring meticulous attention to detail and take pride in delivering high-quality, accurate work. Because the role moves quickly, you'll need to adapt fast, prioritise effectively, and stay agile when demands shift. And you'll enjoy working as part of a team, bringing a service-oriented mindset and a commitment to giving every customer an exceptional experience.

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

You'll gain a wide range of valuable experiences and skills while working towards the BA (Hons) in Recruitment Practice. You'll combine working in your assigned team with your studies: as a working student, your focus during your 20% off-the-job time is to develop the skills, knowledge and behaviours that lead to successful graduation. You'll be set objectives and goals by your training provider and manager to support your studies.

You'll build your skills over a 36-month period, starting in September, developing both personally and professionally. Your apprenticeship combines classroom and virtual training to cover the knowledge, on-the-job training at your Amazon base location, online learning, and mentoring from our experienced team members.

We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups — including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Your career isn't a straight path - it's a journey you build as you go. A universe of opportunity awaits, and your next adventure starts here.

title: OEM Engineering Technician Apprentice - Dublin Locations 2027
descriptionHtml:
Fascinated by the mechanics behind automated systems? Want to master both electrical and mechanical engineering while working with cutting-edge technology? Amazon is the perfect place to launch your career in Mechatronics Maintenance.

As one of the world's most advanced technology-driven companies, we're powered by automation, robotics, and continuous innovation - from robotic arms to complex conveyor networks and smart sensor technology that keep millions of customer orders moving. This apprenticeship gives you the chance to become a multi-skilled maintenance technician across both electrical and mechanical disciplines, with hands-on experience on industry-leading equipment, some of which only exists at Amazon.

Our European Engineering team is fundamental to our operations - they keep vital machinery running around the clock. As an OEM Engineering Technician Apprentice, you'll help maintain a wide range of equipment while upholding Health and Safety best practice, keeping your colleagues safe, preventing downtime, and improving the availability and quality of our equipment.

You'll thrive here if you stay calm when things go wrong and get a real kick out of fixing them. You're hands-on, curious about how machines work, and you understand that keeping production moving is what it's all about. And you don't need to be a qualified engineer to start - what matters most is a practical, problem-solving mindset and a hunger to learn.

A day in the life can involve:

- Carrying out proactive and preventative maintenance
- Carrying out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Using the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Making modifications and upgrades to existing equipment
- Upholding health and safety policies and practices
- Working on continuous improvement projects, and suggesting long-term improvements

Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll build a broad, in-demand engineering skillset, including:

- Fault diagnosis and preventative maintenance
- Mechanical device maintenance, and fluid power systems assembly and testing
- Electrical equipment wiring and testing
- Hydraulics and pneumatics
- Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) operations
- CAD design and 3D printing

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

Throughout the apprenticeship you'll work towards an NFQ Level 6 Advanced Certificate in OEM Engineering, combining practical, on-the-job experience with industry-recognised study. The first 16 weeks of each year will be full-time residential (classroom training) at one of our training providers' facilities. As a result, you may be required to travel to the accommodation on a Sunday and work away from home until Friday each week during term time (costs supported by Amazon), combined with short periods working at one of our Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, or Delivery Stations.

In subsequent years, you'll undertake on-the-job training in a Fulfilment Centre while concurrently completing your academic training, learning directly from experienced technicians and engineers and gaining exposure to real engineering projects. Alongside invaluable experience, you'll gain a number of externally recognised qualifications.

This role supports our 24/7 operation, so you'll work shifts covering days, nights and weekends - patterns that reflect the real-world schedules of the engineers who keep Amazon operating around the clock.

You'll join a diverse and passionate team of engineers dedicated to driving results and pushing creative boundaries. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups - including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a well-rounded professional.

Join us and be part of the team that keeps Amazon moving. Apply now and shape the future of technology with us.

As part of the recruitment and enrolment process for this apprenticeship, candidates must provide proof of all required qualifications. Original certificates or certified copies must be submitted - this is a mandatory requirement to secure the position. The deadline for providing qualification certificates for the RME Mechatronics programme is 16 July 2027. Applications without verified qualifications by this date will automatically be unsuccessful, and failure to provide proof by the deadline will result in the withdrawal of any conditional offer, meaning you will not be able to commence the programme. Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility, and offers may be withdrawn for applicants who do not meet the funding criteria.

title: Manager, Technical Program Management, OTS Delivery Software Engineering (DSE)
descriptionHtml:
Every Amazon package that ships, every grocery order that is fulfilled, and every locker that opens depends on technology our teams keep running. Amazon's OpsTech Solutions (OTS) is the IT operations and infrastructure organization for all of Amazon Worldwide Operations, including Worldwide Grocery Stores (WWGS), delivering reliable technology to more than one million associates and operators across every geography and all business miles. OTS is transforming from reactive support to proactive, AI-powered service delivery. Delivery Software Engineering (DSE) owns the ServiceNow platform and the technology behind that transformation, and the Technical Program Management (TPM) team is how the platform program portfolio gets delivered.

You will lead the DSE Technical Program Management team and own the delivery of its ServiceNow platform program portfolio. This is not a net-new role. You inherit an established team and an active portfolio the team already runs. You manage the people: you hire, develop, and set the bar. You own the portfolio: your team drives delivery across new product introduction, cross-platform intake, routing, high-volume events, product adoption, platform health, release management, contractual compliance, agentic AI delivery, and voice of the customer. You hold team-level accountability for every program your TPMs run.

This is a people-management and single-threaded-ownership role. Your TPMs take product requirements defined by the Product Manager or PM-T and own delivery end to end: technical scoping, cross-team coordination, dependency management, release sequencing, risk mitigation, and field rollout and adoption. You govern the hand-offs between Product, Engineering, and Operations, and you keep the portfolio clear to those partners and to leadership. You carry platform-level strategic awareness for ServiceNow: what capabilities the platform offers, what we pay for, where we have implementation deficits, and how contractual scope aligns with product roadmap needs. You do not need to be a ServiceNow administrator, but you need to know enough about the platform to hold the boundary between what we build custom and what the platform provides natively.

Key job responsibilities
- Own people management for the DSE TPM team, including hiring, performance, growth, and promotion, and hold team-level accountability for the delivery of every program the team runs.
- Define and own the team's charter, operating model, and goal portfolio, so each program carries a named owner, a metric, and skip-level visibility.
- Own AI program delivery end to end, including OTS MCP, OTS-A, and OTS-KG, and coordinate agentic-workspace delivery with product partners.
- Act as single-threaded owner at the portfolio level for ambiguous, cross-functional programs that span Product, Engineering, and Operations.
- Govern the dependency interface. Where a program depends on a product feature or an engineering deliverable, manage that interface with logged needed-by dates.
- Partner with product and engineering leaders across DSE and ANCHOR to resolve service overlap, drive build-versus-reuse decisions, and align competing priorities without direct authority.
- Own the portfolio's review and reporting standards, and set adoption, cost-avoidance, and efficiency metrics that make program impact measurable.
- Contribute to annual planning (OP1/OP2) with clear investment and headcount proposals, and run a mechanism to capture voice of the customer from internal OTS employees and operational customers.

A day in the life
Your day moves between people leadership and portfolio delivery. You run 1:1s and coaching conversations with your TPMs, unblock a stalled program, and step into a red program to drive a decision with the owning TPM and their engineering counterparts. You review portfolio status and dependency risk, then join an architecture or prioritization discussion with Product and Engineering to set where service boundaries sit. In the afternoon you make trade-offs across competing priorities, prepare the monthly Kingpin review or the ServiceNow MPR for senior leadership, and draft the strategy and investment narratives that keep the portfolio funded. You build the mechanisms, the RACI, risk registers, dashboards, and review cadences, so the team can scale without you in every meeting.

About the team
OTS Delivery Software Engineering (DSE) is a product-engineering partnership responsible for every technology platform OTS field technicians and operations associates use daily. The team defines what to build, and a 50-plus person engineering org of AppDev, SysDev, and SDEs delivers it. DSE owns ServiceNow as its enterprise platform, builds AI agents on AWS Bedrock, and runs the technology behind a 24/7 Service Desk. The TPM team is the coordination layer between product vision and engineering execution across ESC, SPM, ITSM, the Idea Portal, routing, and release management on one platform. It partners with ANCHOR, Global Workforce Management (GWM), and the OTS and RME program teams.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of people management experience
- 5+ years of technical program management experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Experience defining system architectures and exploring technical feasibility tradeoffs
- 5+ years of IT platform implementation in a technical and analytical role experience, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of data center infrastructure design, operations, or delivery
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience with Agile or other program management methodologies
- Experience leveraging AI-powered tools or data analytics platforms to drive quality improvements, root cause analysis, or process optimization
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 6+ years of leading technology teams as a information technology operations manager experience
